contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 中央八项规定，无疑是读懂新时代中国共产党...
contentList.remark: 中央八项规定，无疑是读懂新时代中国共产党，这个世界上最大的马克思主义执政党的一把 “钥匙”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “制定实施中央八项规定，是我们党在新时代...
contentList.remark: “制定实施中央八项规定，是我们党在新时代的徙木立信之举，必须常抓不懈、久久为功，十年不够就二十年，二十年不够三十年，直至真正化风成俗，以优良党风引领社风民风。” 二十届中央纪委二次全会上，习近平总书记总书记的这番论述，揭示着新时代全面从严治党的清醒和坚定，更是一份在人民群众面前掷地有声的生动宣告。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 就在这个月，全国两会一结束，党中央在全党...
contentList.remark: 就在这个月，全国两会一结束，党中央在全党部署开展深入贯彻中央八项规定精神学习教育。中共中央办公厅印发《通知》的消息发布之际，习近平总书记正在贵州云南考察。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 黎平肇兴侗寨，总书记就坐在老旧鼓楼条凳上...
contentList.remark: 黎平肇兴侗寨，总书记就坐在老旧鼓楼条凳上，同乡亲聊家常，“条凳座谈会” 别开生面；丽江古城，雪花飞檐覆春雪，不封路、不排场、轻车简从，他的到来温暖了街巷。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 对照八项规定，云贵行既有 “多同群众座谈...
contentList.remark: 对照八项规定，云贵行既有 “多同群众座谈” 的示范，也有 “轻车简从” 厉行勤俭节约的践诺，更有希望乡亲们 “幸福生活更上一层楼” 的美好祝愿…… 总书记身体力行、以上率下，人民情怀、政治本色一以贯之。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 镜头拉回到 2012 年 12 月 4 ...
contentList.remark: 镜头拉回到 2012 年 12 月 4 日，十八届中央政治局会议，在党史上标注了浓墨重彩的一笔：审议通过《中央政治局关于改进工作作风、密切联系群众的八项规定》。这是新时代制定的第一部重要党内法规，也成为改进工作作风的 “一个切入口和动员令”。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: 一问：实施八项规定，成效如何？ “我们是...
contentList.remark:
一问：实施八项规定，成效如何？
“我们是能办成事的，而且是认真办事的”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “八项规定一落地，作风建设满盘皆活。”...
contentList.remark: “八项规定一落地，作风建设满盘皆活。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 驰而不息。中央八项规定已成为党的作风建设...
contentList.remark: 驰而不息。中央八项规定已成为党的作风建设的代名词，成为新时代中国共产党人的一张 “金色名片”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 就在这次云贵考察中，习近平总书记深刻指出...
contentList.remark: 就在这次云贵考察中，习近平总书记深刻指出：“这些年，八项规定确实是推动了根本性的变化，风气为之一新，过去积重难返的现象大部分没有了。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 放在时间长河里去观察。审议通过八项规定的...
contentList.remark: 放在时间长河里去观察。审议通过八项规定的那次中央政治局会议，习近平总书记语重心长说了一席话：“就是要不舒服一点、不自在一点，我们不舒服一点、不自在一点，老百姓的舒适度就好一点、满意度就高一点，对我们的感觉就好一点。这也是新形象新气象。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 党员干部的变化和人民群众的观感，制定八项...
contentList.remark: 党员干部的变化和人民群众的观感，制定八项规定之初的两方面思量，也在多年后成为检验八项规定成效的量尺。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 党员干部，约束多了，却 “解脱了” 又 ...
contentList.remark: 党员干部，约束多了，却 “解脱了” 又 “身心舒畅”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “从文山会海和接待应酬中解脱出来，工作方...
contentList.remark: “从文山会海和接待应酬中解脱出来，工作方式和生活方式发生明显转变，大多数干部觉得解脱了、身心舒畅，家庭也有亲切感了。整天喝得醉醺醺的，舒服吗？”2014 年 3 月，在八项规定实施一年多之后，习近平总书记在河南兰考县委常委扩大会议上深刻指出。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 十年后的春天。2024 年 3 月，湖南...
contentList.remark: 十年后的春天。2024 年 3 月，湖南常德蒿子坪村，村党支部书记段德喜向总书记汇报：村部最多时有 38 块牌子，现在 12 块；微信工作群从最多时的 30 多个减为现在的 4 个。一减一留，知全貌。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “戒”“规”“畏”，不论什么人，不论其职...
contentList.remark: “戒”“规”“畏”，不论什么人，不论其职务多高，只要触犯了党纪国法，都要受到严肃追究和严厉惩处，决不是一句空话。划出禁区红线，设定行为杠杠，这又何尝不是一种保护？

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 许多党员干部的思想和行动在悄然转变：从不...
contentList.remark: 许多党员干部的思想和行动在悄然转变：从不适应到适应，由不相信到相信，由被动到主动，校准了思想之标。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 调整了行为之舵，绷紧了作风之弦”。...
contentList.remark: 调整了行为之舵，绷紧了作风之弦”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 百姓，多了份信任，也添了份信心。社风民风...
contentList.remark: 百姓，多了份信任，也添了份信心。社风民风正持续向好。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 2024 年国家统计局的调查显示，94....
contentList.remark: 2024 年国家统计局的调查显示，94.9% 的受访群众对中央八项规定精神贯彻落实成效表示肯定。这是人民群众给我们党投下的信任票。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 2018 年 1 月，在《推进党的建设新...
contentList.remark: 2018 年 1 月，在《推进党的建设新的伟大工程要一以贯之》的重要文章中，总书记强调：“党的十八大前的一段时间里一些领导干部中吃喝成风，老百姓意见很大。出了多少规定，也没有管住，不少人因此失去了信心。党的十八大后，我们下决心整治，现在管住了，人民群众拍手叫好。我们管住了一些领导干部的嘴，赢得了无数人民群众的心。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 人民心中有杆秤。从八项规定实施，人们看到...
contentList.remark: 人民心中有杆秤。从八项规定实施，人们看到了总书记的人民情怀，看到了共产党人的严肃认真，不加 “试行”，上来就是硬杠杠，出手就是刚性约束。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “世界上怕就怕‘认真’二字，共产党就最讲...
contentList.remark: “世界上怕就怕‘认真’二字，共产党就最讲‘认真’。只要我们动真格抓，就没有解决不了的问题。” 当价值旨归置于人民，当一切为了人民，哪怕是像中秋送月饼的小事，也会认真地紧盯不放，因为 “看起来是小事，其实是抓这后面隐藏的腐败”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 整治指尖上的形式主义，既为基层减负，更为...
contentList.remark: 整治指尖上的形式主义，既为基层减负，更为着基层干部能够腾出时间来为群众办实事。习近平总书记将 “如何始终不忘初心、牢记使命” 列为大党独有难题之首，从人民的获得感、幸福感、安全感去思考大政方针，“不正之风离我们越远，群众就会离我们越近”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 党的作风就是党的形象。八项规定滋养的是党...
contentList.remark: 党的作风就是党的形象。八项规定滋养的是党和群众的血脉深情。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “让大家感到我们是能办成事的，而且是认真...
contentList.remark: “让大家感到我们是能办成事的，而且是认真办事的。这样才能取信于民、取信于全党。” 这种精神的感召，这种作风建设的新成效，使我们党不断赢得人民群众信任拥护，“全党就会很有力量，我们就不惧任何艰难险阻”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我担任了党的总书记，必须严格要求自己，带...
contentList.remark: 我担任了党的总书记，必须严格要求自己，带头按党章办事，带头遵守党的纪律和规矩，带头管好亲属子女和身边工作人员。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 八项规定第一条，“要改进调查研究”。...
contentList.remark: 八项规定第一条，“要改进调查研究”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 还记得小康路上，翻山岭、冒风雪、顶烈日，...
contentList.remark: 还记得小康路上，翻山岭、冒风雪、顶烈日，总书记的足迹遍布 14 个集中连片特困地区。到老乡家坐炕沿，问得也细，因为炕头铺盖里装着群众的吃穿用度。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 2020 年疫情之初，习近平总书记到浙江...
contentList.remark: 2020 年疫情之初，习近平总书记到浙江调研，正是因为深入港口、企业，敏锐察觉 “大进大出的环境条件已经变化”，由此思考 “双循环” 的新发展格局。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “下之所以为，惟上是视。” 习近平总书记...
contentList.remark: “下之所以为，惟上是视。” 习近平总书记深刻指出，一些久拖难解的问题，病症在下面，病根却在上头。一次会上，他谆谆告诫在场的领导干部，“不应该是作风建设的被动参与者，而应该是积极践行者，以身作则、以上率下，把落实中央八项规定精神化作自觉行动”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 上行下效，积微践行。大江南北，八项规定成...
contentList.remark: 上行下效，积微践行。大江南北，八项规定成为作风建设 “切入口”，从点到面、以点带面，以此带动党的建设各方面工作。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 安徽桐城，六尺巷里天地宽。古人倡导讲求礼...
contentList.remark: 安徽桐城，六尺巷里天地宽。古人倡导讲求礼让，以和为贵处理邻里矛盾，留下一段佳话。今天，基层干部打卡社会治理文化根基，走出一条 “新时代六尺巷工作法” 基层治理之路。北京的 “接诉即办”、上海的 “一网通办”、浙江的 “最多跑一次”…… 党员干部作风转变之后，治理体系和治理能力现代化的地方实践，如雨后春笋。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 那么，该如何深入八项规定？当然，有人读后...
contentList.remark: 那么，该如何深入八项规定？当然，有人读后置疑：“我的一个同学在一家企业做大企业老板，可以让基层更好履职，可以让一个企业更好发展，可凡事利弊相依。统筹营商环境、民生实事，都同八项规定一脉相承。就拿营商环境来说，习近平总书记创新性概括做到 “亲”“清” 两个字。亲而有度、清而有为，凡事，小一点，慎微慎独。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “敏于行、慎于言，降虚火、求实效，实一点...
contentList.remark: “敏于行、慎于言，降虚火、求实效，实一点，再实一点。” 在以上率下的实干中，中华民族跋涉、奋进，阔步向前。

contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: 三问：为什么不是 “歇歇脚”，而是再务实...
contentList.remark:
三问：为什么不是 “歇歇脚”，而是再务实？

contentList.remark:
二问：取得今天的成效，原因何在？
“改进作风必须自上而下、以上率下”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 梳理八项规定收获成效的缘由，以上率下，抓...
contentList.remark: 梳理八项规定收获成效的缘由，以上率下，抓住 “关键少数”，是其中的关键。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 历来重信守诺，历来崇尚真抓实干。八项规定...
contentList.remark: 历来重信守诺，历来崇尚真抓实干。八项规定实施之初，习近平总书记首先就从中央政治局抓起：

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “党风廉政建设，要从领导干部做起，领导干...
contentList.remark: “党风廉政建设，要从领导干部做起，领导干部首先要从中央领导做起。” 他亮明态度，“善禁者，先禁其身而后人”“中央政治局同志从我本人做起”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 谘于前而励后践。很多人至今记得这些画图：...
contentList.remark: 谘于前而励后践。很多人至今记得这些画图：

contentList.fullName: text: 党的十八大后首次离京考察，总书记前往广东...
contentList.remark: 党的十八大后首次离京考察，总书记前往广东，不腾道、不封路、不铺红毯；

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 下部队视察，在舰艇，总书记到水兵餐厅就餐...
contentList.remark: 下部队视察，在舰艇，总书记到水兵餐厅就餐，拿着餐盘同战士们一起排队打饭菜，一张桌子吃饭。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 饭碗里，盛着党心民心。有几张菜单、票据：...
contentList.remark: 饭碗里，盛着党心民心。有几张菜单、票据：2012 年考察河北阜平县的晚餐菜单，2014 年考察河南兰考县的餐费收据、2015 年在梁家河乡亲梁玉明家的午餐收条…… 一四菜一汤，都是普通家常菜，这就是一位领袖的日常。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 2015 年 12 月，在中央政治局 “...
contentList.remark: 2015 年 12 月，在中央政治局 “三严三实” 专题民主生活会上，谈到待遇保障，习近平总书记的话令人动容：“在这方面，我是很注意的，也算是谨小慎微，遇事三思而后行，做事情总要想想有没有触碰哪条规矩。我常常想，受全党同志信任。

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: 有人问，既然中央八项规定实施这些年，成效如此之大，是不是可以“歇歇脚”了？

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 习近平总书记曾用“快活三里”的故事做过形...
contentList.remark: 习近平总书记曾用“快活三里”的故事做过形象比喻。泰山半腰有段平路叫“快活三里”，一些登山的人喜欢在此歇脚。挑山工却不在此久留，休息时间长了，腿就会“发懒”，再上“十八盘”就更困难了。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 越到紧要关头，越不能有丝毫松懈。作风建设...
contentList.remark: 越到紧要关头，越不能有丝毫松懈。作风建设同样如此。这次云贵行，讲到八项规定成效的同时，习近平总书记清醒指出：“要看到，有一些地方发生了松动，有一些方面还存在盲区死角，一些不良风气出现了反弹回潮。钉钉子嘛，再钉几下，久久为功，化风为俗。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 有组数据令人深思。党的二十大以来，全国监...
contentList.remark: 有组数据令人深思。党的二十大以来，全国监察机关共查处群众身边不正之风和腐败问题76.8万件、处分62.8万人。看这组数据，人们既真切感受到清风正气，也难免忧虑：为什么有些人在高压态势下依然不收敛、不收手？

contentList.remark:
从外部看，“作风问题具有反复性和顽固性，不可能一蹴而就、毕其功于一役，更不能一阵风、刮一下就停”。

contentList.remark: 新华社北京 3 月 23 日电（记者韩洁、雷蕾）国务院总理李强 3 月 23 日上午在北京出席中国发展高层论坛 2025 年年会开幕式并发表主旨演讲。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 李强表示，正如习近平主席指出，发展是人类...
contentList.remark: 李强表示，正如习近平主席指出，发展是人类社会的永恒主题。大家都非常关心中国经济发展情况，也很关心全球发展走向。一段时间以来，对中国经济和世界形势，基于不同层面、不同视角的观察和分析可谓林林总总，其中不乏真知灼见。这里我也想从三个视角，跟大家分享一些观察和思考。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 第一个视角：从 “春节经济” 来看中国的...
contentList.remark: 第一个视角：从 “春节经济” 来看中国的发展活力。今年春节前后，中国经济涌现出一批现象级的亮点。电影、冰雪、文旅等消费市场热点纷呈，展现了国内经济循环的巨大潜力。以 “杭州六小龙” 等初创企业为代表的科技突破不断涌现，展现了创新创造的巨大能量。绿色家电、新能源产业等绿色经济蔚然成风，展现了转型发展的巨大空间。不同领域的新动能不断积蓄壮大，必将为中国经济带来持久旺盛的发展动力。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 第二个视角：从全国两会来读懂中国的经济政...
contentList.remark: 第二个视角：从全国两会来读懂中国的经济政策。今年中国将经济增长目标设定为 5% 左右，既是源于对中国经济基础条件的深刻把握，也源于对自身治理能力和未来发展潜力的坚定信心。我们将注重加大政策力度与激发市场力量相结合，努力实现这一预期目标。一方面实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，进一步加大逆周期调节力度，必要时推出新的增量政策，为经济持续向好、平稳运行提供有力支撑。另一方面深化经济体制改革，不断推进全国统一大市场建设，着力打通经济循环的堵点卡点，为各类经营主体进一步营造良好发展环境，强化对企业创新创造的政策支持，增强发展内在驱动力。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 第三个视角：从国际变局来思考世界发展进步...
contentList.remark:
第三个视角：从国际变局来思考世界发展进步的人间正道。
当今世界经济碎片化加剧，不稳定不确定性上升，更需要国家开放市场、企业共享资源，携手抵御风险挑战、实现共同繁荣。中国始终把自身发展同全球发展紧密结合在一起，将坚持经济全球化正确方向，践行真正的多边主义，努力做全球和平发展事业的稳定性、确定性力量。我们将坚定不移推进开放合作，倡导国际通行规则下的公平竞争，维护自由贸易和全球产业链供应链畅通稳定，继续敞开怀抱欢迎各国企业，进一步扩大市场准入，积极解决企业关切，帮助外资企业深度融入中国市场。希望企业家们做全球化的坚定维护者、推动者，齐心协力、精诚合作，抵制单边主义和保护主义，在互利互惠中实现更大发展。

2025 全国家电消费季启动仪式 22 日在上海举行。启动仪式上，商务部发布的数据显示，在消费品以旧换新政策拉动下，2024 年 8 月至今，消费者购买以旧换新家电产品近 9000 万台。今年以来，以旧换新政策实现跨年度无缝对接，截至目前，共有 2020.8 万名消费者购买 12 大类家电产品 2757.2 万台，带动销售 930.8 亿元。

contentList.remark:
国家发展改革委副主任赵辰昕表示，2024年，中国
经济实力、科技实力、综合国力持续增强，中国式现代
化迈出新的坚实步伐。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 创新活力持续激发，新旧动能转换加快。中国...
contentList.remark: 创新活力持续激发，新旧动能转换加快。中国因地制宜发展新质生产力，为高质量发展提供源源不断的新动能。一方面，支持全面创新的基础制度加快健全，重大科技基础设施体系化建设不断推进，另一方面，创新驱动发展成效持续显现，传统产业加快升级，新兴产业加快发展，未来产业加快布局。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 协调发展扎实推进，空间格局更趋优化。深入...
contentList.remark:
协调发展扎实推进，空间格局更趋优化。深入实施
区域协调发展战略、乡村振兴战略、新型城镇化战略，
城乡区域协调发展不断扎实推进。京津冀、长三角、粤
港澳大湾区引领带动作用进一步增强。第二轮乡村全面
振兴规划印发实施，脱贫攻坚成果巩固拓展，以工代赈
吸纳务工就业超300万人次。

contentList.remark: 绿色低碳转型加快，发展底色更加鲜明。协同推进降碳减污扩绿增长取得新的积极成效。出台加快经济社会发展全面绿色转型的意见，深入实施全面节约战略。扎实推进碳达峰碳中和，加快实施重要生态系统保护和修复重大工程，出台施行生态保护补偿条例，深入打好蓝天、碧水、净土保卫战。

部署加快落地见效，特别是去年9月26日中央政治局会
议部署实施一揽子增量政策后，市场预期有效提振，经
济运行明显回升。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 推进对外开放方面，赵辰昕表示，体制机制上...
contentList.remark:
推进对外开放方面，赵辰昕表示，体制机制上，将稳
步扩大制度型开放，深化外商投资促进体制机制改革，采
取有效措施鼓励外资企业境内再投资。稳步推进服务业
开放，推动扩大电信、医疗、教育等领域开放试点。政策引
导上，将修订扩大鼓励外商投资产业目录，加快推进海
南自由贸易港封关准备工作。服务保障上，将适时推出
新一批重大外资项目，协调解决项目落地涉及的用地、
用海、环评、能耗等问题；健全境外投资管理、服务、
监管和风险防控体系，加强境外投资促进和保障。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 与此同时，发展质量持续提高。就业形势总体...
contentList.remark: 与此同时，发展质量持续提高。就业形势总体平稳，去年前11个月城镇新增就业1198万人，同比多增18万人。教育、医疗、体育等公共服务设施加快补齐，“一老一小”服务体系更加完善。安全发展基础巩固夯实，粮食产量再创历史新高，煤电油气供应保障有力。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 月，规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.4%，...
contentList.remark:
月，规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.4%，增速比上月快
0.1个百分点。服务业较快增长，11月服务业生产指数同
比增长6.1%。企业预期有所改善，12月制造业采购经理指
数（PMI）为50.1%，连续3个月保持扩张态势。另一方面，
发展新动能不断壮大。产业加快转型升级，11月高技术
制造业、装备制造业增加值同比分别增长7.8%、7.6%，
均快于全部规模以上工业增速。新产品增速较快，11月
工业机器人、新能源汽车产量分别增长29.3%、51.1%。

域向经营主体公平开放，特别是向民营企业公平开放。

市定日县发生6.8级地震，造成重大人员伤亡。要全力
开展人员搜救，全力救治受伤人员，最大限度减少人员
伤亡，防止发生次生灾害，妥善安置受灾群众，做好善

保安全温暖过冬。

险救援，并加强震情监测，防范各类次生灾害，尽最大
努力减少伤亡。地震灾区位于高原高寒地区，正值冬
季，要千方百计保障灾区群众基本生活和温暖过冬。

contentList.remark: 国家京剧院是文化和旅游部直属国家艺术院团，前身为1955年1月成立的中国京剧院，梅兰芳担任首任院长，2007年更名为国家京剧院。近日，国家京剧院全体青年艺术工作者给习总书记写信，汇报传承京剧艺术相关情况，表达为繁荣发展京剧事业、弘扬中华优秀传统文化而奋斗的决心。

名家优良传统，践行艺术为民，坚持崇德尚艺、守正创
新，让京剧艺术持续焕发时代光彩，为繁荣文艺事业、
建设文化强国贡献力量”。

contentList.remark: 习近平总书记的关怀和希望，极大激励了全国戏剧工作者。大家表示，要赓续中华文脉，创作文艺精品，不断壮大戏剧人才队伍，努力推动中国戏剧事业繁荣发展，更好担负起新时代的文化使命。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “这封回信是勉励、是期望，更是一束光，照...
contentList.remark:
“这封回信是勉励、是期望，更是一束光，照亮了
我们前进的道路。”编剧陈卓是给习近平总书记写信的
青年艺术工作者之一。她说，要按照总书记要求，向前
辈大师学习，向古今中外经典名作学习，从源远流长的
传统文化与热火朝天的现实生活中汲取营养，做“扎根
人民、扎根生活”的艺术家。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 国家京剧院前身为1955年1月成立的中国...
contentList.remark: 国家京剧院前身为1955年1月成立的中国京剧院，梅兰芳担任首任院长，2007年更名为国家京剧院。剧院汇集了李少春、袁世海、叶盛兰、杜近芳、翁偶虹、阿甲等艺术家，创编上演了《杨门女将》《野猪林》《白蛇传》《满江红》《大闹天宫》《文姬归汉》等600多部优秀剧目。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 年过八旬的表演艺术家刘长瑜已为剧院工作6...
contentList.remark:
年过八旬的表演艺术家刘长瑜已为剧院工作63年。
习近平总书记的回信让她心潮澎湃：“剧院成立至今，几
代演职员用心血和汗水铸就了鲜明的艺术风格，为传承
民族艺术、弘扬民族精神作出了贡献。我将不负总书记
期待，做好传帮带，做一支蜡烛，为青年人照亮灿烂长路。”

contentList.fullName: text: 中国艺术研究院戏曲研究所所长王馗表示，习...

总书记在回信中提到的“崇德尚艺”，为戏曲工作者指
明了立身为艺的方向。

创作风格的传承，更包括张扬中国精神、中国气派的戏
曲理想的传承。这是国家京剧院70年传承发展的启示。”
王馗说，一代代青年也要沿着前辈师者的道路一步步成
为爱国为民的艺术工作者。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 习近平总书记在回信中强调“艺术为民”，是...

家京剧院艺术工作者的肯定与关怀，也是对每一位戏剧
工作者的殷切嘱托。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “我们要坚持以人民为中心的创作导向，加强...
contentList.remark:
“我们要坚持以人民为中心的创作导向，加强自身
素质，提高艺术水平，以创作为核心任务，以演出为中
心环节，推出更多有质量、有温度的艺术作品。”昆曲
艺术家杨凤一说。

contentList.remark: 文化和旅游部艺术司一级巡视员周汉萍说，文化和旅游部实施新时代现实题材创作工程等项目，引导广大文艺工作者深入生活扎根人民，把人民作为艺术表现的主体，从人民和生活中汲取艺术灵感，以精品奉献人民。

contentList.fullName: text: 坚持守正创新，是增强戏剧艺术生产原创能力...

contentList.remark: 乐声悠扬、水袖轻扬，浙江小百花越剧院的演员们正紧张排演。这部即将在春节前首演的越剧《我的大观园》取材于《红楼梦》，将传统艺术与现代审美相结合，力求吸引更多年轻观众。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 院长王滨梅说：“我们要在新起点上践行总书...
contentList.remark: 院长王滨梅说：“我们要在新起点上践行总书记‘守正创新’的要求，创新创作双轨推进，深化新空间演艺，做好拔尖人才培养和人才梯队建设，为越剧事业发展注入源源不断的活力与动能。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “从总书记的回信中，我们深刻领悟到戏剧工...
contentList.remark:
“从总书记的回信中，我们深刻领悟到戏剧工作者
必须承担的历史责任。”中国儿童艺术剧院院长冯俐说，
要继续推进中华优秀传统文化创造性转化、创新性发
展，创作更多类似于《中国故事之成语魔方》《猫神在
故宫》的创新作品，在孩子们心中播下真善美的种子。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 国家京剧院院长王勇说：“总书记的回信充分...
contentList.remark: 国家京剧院院长王勇说：“总书记的回信充分肯定了70年来国家京剧院取得的发展成就，为剧院奋进新征程、建功新时代指明前进方向。我们要进一步筑牢青年成长平台，让每一个有梦想的年轻人做主角；加强对传统文化的挖掘和阐释，推动传统艺术生命更新，在戏剧舞台上绽放中华文化的生机活力。”

contentList.remark: Tuberculosis (TB) spreads through the air from one person to another.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • TB germs spread when a person with infectious TB disease coughs, speaks, or sings.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • TB germs usually attack the lungs but can also move to any part of the body.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: TB germs can live in...
contentList.remark: TB germs can live in the body without making you sick.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This is called latent TB infection or inactive TB.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • TB germs can live in your body for years without causing symptoms. Without treatment, inactive TB can develop into active TB disease and make you sick.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • If you have inactive TB, you can take TB medicine to prevent the development of active TB disease even if you do not feel sick.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
If your body cannot stop TB
germs from growing, you
develop active TB disease.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • You may feel sick and spread TB germs to your family, friends, and others around you.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: • You need to take a...
contentList.remark: • You need to take and finish all your TB medicine to help you feel better and prevent other people from getting sick.

contentList.remark:
Cognitive
Dissonance:
Performing
Menial Tasks

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Study conducted by Jonas Festinger, Marcus Carlsmith & Gabriel Chessman

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: REFERENCES:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Walsh, Karen., Kemputo, Odelle., "The psychology of self-deception" The Anaptic Journal, 2017 • Satuda, Evelyn., Temitope, Anya., "Neuroscience of Decision-Making" The Science Review, 2018 • Brahms, Hansen., Leigh, Anderson., "The Need and Neurology for Happiness", The Arch Journal, 2020

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Purpose:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Festinger, Carlsmith and Chessman wanted to understand if making people perform a menial task would result in cognitive dissonance as a result of forced compliance behavior.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Participants:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In a lab setting, 71 male students as participants to perform a series of menial tasks (like turning pegs in a peg board for an hour).

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Results:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: When the participants were asked to evaluate the experiment, the participants who were paid only $1 rated the tedious task as more fun and enjoyable than the participants who were paid $20 to lie.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Hypothesis:

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: When asked to do an ...
contentList.remark: When asked to do an unenjoyable task, people will not readily admit as much, and tell themselves and others it is actually enjoyable.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Method:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The participants were then paid either $1 or $20 to tell a waiting participant (a test confederate) that the tasks were really engaging and fun. Almost all of the participants agreed to walk into the waiting room and persuade the confederate that the boring experiment would be interesting.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Conclusion:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Getting paid $1 is not sufficient for lying, so those who were paid $1 experienced dissonance. These participants could only overcome that dissonance by coming to believe that the tasks really were interesting and enjoyable.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Being paid $20 provides a reason, therefore there is no dissonance.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Wir sind da.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 55 527 Menschen in der Bundesrepublik sind HIV-infiziert, 15,4 Prozent davon sind Frauen, Frauen, die zu einer der gefährdeten Gruppen gehören oder Frauen, die als "ganz normal" gelten.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wir werden in jeder Statistik registriert, aber nicht im täglichen Leben. Wir haben uns beim Fixen angesteckt, beim Sex mit einem Mann. Einige von uns wurden über Bluttransfusionen infiziert.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Alle Menschen leben mit dem Risiko der Infektion. Nicht nur Homosexuelle und Fixer(innen). Die Zahl der infizierten Frauen steigt stetig. Beim ungeschützten Sex ist unser Ansteckungsrisiko um ein Vielfaches höher als bei Männern.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Wir sind unbeschreiblich.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Wir sind zwischen 20 und 40 Jahre alt - manche älter, wenige jünger.
Wir sind alternativ oder konservativ.
Geschäftsfrauen oder Hausfrauen.
Wir leben allein oder in einer Gemeinschaft.
Wir sind Frauen, die geme "bemuttern".
Frauen, die ihren "Mann" stehen.
Viele kommen aus der Stadt, einige leben auf dem Land.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Keine ist wie die an...
contentList.remark:
Keine ist wie die andere.
Aber eines haben wir gemeinsam:
Wir sind weiblich und positiv.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Wir schweigen uns zu Tode.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Wir sind immer für a...
contentList.remark:
Wir sind immer für andere da.
Aber es fällt uns schwer, für uns selbst da zu sein,
Erwartungen zu äußern, Ansprüche zu stellen.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Wir melden uns selten zu Wort.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Unsere Ohnmacht und Hilflosigkeit bleibt den meisten Menschen verborgen. Die Angst vor möglichen Leiden und die Konfrontation mit dem Tod, der Gedanke, früher zu sterben als unsere Kinder, die Einschränkung unserer Sexualität, das Gefühl, schuldig zu sein – das alles macht uns ohnmächtig, hilflos, sprachlos.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wir haben Angst vor Ablehnung und Ausgrenzung. Wir bleiben allein.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Auch mit unserer Wut - die Wut auf den Partner, die Freunde, auf Ärzte, auf Behörden - auf uns selbst. Wir erwarten nicht, daß uns Infizierte noch irgend jemand unterstützt oder gar liebt. Wir schweigen.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Schweigen macht krank, noch ehe der Virus zur Krankheit führt.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Wir haben jede Menge Leben.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Von der Infektion bis zum Ausbruch der Krankheit vergehen meist viele Jahre, Jahre der Auseinandersetzung mit dem Positivsein und der Hoffnung auf ein wirksames Medikament. Mit dem Gedanken an den Tod.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Aber vor allen Dingen vergehen Lebensjahre.
Das Leben aller Menschen ist endlich. Wir müssen lernen, das Ende zu akzeptieren. Aber vor allen Dingen müssen wir sehen, daß noch jede Menge Leben auf uns wartet.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Sterben können wir immer noch.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wir müssen entscheiden, auf welche Weise wir unser Leben gestalten wollen. Wir müssen prüfen, wem wir uns anvertrauen, welche Behandlung die richtige für uns ist, wer uns beraten kann und wo es Unterstützung gibt. Wir müssen unsere Rechte auf Arbeit und Wohnung wahrnehmen und lemen, mit Intoleranz und Unverständnis umzugehen.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wir müssen unser Leben in die Hand nehmen. Und das nicht nur in Sachen Aids.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Der erste Schnitt ist schwer. Es tut weh, wenn wir endlich über unsere Infektion sprechen und unser Umfeld mit Abwehr reagiert. Wenn unser soziales Netz nicht mehr tragfähig ist, wir um unsere Beziehungen, unsere Arbeit und unsere Wohnung kämpfen müssen.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: Aber es tut auch gut...
contentList.remark: Aber es tut auch gut.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Keine, die aus ihrer Isolation herausgetreten ist, hat diesen Schritt bereut.
Über unsere Lebenssituation reden zu können bedeutet auch, Mitgefühl
und Hilfe anzunehmen.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Für schwule Männer und Fixer gibt es viele Angebote. Für uns erst wenige.
Wir brauchen zusätzliche Informationen und spezielle Beratungen, weil wir
anders leben und fühlen als Männer. Wir wollen auf eine uns gemäße
Weise angesprochen werden. Unsere Erfahrungen und Bedürfnisse sind -
weiblich.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wir brauchen geschützte Räume und eine Lobby, die unsere Interessen nach außen vertritt.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Gemeinsam können wir uns eine Chance geben.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Research Objective:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Activation of the medical emergency services system begins with a call to 911. Performance on call receivers can directly impact patient safety, especially for life threatening emergencies such as cardiac arrest  $ (1) $ . New technologies, such as cell phone texting to 911 (text2911), automobile crash notification (OnStar), pre-registration of household emergency information (Smart911) and ability to send videos of an incident (Visuals), are being implemented across the country as part of the Next Generation 9-1-1 (NG911) initiative. NG911 technologies provide additional or alternative avenues other than voice for contacting 911.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Study Design:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A cross-sectional survey that included questions on the perceived impact of new technologies on call receiver performance, responder safety and patient safety was administered as part of a longitudinal study. Survey items (using a 7 point Likert-type scale) included questions regarding the perceptions of 911 employees on the impact of the technologies on: the quality and usefulness of the information in a call; time it takes to process a call; quality of job performance; and helpfulness of each technology for decision making, ability to convey pre-arrival instruction, ability to protect the safety of responders and ability to protect safety of the public.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Population Studied:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Emergency call center employees (n=165) from 23 call centers across the United States.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Principal Findings:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The impact of text2911 on performance was uniformly perceived more negatively than Onstar, Smart911 or Visuals (table 1).

contentList.remark: Presentation Title: DLC-1 tumor suppressor gene induces apoptosis in human non-small cell lung carcinoma cells following a unique process of cell morphological changes and protein nuclear translocation

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Presentation Monday, Apr 03, 2006, 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Location: Exhibit Hall, Washington Convention Center

contentList.name: text

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Poster Board Number: 27

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Author Block: Bao-Zhu Yuan, Amy M. Jefferson, Lyndell Millecchia, Steven H. Reynolds. National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health, Morgantown, WV

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The deleted in liver cancer (DLC-1) gene is a recently identified tumor suppressor gene for human non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC). It can inhibit the growth and induce morphological changes of NSCLC cells in gene transfection studies. To explore the association between morphological change and DLC-1's tumor suppression function, we performed a further investigation utilizing gene transfection with a green fluorescent protein (GFP)-fused DLC-1 cDNA and laser scanning confocal microscopy. New studies revealed that DLC-1 transfection can initially induce multiple branched cytoplasmic extensions, which are followed by membrane blebbing along the cytoplasmic extensions and progressive cell shrinkage, and ended with cytoplasmic and nuclear decomposition, the morphological evidence of cell apoptosis. The process of morphological change is associated with RhoGAP-domain-related reduction of stress fibers and filopodia early in gene transfection and with collapsing of the actin cytoskeleton at the time of cell apoptosis. DLC-1's ability to induce tumor cell apoptosis is supported by the induction of caspase 3 activation in DLC-1-transfected cells following the morphological changes. Furthermore, the apoptosis is accompanied by DLC-1 protein nuclear translocation, which depends on a nuclear localization sequence (NLS). Gene deletion and NLS point mutation analyses suggest that DLC-1 can exert its tumor suppression function in both the cytoplasm and nucleus. However, the induction of cell apoptosis is more dependent on DLC-1 protein nuclear translocation, which could be retarded by active RhoA signaling. This study revealed several new features about DLC-1 which are important for understanding DLC-1's tumor suppression functions.

Daily Aspirin Therapy Does Not Increase Body Core Temperature Responses in Firefighters During Exertion in Thermal Protective Clothing
Serina J. McEntire, Steven E. Reis, Diane Comer, Charity G. Moore, Riana R. Pryor, Jennifer Erin, Priya Khorana, Joe Suyama, Francis X. Guyette, David Hostler.
University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, PA. (Sponsor: Robert Robertson, PhD, FACSM)
(No relationships reported)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Heart attack is the most common cause of line-of-duty deaths in the fire service. Daily aspirin therapy is a common preventative measure used to reduce the morbidity of heart attacks in the general population. However, the mechanism of aspirin can hypothetically impair thermoregulation and anecdotal reports have suggested aspirin use increases the risk of heat illness. In spite of these observations, the safety profile of aspirin during uncompensable heat stress has not been well described.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: PURPOSE: Determine if fourteen days of daily aspirin therapy (81mg PO) alters body core temperature responses during exertion in the heat while wearing thermal protective clothing (TPC).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: METHODS: In this double-blind, placebo controlled study, 102 firefighters were randomized to receive either 14 days of aspirin ($N=54$) or a placebo ($N=48$) prior to completing a 50 minute bout of treadmill exercise in the heat ($38.9\pm1.1^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$; $24\pm7\%$ RH) while wearing TPC and self-contained breathing apparatus. Heart rate, weighted mean skin temperature, and body core temperature were monitored throughout the 50 minutes of exercise.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: RESULTS: There were no differences in age, height, mass, BMI, or $VO_{2}$ max between groups. Heart rate at the end of exercise did not differ between aspirin and placebo groups ($174\pm17$ vs. $171\pm17$ bpm, respectively). In the aspirin group, baseline core body temperature was $37.1\pm0.3^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, which was similar to the placebo group ($37.2\pm0.5^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$; $p=0.55$). Maximal body core temperature was $38.7\pm0.5^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the aspirin group and $38.6\pm0.5^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the placebo group ($p=0.39$). The percent change in core temperature from baseline was $4.3\pm1.2\%$ in the aspirin group and $3.9\pm1.6\%$ in the placebo group ($p=0.20$). Upon completion of exercise, maximal weighted skin temperature was $38.3\pm0.5^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the aspirin group and $38.1\pm0.6^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the placebo groups. Skin temperature rose $12.5\pm2.3\%$ from baseline in the aspirin group and $12.2\pm2.6\%$ with the placebo ($p=0.55$).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: CONCLUSIONS: Fourteen days of aspirin therapy does not alter temperature responses among firefighters performing exertion in the heat.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Physiological and Thermoregulatory Responses to Wearing N95 Filtering Facepiece Respirators

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Jung-Hyun Kim, Raymond J. Roberge, Stacey M. Benson. CDC/NIOSH/NPPTL, Pittsburgh, PA.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: (No relationships reported)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The use of filtering facepiece respirators (FFR) has increased enormously in both public and occupational sectors for respiratory protection from infectious airborne particles. The N95 class of FFR, which filters out at least 95% of airborne particles  $ >0.3\ \mu m $ , is the most common type of FFR; however, there has been a lack of scientific information on physiological and thermal burdens of wearing N95 FFR.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: PURPOSE: To investigate physiological and thermoregulatory responses to wearing N95 FFRs while performing low-moderate intensity exercise.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: METHODS: Twenty healthy subjects (13 men, 7 women), who passed a physical examination and a respirator quantitative fit test, performed three trials of treadmill exercise (5.6 km/h, 0% grade, 60 min duration) in a thermoneutral environment (21.4±0.7°C, 23.5±7.9%) while wearing two popular styles (cup-shaped and flat fold) of N95 FFR or not wearing FFR for control (CON). Study variables included core body temperature ( $ T_{co} $ ), skin temperature at the cheek ( $ T_{cheek} $ ) and abdomen ( $ T_{abdomen} $ ), heart rate (HR), respiratory rate (RR), transcutaneous carbon dioxide ( $ tcPCO_{2} $ ), and oxygen saturation ( $ SpO_{2} $ ). Deadspace microclimate temperature and humidity were also measured in FFR trials. Data were analyzed by two-way (Trials × Time) repeated measures ANOVA.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: RESULTS:  $ T_{co} $ ,  $ T_{cheek} $ , and  $ T_{abdomen} $  rose significantly by time in all trials (p<0.001) and the final deadspace microclimate temperature and humidity reached up to 33°C and 90%, respectively. However, there was no statistical difference in these temperature variables between CON and the FFR trials. HR and RR increased significantly by time in all trials (p<0.001), but at a greater rate in the FFR trials than in CON (HR; P<0.001, RR; P<0.01). There was no statistical difference in  $ SpO_{2} $  levels between CON and FFR trials, however,  $ tcPCO_{2} $  levels were significantly higher in the FFR trials than in CON (p<0.001).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: CONCLUSION: Wearing N95 FFR while performing low-moderate work for 60 min in a thermoneutral environment did not impose a significant thermal burden on the wearer. However, significantly elevated HR and RR in the FFR trials indicated that wearing N95 FFR may add additional metabolic demands. Also, breathing through N95 FFR did not interfere with  $ SpO_{2} $ , but caused some mild degree of  $ CO_{2} $  retention ( $ tcPCO_{2} \geq 45 mmHg $ ).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Increased Salivary Cortisol and State Anxiety Levels in Firefighter Candidates during Repeated Fire Suppression Tasks

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Deena Campbell $ ^{1} $ , Heather E. Webb $ ^{2} $ , Christopher J. Jackson $ ^{1} $ , Daniel Cross $ ^{3} $ .  $ ^{1} $ University of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia.  $ ^{2} $ Mississippi State University, Starkville, MS.  $ ^{3} $ Mississippi State Fire Academy, Jackson, MS.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: (No relationships reported)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Research suggests that the combined psychological and physiological stress load of firefighting may contribute to an exacerbated cortisol response during fire suppression.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to examine the salivary cortisol (SCORT) response in firefighter candidates during simulated fire suppression tasks.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: METHODS: Twelve firefighter candidates (age =  $ 25.25 \pm 5.69 $ ) participated in two research sessions, an informational session during which consent and demographic/psychometric data were obtained, and a second session in which the candidates completed two fire suppression evolutions. In each evolution, the participants entered the burn building in pairs and undertook fire suppression tasks. Baseline measures of SCORT and state anxiety (SAI) were collected immediately prior to each evolution, and collected again within 5 minutes of completion of each evolution.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: RESULTS: The fire suppression tasks resulted in elevated SCORT levels (when controlling for participant order) compared to baseline in both evolution 1 and 2 (t = 11.27, p = 0.004 and t = 44.07, p = 0.000 respectively). Anxiety levels also increased but did not reach significance in evolution 1, and increased significantly in evolution 2 (t = -2.66, p = 0.026).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that the candidates experienced both physical and psychological stress in both evolutions. Further, findings suggest that the experience of the first evolution did not reduce the psychological stress and the resultant physiological load of the second evolution.

contentList.remark: Review of Current Minimum Riding Weights in Australian Horse Racing - Implications for Jockey Health and Wellbeing

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Caron B. Jander $ ^{1} $ , David A. Greene $ ^{2} $ , Helen O'Connor $ ^{3} $ , Giles D. Warrington, FACSM $ ^{4} $ .  $ ^{1} $ Australian Racing Board, Freshwater, Australia.  $ ^{2} $ Australian Catholic University, Strathfield, NSW, Australia.  $ ^{3} $ University of Sydney, Lidcombe, NSW, Australia.  $ ^{4} $ Dublin City University, Dublin, Ireland. (No relationships reported)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Despite the international popularity of horse racing there is a dearth of population specific research available describing the physiological demands and health and lifestyle characteristics of jockeys. Given the weight-restricted nature of horse racing, jockeys often engage in extreme and unhealthy weight-loss practices, which are likely to place riders at an increased risk of injury. As a consequence, the Australian Racing Board (ARB) commissioned a scientific review of the minimum riding weight for flat jockeys.

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark:
Determination of the Interior Structure of Europa
from Gravity and Magnetic Data

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Flavio Petricca (JPL Postdoctoral Fellow, 322)
J. Castillo-Rogez (4000), S. Vance (322), M. Melwani Daswani (322), C. Cochrane (322)

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Background

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Galileo mission provided measurements of Europa's gravity and magnetic fields, indicating that the moon hosts a subsurface ocean and that its interior is mostly made by rocks (90 wt. %). However, the interior structure is still poorly understood, with the main uncertainties affecting the ice shell thickness and ocean depth, and the size of a putative metallic core whose existence was inferred from the first analysis of Galileo's gravity data (Anderson et al., 1998). A recent reanalysis indicated a smaller level of differentiation (Gomez-Casajus et al., 2021), challenging the inference of the existence of the metallic core. Knowledge of the degree of differentiation is crucial to understand the origins and evolution of Europa. Furthermore, gravity and magnetic data have only been used separately, and developing methodologies to jointly analyze them will be fundamental for Europa Clipper's investigations.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Objectives

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We analyze measurements of Europa’s gravity and magnetic fields based on Galileo data with new generation interior models and techniques to answer the following questions:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 1. Did Europa differentiate a metallic core? What is the composition of the rocky mantle?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 2. How can we combine gravity and magnetic data in an effective way to infer the ice thickness and ocean depth and salinity?

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Approach and Results

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We developed new interior models that use Bayesian inference and Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms to combine gravity and magnetic observations with geochemical data on the composition of the ocean and the rocky mantle. Our two main results are:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 1. Our models indicate that Europa did not differentiate a metallic core (Figure 1). This implies that Europa's evolution was colder than previously thought. The resulting structure and composition of the rocky mantle indicates that Europa and the Jupiter system likely formed from dry CV chondrite-like material.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 2. The combination of gravity and magnetic data can separately constrain the ice shell and ocean thicknesses, while separate inversions are degenerate (Figure 2).

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Significance of Results/Benefits to NASA/JPL

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The unprecedented constraint on the structure of the deep interior changes our understanding of the evolution of Europa. The lack of a metallic core indicates a cold evolution, with implications for the origin of the Jupiter system and the evolution of the other Galilean moons. The methodology developed to combine gravity and magnetic data will be fundamental in the context of Europa Clipper's interior science. This technique will provide a framework to connect interior models with the results of ongoing lab work at JPL (PSIE, PI: S. Vance). New experimental data on the thermodynamic and electric properties of solutions relevant to Europa's ocean are being collected and will be implemented in this interior modeling framework.

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Figure 1: metallic core radius resulting from the inversion of Europa’s gravity field measurements from the earlier analysis (Anderson et al., 1998; Panel A) and the more recent analysis (Gomez-Casajus et al., 2021; Panel B).

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Figure 2: Europa’s ice and ocean thicknesses derived from inversion of (A) gravity data only, (B) magnetic data only, (C) combination of gravity and magnetic data.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Future Work

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The framework developed will be expanded to include new experimental data in preparation for the analysis of Europa Clipper’s data. It will be also applied to Ganymede, Callisto and Titan to explore their interiors. Finally, ongoing work includes the application of this framework to the moons of Uranus in the context of the formulation of the Uranus Orbiter and Probe, highly prioritized by the Planetary Science Decadal Survey.

contentList.remark: Microwave Resonator Spectroscopy of Wafer-Scale Magnesium Diboride

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Author: Albert Wandui, JPL Postdoctoral Fellow (365H)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Jason Allmaras (365H), Jon Greenfield (365H), Matt Kenyon (365H), Cliff Frez (365K), Sahil Patel (365H), Daniel Shanks (365F), Matt Shaw (365H), Emma Wollman (365H), Daniel Cunnane (365H)

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Background and Scientific Goals

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our objective is to develop and mature wafer-scale thin-film Magnesium Diboride (MgB₂) enabling:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • High performance superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) operating above 4K.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Superconducting filters and detectors for astrophysics and remote sensing in the sub-mm to far-IR regime.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This requires an accurate model of the both the equilibrium and non-equilibrium superconductivity and quasiparticle dynamics in a two-gap superconductor with various degrees of disorder and interband interaction strength.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Approach and Results I: Resonator Measurements

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Extract the complex conductivity of films from measurements of the temperature (100 mK - 30 K), and frequency (100 MHz - 5 GHz) dependence of the resonance frequency and internal quality factor of $MgB_{2}$.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Why $MgB_{2}$?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Superconductivity in  $ MgB_{2} $  is mediated by the electron-phonon interaction. Uniquely among BCS superconductors, it exhibits:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • 2 interacting superconducting band gaps: a strongly coupled 2D $\pi$ band and a weakly coupled 3D $\sigma$ band.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • The resulting high superconducting transition temperature $T_{c}$ offers a compelling pathway for superconducting devices that operate at elevated temperatures or at higher frequencies.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: JPL has developed a process for wafer-scale $MgB_{2}$ with low roughness and high uniformity with $T_{c}$ of up to 31 K for bulk films and high kinetic inductance [1,2].

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Approach and Results II: Modeling 2 gap physics

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Obtain the temperature dependent gap energies $\Delta_{\pi}(T)$ and $\Delta_{\sigma}(T)$ and the band interaction parameters $V^{\pi\pi}, V^{\pi\sigma}, V^{\sigma\sigma}$.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: • To do so, we devel...
contentList.remark: • To do so, we developed a self-consistent approach to fitting the measured penetration depth using Eliashberg Theory.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: - Noise measurements shed light on the quasiparticle dynamics in the superconducting film.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Outlook

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Have developed a robust model of the 2-gap interaction in $MgB_{2}$ applicable to films over a wide thickness, sheet resistance and $T_{c}$ range.

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \sum_{\beta}\left(V_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}-N_{\alpha}\cdot\Pi_{\alpha}\cdot\delta_{\alpha\beta}\right)\cdot\Delta_{\beta}=0\quad\Pi_{\alpha}=\int\limits_{0}^{\omega_{c}}\mathrm{d}\xi\frac{\tanh[\beta\sqrt{\xi^{2}+|\Delta_{\alpha}|^{2}}/2]}{\sqrt{\xi^{2}+|\Delta_{\alpha}|^{2}}} $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Currently incorporating data from critical field measurements to constrain the total DOS.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Film-to-film comparisons can now inform fabrication and further work on modeling detector response.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Using 3 fit parameters: ratio of the DOS, ratio of the gap energies at $T=0$, and fraction of conductivity from the $\pi$ band, we accurately reproduce both the penetration depth and the dissipation as a function of temperature [3].

contentList.remark: Global Significance of Serpentine on Mars

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark:
Author: A. Emran (3223 JPL Postdoctoral Fellow)
J. D. Tarnas (Blue); and K. M. Stack (3223)

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: INTRODUCTION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Serpentine is an astrobiologically compelling mineral on Mars. H₂ and CH₄ (in presence of CO₂) are produced during its production via the oxidation of olivine and pyroxene (mafic and ultra-mafic rocks) by water [1]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Chemolithotrophic microbial communities rely on  $ H_{2} $  and  $ CH_{4} $  nutrient sources [2]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
□ Serpentine has characteristic absorption bands at 1.38, 2.12, 2.32, and 2.52 μm at near infrared wavelengths [3]
❖ 2.12 μm is the most characteristic band for a unique identification (Fig. 1)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Identifying serpentine on Mars using I/F data from the Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM) is challenging due to the presence of an artifact in the images [4]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Requires a validation of 2.12 µm band in radiance data – called radiance ratio technique [4] (Fig. 2)

contentList.name: vision_footnote
contentList.remark: Fig. 1: Laboratory spectra of serpentine, dolomite, and Mg-rich chlorite (RELAB database [5]).

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Fig. 2: Example of a false positive serpentine detection on Mars using CRISM data. (a) Location of serpentine claimed pixels. (b) Spectra showing the presence of  $ 2.12 \mu m $  feature in the I/F data but absent in the radiance spectrum [6].

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: RESULTS

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: OBJECTIVE

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Create an updated global map of serpentine for Mars using CRISM images

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: ✓ validated with both I/F and radiance data

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
□ Geologic context and mineral assemblage associated with serpentine
□ Timing and amount (approx.) of  $ H_{2} $  produced via serpentinization on Mars
□ Extend of serpentinization on the surface and subsurface

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: METHODOLOGY

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: ■ Uses all TRDR records viz. 7885 Full Resolution Targeted (FRT), 2785 Half Resolution Long (HRL), 3738 Full Resolution Short (FRS), 1352 Half Resolution Short (HRS)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Covers 90° N to 90° S latitudes ($\sim 1.2\%$ of Martian surface)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Atmospherically and photometrically corrected using the standard CRISM processing pipeline including volcano-scan calibration [7]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Apply dynamic aperture factor analysis/target transformation (DAFA/TT) [6] to the calibrated CRISM images

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ I/F and radiance ratio spectra from the DAFA/TT detected pixels

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Detections are assigned to confidence values—1 (low/weak) to 5 (high/best)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Geologic context using CTX and THEMIS-IR daytime mosaics [8-9]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Age of serpentine host unit [10] and associated minerals from CRISM

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Influence of dust in surface detection using dust cover index map [11]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Amount of $H_{2}$ produced using the rates from analogue rocks [12]

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Fig. 3: Global distribution of serpentine on Mars overlain on the TES dust cover map on MOLA global mosaic [12]. Serpentine detections are color-coded according to confidence level. Upper left inset shows number of images investigated in  $ 30^{\circ} $  longitudinal bin.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: ## Key findings ##

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Detected in 43 CRISM images, with detections in 32 of the images representing “new” or previously unrecognized detections

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Occurrence between 40°N to 40°S latitudes, and no detections between 90°E to 180°E longitudes

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
□ Formation in a wide variety of landforms (craters, valleys, and plains)
□ 31 out of 43 detected images on Noachian-aged surface units

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
□ Younger detections are associated with impact craters—possibility that serpentine formed earlier at depth, and was subsequently excavated
□ Serpentine detections correspond with lower average dust cover

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
□ Often occurs near olivine, low-Ca pyroxene, clays, and carbonate minerals
□ Mg-rich serpentine detections cover a total surface area of $\sim 1.46\,\mathrm{km}^{2}$
□ Estimated max. production (~10 km) of $5.11 \times 10^{11}$ and $4.85 \times 10^{13}\,\mathrm{mol}\,H_{2}$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Only 11 CRISM images previously thought to contain serpentine [13] could be validated for the presence of the mineral using the radiance ratio technique

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Most serpentine deposits identified here occur in Noachian-aged terrains implying that serpentinization occurred predominantly early in Mars' history

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
☐ Although it occurs in a wide variety of landscapes, the detection of serpentine in craters raises the possibility that impact-induced hydrothermal serpentinization was an important process for serpentine formation

☐ Although serpentinization is favored thermodynamically in mafic/ultramafic rocks on the surface and in the subsurface [14-15], Mg-serpentine deposits was found to be generally rare and of relatively limited areal extent

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: □ Reasons for the apparent paucity of serpentine on Mars could include:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: a). Limitations of orbiter sensor capability and the impact of dust and/or sub-pixel mixing

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: b). Inability to uniquely detect Fe-rich serpentine on Mars [16]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: c). CRISM data covers only $\sim 1.2\%$ of the Martian surface

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: d). Serpentine may once have formed extensively on early Mars, but has subsequently weathered and altered to clay minerals and carbonates

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: e). Serpentinization occurred primarily in the subsurface and is observable only when excavated by impact cratering or other tectonic processes

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Hu Ge $ ^{1} $ , Jordan Douglas $ ^{2} $ , Remco Bouckaert $ ^{2} $

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
(1) School of Biological Sciences, University of Auckland, Auckland 1010, New Zealand  
(2) School of Computer Science, University of Auckland, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Introduction

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A novel Parallelised Bayesian Inference of the Multispecies Coalescent with new MCMC proposals has been implemented in the open-source BEAST 2 platform as the StarBeast3 package. This new approach avoids biases, such as being an inconsistent estimator of the tree topology. Furthermore, it explores the state space much more efficiently, allowing the handle of data sets one and a half orders of magnitude larger than StarBeast2 and more than two orders faster than *BEAST*.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Our goal was to esta...
contentList.remark: Our goal was to establish the correct implementation of StarBeast3 by testing different numbers of taxa and genes.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Key words: multispecies coalescent; BEAST 2; phylogenetics; bayesian inference; high performance; adaptive; parallelisation.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Methods

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: We performed well calibration studies by simulating alignments using parameters directly sampled from the prior distribution, and then we inferred the posterior estimates of these parameters using StarBeast3 (Figure 1).

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Figure 1. Pipeline of 5 steps implemented by Experimenter package in BEAST 2 that assists in simulation studies to verify correctness of the implementation. (1) Set up XML for desired model and sample from prior. (2) Generate (MCMC) analysis for each of the samples (support for multiple alignments). (3) Run the analyses using StarBeast3 package in BEAST2. (4) Use loganalyser to summarise trace files. (5) Run CoverageCalculator to summarise coverage of parameters. Source: https://github.com/rbouckaert/DeveloperManual.git

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We evaluated a strict and relaxed clock model, across varying tree sizes (4 species: 12 taxa; 16 species: 48 taxa), and multiple genes (10, 50, 100, and 200). With 100 independent runs, we estimated the coverage of the true value by the 95% highest probability density (HPD) estimates for various parameters in the model (Figure 2) and its newly developed efficient MCMC operators.

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Figure 2. Simulated species trees S with n = 16 species with k = 100 gene trees embedded. Parameters in the multispecies coalescent model are indicated in the figure: Node heights (time) are shown on the y-axis, and effective population sizes are on the x-axis. Species tree branch rates are indicated by line thickness. Colors show Gen trees. The tree was built from a Direct simulator in BEAST2 and visualized using UglyTrees (Douglas, 2020).

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Results

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Well-calibrated simulation study analysing nS = 16 species, nG = 48 taxa, and k = 50 genes. One hundred simulations were performed to recover the coverage between “true” simulated values and their estimates under the posterior distribution. Vertical lines represent 95% highest posterior density (HPD) intervals of parameters. Each line represents a single simulation and is colored blue when the true value was contained within the 95% interval, or red otherwise. The top of each plot shows the coverage of each parameter (i.e., the number of MCMC simulations for which the “true” parameter value was contained within the 95% HPD). This result was coherent when we tested 100 and 200 genes, respectively.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Conclusion

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our results show all coverage observed is in the expected range, from 90 to 99 inclusive, suggesting the correct implementation of StarBeast3 for all experiments performed. Furthermore, these experiments evidence that startbeast3 is suitable for multispecies

contentList.remark: EXPLORING THE EFFECT OF TEMPERATURE ON ENZYME ACTIVITY IN PLANT CELLS

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: · Alex G.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: · Monica V.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: · Tessa H.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: · Aiko S.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: · Bill T.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: INTRODUCTION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Enzymes are essential biological catalysts that regulate chemical reactions within cells. This study investigates how temperature influences enzyme activity in plant cells, specifically focusing on amylase, an enzyme that catalyzes the breakdown of starch. Understanding the relationship between temperature and enzyme activity can help optimize agricultural practices, such as enhancing crop resistance to temperature fluctuations and improving the efficiency of industrial processes that involve plant-based enzymes.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: METHODOLOGY

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: SAMPLE PREPARATION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Corn leaf cells were isolated and homogenized to extract amylase enzymes. The enzyme activity was measured by the rate of starch breakdown.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: TEMPERATURE VARIATION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Enzyme activity was tested at  $ 0^{\circ} $ C,  $ 20^{\circ} $ C,  $ 40^{\circ} $ C,  $ 60^{\circ} $ C, and  $ 80^{\circ} $ C. Reactions were incubated for 30 minutes at each temperature.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: SUBSTRATE ADDITION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Starch solution was added to each reaction, providing a substrate for the amylase enzyme.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: REACTION TERMINATION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The reactions were stopped after 30 minutes using an enzyme inhibitor, and glucose production was measured.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: DATA ANALYSIS

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Absorbance of glucose was measured using a spectrophotometer. Data were analyzed using ANOVA to assess statistical significance of temperature on enzyme activity.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: RESULTS

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: OPTIMAL TEMPERATURE

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Enzyme activity peaked at  $ 40^{\circ} $ C, where the amylase was most effective in catalyzing starch breakdown. At this temperature, the rate of glucose production was 50% higher than at lower or higher temperatures.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: TEMPERATURE EFFECT

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - At 0°C, enzyme activity was minimal, with only 10% of the maximum activity observed at 40°C

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - At 20°C, enzyme activity was moderate, with a 30% increase in glucose production compared to 0°C

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - At 60°C, enzyme activity dropped significantly, with only 25% of the activity seen at 40°C

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - At 80°C, enzyme activity was nearly zero, indicating enzyme denaturation

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: TEMPERATURE EFFECT

contentList.name: table
contentList.remark:

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: DISCUSSION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The results suggest that temperature has a profound impact on enzyme activity, with amylase being most efficient at  $ 40^{\circ} $ C. The significant decline in activity at temperatures above  $ 60^{\circ} $ C supports the hypothesis that extreme heat denatures enzymes. This has implications for both agricultural biotechnology, where temperature resilience could be engineered, and for industrial enzyme applications, where optimal reaction conditions are critical for efficiency.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: CONCLUSION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Amylase activity in plant cells is highly temperature-dependent, with an optimal temperature of 40°C for maximum efficiency. Understanding the temperature sensitivity of enzymes can help improve crop productivity under varying environmental conditions and optimize industrial enzyme processes.

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: Investigating the Impact of Magnetic Field on the Superconductivity of High-Temperature Ceramics

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Dr. Alice Green, Dr. Patrick Green, Leslie Thomas, Diego Ruiz

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Introduction

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Superconductivity is a state of zero electrical resistance occurring at low temperatures in certain materials. High-temperature superconductors (HTS), such as yttrium barium copper oxide (YBCO), exhibit superconductivity above the boiling point of liquid nitrogen. This study explores how varying magnetic fields affect the superconducting properties of YBCO ceramics, providing insight into their practical applications in energy transmission and magnetic levitation.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Methodology

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We synthesized YBCO ceramic samples with varying compositions of yttrium (Y), barium (Ba), copper (Cu), and oxygen (O). Using a cryostat, we cooled the samples to temperatures ranging from 77 K to 90 K. Magnetic fields ranging from 0 to 5 Tesla were applied perpendicularly and parallel to the sample surface. The critical temperature was determined by measuring the resistivity of the samples as a function of temperature in the presence of the magnetic field. The data were analyzed to find the values of Tc and Hc2.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Results

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The superconducting transition temperature decreased as the magnetic field increased

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The rate of decrease was more pronounced for higher magnetic field strengths

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The upper critical field for YBCO was found to be 4.8 Tesla when the field was applied

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: When the magnetic field was applied perpendicular to the surface, Hc2 increased to 5.1 Tesla

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Critical Temperature (Tc) vs. Magnetic Field Strength for Perpendicular and Parallel Orientations

contentList.name: table

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Discussion

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our results demonstrate that magnetic fields significantly alter the superconducting properties of YBCO ceramics, with field orientation and strength playing critical roles in Tc and Hc2. The anisotropic behavior observed in the samples suggests that further research is needed to optimize YBCO materials for practical applications in magnetic environments, such as in high-speed magnetic levitation trains and power transmission lines.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Conclusion

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Magnetic field-induced suppression of superconductivity in high-temperature ceramic superconductors can be mitigated by adjusting the composition and the orientation of the magnetic field relative to the sample. Future studies should focus on enhancing flux pinning mechanisms to extend the functional temperature range of YBCO superconductors in magnetic fields.

contentList.name: text

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Introduction

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Adolescents are exposed to multiple developmental, cognitive and emotional challenges, including independence and autonomy acquisition, identity and self esteem development, and social bond creation.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Aim

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: To assess the risk d...
contentList.remark: To assess the risk determinants and clinical outcomes of uncontrolled diabetes among Egyptian adolescents with T1D.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Methodology

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Six hundred adolescents with T1D were recruited from the Pediatric and Adolescents Diabetology Clinic, Ain-Shams University.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: From the studied cohort, 200 with good glycemic control ($\leq 7\%$) and 200 with poor control ($> 7\%$) were assessed for diabetes-duration, insulin regimen, frequency of diabetic-ketoacidosis, clinically significant hypoglycemia and the Mini-International Neuropsychiatric Interview for Children and Adolescents.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Auxological assessment, fundus and clinical screening for complications were done.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Neuropathy was confirmed by nerve conduction velocity.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Thyroid profile, anti-tissue transglutaminase-IgG, fasting lipids and urinary albumin/excretion ratio (UAE) were measured.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Results

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Adolescents having uncontrolled diabetes have significantly higher diabetes onset age (p = 0.037), diabetes-duration (p = 0.038), eating disorders (p = 0.027), sadness (p = 0.038), depression (p = 0.003), suicidal manifestations (p = 0.001) and anxiety (p<0.001) than the well-controlled group.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Avoid public gatherings as much as possible

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: WHY IS SOCIAL DISTANCING IMPORTANT?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It prevents contact between infected and uninfected individuals, resulting in reduced disease transmission and less deaths from fatal diseases.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Keep spots susceptible to mass gatherings like parks, malls, food courts, restaurants and schools closed. Restaurants can be instructed to follow a “Takeaway” only system until the situation relaxes

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Avoid shaking hands and embracing one another

contentList.remark: This means that if proper social distancing protocols are followed, the spread of the disease will slow down and relieve health care professionals and medical centers of the burden of providing aid to hundreds of patients at a time, which is not feasible.

contentList.remark: The ocean is a vital resource that supports life on Earth, yet it faces a growing number of threats from human activities. This poster provides an overview of the importance of ocean conservation and highlights the key threats facing the world's oceans.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Background

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The world's oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface and support a diverse range of ecosystems, including coral reefs, kelp forests, and open ocean habitats. However, the ocean is facing a growing number of threats, including climate change, overfishing, and plastic pollution. These threats can have far-reaching impacts on both marine and human life.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Global Ocean Heat

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Climate change is causing ocean temperatures to rise, leading to coral bleaching and other impacts on marine life.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Overfishing is depleting fish populations, leading to ecological imbalances and economic losses for coastal communities.

contentList.remark: 近年来，我国新能源汽车产业发展呈现市场规模、发展质量双提升的良好势头，年度产量首次达成1000万辆，自主品牌得以充分发展。成绩的取得，得益于国内消费市场的发展、企业自主创新能力的提升，更得益于我国强大的产业政策支撑，在有效统筹处理好质量和总量的关系、发挥规模效应的前提下，实现以质取胜的效果。2024年中央经济工作会议明确指出，必须统筹好提升质量和做大总量的关系，夯实中国式现代化的物质基础。这既是对当前我国经济发展阶段的精准把脉，也为今后经济高质量发展指明了方向、提供了遵循。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 在经济发展过程中，量变和质变是辩证统一的，量变通常表现为...
contentList.remark: 在经济发展过程中，量变和质变是辩证统一的，量变通常表现为经济发展的规模和速度，质变则表现为经济结构优化和经济效率提升。量的增长为质的提升创造条件，没有量的增加，高质量发展就缺乏物质技术基础；而没有质的提升，则谈不上高质量发展。只有统筹提升质量和做大总量的关系，既发挥规模效应，又以质取胜，才能实现更高质量、更有效率、更可持

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 党的十八大以来，我国经济发展在质和量两方...
contentList.remark: 党的十八大以来，我国经济发展在质和量两方面都取得了显著成就。从量的方面看，我国经济持续快速发展，2023年，我国国内生产总值达126万亿元，稳居世界第二位，工业基础和贸易大国地位持续巩固，经济实力显著增强。从质的方面看，创新活力持续迸发，2023年我国研发投入强度达到2.64%，全球创新指数升至第12名。重大科技成果竞相涌现，国产首艘大型邮轮投入运营，国产大飞机C919翱翔天空。人工智能、云计算等新技术快速发展，新兴产业和未来产业发展壮大，新动能日益成为经济增长的新引擎。这些成绩的取得，离不开坚持以质取胜和发挥规模效应相统一、有效统筹提升质量和做大总量这一科学方法论。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 坚持以质取胜和发挥规模效应相统一，也是当前和今后一个时期...
contentList.remark: 坚持以质取胜和发挥规模效应相统一，也是当前和今后一个时期做好经济工作的迫切需求。从当前看，无论是稳就业、防风险、惠民生，还是优结构、促转型、保安全，都需要我们在保持经济规模合理增长的同时，实现以质取胜，以自身发展的确定性来应对全球经济发展的不确定性。从长远看，中国式现代化是人口规模巨大的现代化，也是全体人民共同富裕的现代化，这就对我国经济发展的质量、结构、规模提出了更高要求。面对这一艰巨繁重的任务，只有在更长时间内

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 保持经济总量的合理增长，才能进一步做大蛋糕，以量的积累稳...
contentList.remark: 保持经济总量的合理增长，才能进一步做大蛋糕，以量的积累稳住经济发展基本盘，也只有不断提高发展质效，提升创新能力，才能做优蛋糕，以质的提升促进经济可持续发展。总的来看，坚持以质取胜和发挥规模效应相统一，既是应对当前困难挑战、推动经济持续回升向好的重要着力点，也是促进经济结构转型升级、推动高质量发展的科学方法论。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 打好宏观调控“组合拳”。推动经济量质齐升...
contentList.remark: 打好宏观调控“组合拳”。推动经济量质齐升，不仅要关注当下稳增长、稳预期、稳就业，更要着眼长远调结构、提质量、增效益，这都离不开精准有效的宏观调控。打好政策“组合拳”，必须强化宏观政策的系统性和协调性，注重各项政策之间的系统集成、协同配合，增强宏观政策取向一致性，确保同向发力、形成合力。把准政策“组合拳”的方向和力度，遵循财政货币政策更加积极有为这一主线，完善宏观政策框架，丰富政策调控工具，在执行过程中发挥激励机制作用，提升宏观调控的精准性和有效性。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 用好改革开放关键一招。改革开放是党和人民事业大踏步赶上时...
contentList.remark: 用好改革开放关键一招。改革开放是党和人民事业大踏步赶上时代的重要法宝，同样也是统筹提升质量和做大总量、推动高质量发展的必由之路。用好改革开放关键一招，重点是要坚决破除市场准入壁垒，维护公平竞争秩序，让地方经济的“小局”服从于全国统一大市场建设这个“大局”，打造市场化法治化国际化的一流营商

contentList.remark: 环境。比如，辽宁开展综合窗口改革，群众办事所需时间比法定要求提速78.9%；贵州全力推进“一窗通办”，窗口人员缩减63%，各地排队时长减少56%；江西搭建“惠企通”平台，惠企政策从梳理到兑现全程线上办理……这些都是各地区、各部门优化营商环境取得的实效。同时，注重瞄准重点领域推进高水平开放，稳步扩大规则、规制、管理、标准等制度型开放，以扩大开放破解贸易保护主义带来的困难和问题。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 在我国经济向高质量发展迈进的过程中，要不...
contentList.remark: 在我国经济向高质量发展迈进的过程中，要不断深化对经济工作的规律性认识，统筹好提升质量和做大总量的关系，坚持以质取胜和发挥规模效应相统一，促进国内经济实现更高水平的均衡发展，为实现中国式现代化奠定坚实基础。

contentList.remark: 一流”建设，一批大学和一大批学科已经跻身世界先进水平。高等教育服务国家重大战略的能力持续增强，高校获得了60%以上的国家科技三大奖励，承担了全国60%以上的基础研究和80%以上的国家自然科学基金项目，参与研制了超级计算机、北斗卫星导航系统、神舟系列等国之重器。高等教育促进经济社会发展的作用越来越突出，高校成为新质生产力的重要生长极。

contentList.fullName: text: 以党建保证高等教育改革的方向。中国高等教...
contentList.remark: 以党建保证高等教育改革的方向。中国高等教育改革有着世界高等教育改革的一般规律与特性，也有自身独特的改革逻辑和发展脉络，最重要的一点就是要确保社会主义办学方向。高等教育改革要以党的政治建设为统领，落实好党委领导下的校长负责制，确保党的教育方针在高校得到贯彻。要把“为党育人、为国育才”作为理念、责任和使命贯彻到高等教育改革全过程，培养社会主义的建设者和接班人。要坚持不懈用习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想铸魂育人，坚持思政课建设与党的创新理论武装同步推进，促进高等教育形成强大思政引领力。以党建加强高等教育改革的顶层设计，加强体制机制建设，从全局着手，整体擘画、系统集成、协同推进，努力做到统合力量、整合资源、凝聚共识，引领高校顶层设计的建立和完善，为高等教育改革保驾护航。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 以党建破解高等教育改革的难题。做好高校党...
contentList.remark: 以党建破解高等教育改革的难题。做好高校党建工作，为破解高等教育改革难题提供精神动力。改革没

contentList.fullName: text: 有完成时，只有进行时，必须有敢于冲破利益...
contentList.remark: 有完成时，只有进行时，必须有敢于冲破利益固化藩篱、将改革进行到底的决心。做好高校党建工作，就是要将改革精神贯彻下去，让高等教育在改革的洪流中获得高质量发展。做好高校党建工作，为破解高等教育改革难题提供人才支持。近年来，教育部组织2800余名全国普通高校党委书记和校长、8万余名领导班子成员和中层骨干、8.8万名学生党支部书记开展全覆盖集中培训，全国高校“双带头人”教师党支部书记配备比例超过97%，高校3.2万名高层次人才队伍中党员占比超过60%。这些都是新的历史时期推动高等教育改革所依靠的人才力量。要持续增强高校党组织政治功能和组织功能，引领广大师生积极投身改革。

contentList.remark: 古镇如何带给游客新体验

contentList.name: vertical_text
contentList.remark: 邓智团

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 散落在中华大地上的座座古镇，宛如一颗颗遗...
contentList.remark: 散落在中华大地上的座座古镇，宛如一颗颗遗世明珠，承载着历史和文化的记忆。中国旅游研究院发布的《2024年中国古镇旅游发展报告》显示，古镇旅游已成为游客重要的出游选择，超过九成的受访者表示曾参与过古镇旅游。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 古镇旅游的兴起，离不开古镇保护与发展的积...
contentList.remark: 古镇旅游的兴起，离不开古镇保护与发展的积极探索。古建筑的物质形态得以留存，传统手工艺、民俗文化等非物质文化遗产也得以传承。比如，有着1300多年历史的江苏太仓沙溪镇坚持原格局、原生态、原风貌和原住民的“四原”保护，依托古镇原始肌理，打造沙溪古镇数字文化产业创新基地，还结合本土风俗推进农文旅项目，帮助村民增收致富。皖南古村落宏村，作为联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产名录中的瑰宝，在妥善保存古建筑和历史信息的基础上，通过发展旅游业、文化产业和现代农业，巧妙推动文化浸润经济、经济融入文化，实现了古镇与产业的深度融合。成都以“天府古镇”为统一品牌，利用“主题创意场景+地域文化+特色互动”的方式，依托绿色低碳的生态本底、古色古香的街道、历史悠久的建筑以及传统的地方文化，打造不同主题的创意场景，推动古镇整体联动发展。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 事实上，这种“古镇+”模式，不仅为古镇带...
contentList.remark: 事实上，这种“古镇+”模式，不仅为古镇带来了源源不断的客流和收入，也有力支撑了古镇的可持续发展。不过也需要看到，古镇在资源禀赋上难免存在差异，尤其是对于那些相对“资质平平”的古镇来说，要在激烈竞争中突围难言容易。笔者认为，关键是要找准自身定位和核心资源，着力打造自身差异化特色，以历史文化为魂来守护古镇的千年记忆，以人间烟火为根来滋养古镇的生机与活力，以特色产业为筋骨来支撑古镇的可持续发展。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 了古镇的可持续发展...
contentList.remark: 了古镇的可持续发展

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 坚守历史文化之魂，深挖古镇特色资源。深入...
contentList.remark: 坚守历史文化之魂，深挖古镇特色资源。深入挖掘古镇的历史文化资源，不仅能让我们更好地了解过去，还能为古镇的发展注入独特魅力。保护和修缮历史建筑，使其重现昔日的风貌，让游客能够随手触摸并感受到古风古韵；传承传统手工艺和民俗文化，让这些古老的技艺和习俗融入现代生活，重新焕发生机与活力。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 以特色产业为筋骨，支撑古镇可持续发展。在...
contentList.remark: 以特色产业为筋骨，支撑古镇可持续发展。在妥善保护古镇的同时，善于引入与古镇文化相契合的产业，丰富古镇文化业态，提升游客在地体验，增加古镇的辨识度和吸引力。一些古镇拥有独特的传统手工艺，如陶瓷制作、刺绣、木雕等，可精心谋划、特色招商、创新业态，打造具有地方特色的文化产业品牌。同时，利用古镇的自然风光和人文景观，推进文旅深度融合，善用新信息技术，提供丰富多样的旅游体验。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 古镇的保护发展离不开社会参与和多元共赢。...
contentList.remark: 古镇的保护发展离不开社会参与和多元共赢。当地居民是古镇的主人，他们沿用的生活方式和接续的文化传统是古镇的魅力所在。理应鼓励居民积极参与古镇的保护和发展，保护本土文化，传承传统技艺。可通过开展培训活动等，增强当地居民的文化保护意识和旅游服务能力，让他们更好参与到古镇的发展中。同时，吸引企业、社会组织等多元主体参与其中，协同努力，优化服务格局，丰富产品供给，让古镇更好连接过去与未来，成为既具有历史韵味又充满现代活力之地。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 期待更多古镇找到适合自己的发展模式，让古...
contentList.remark: 期待更多古镇找到适合自己的发展模式，让古老文化与现代生活相互辉映，为游客带来新体验和新感受。相信汇聚而起的古镇保护与发展之力，将更好护佑中华民族的文化瑰宝。

contentList.remark: 随着老年群体不断扩容，老年用品消费将持续增长，且更加多样化、个性化。从辅具使用来看，据《第五次中国城乡老年人生活状况抽样调查基本数据公报》，2021年，我国75.8%的老年人使用了辅具用品。中国老龄科学研究中心预测，2035年我国银发经济规模将达30万亿元。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 当前老年用品产业快速发展，能较好满足老年...
contentList.remark: 当前老年用品产业快速发展，能较好满足老年人的基础需求，但仍存在供需矛盾。客观上，对老年人有效需求的挖掘还不充分，老年用品产业整体适老化水平、创新能力也有待进一步提升，创新产品供给能力尚显不足。如何更好促进老年用品产业发展？首要的是准确把握老年人对老年用品的需求及变化趋势。老龄群体特殊的身心特点和行为习惯，决定了老年用品需求通常有以下特点：一是健康主导；二是对产品的安全性和便利性要求较高；三是注重产品的长期性和稳定性。还有部分老年人对产品价格较为敏感，注重产品质量和价格间的平衡。此外，老年人对科技化和智能化产品的需求也愈加凸显，个性化和定制化需求强烈。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 以需求牵引供给，充分挖掘并满足老年人的有效需求。一方面，...
contentList.remark: 以需求牵引供给，充分挖掘并满足老年人的有效需求。一方面，多渠道推广健康管理理念，激发并释放老年用品消费需求。可采用政府购买服务等形式，在社区为老年人提供中高端老年用品租赁服务；另一方面，探索扩大长期护理保险和民政居家养老补贴范围，支持老年人更便利获得所需的老年用品和服务。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 以供给创造需求，通过多方面的支持政策推动...
contentList.remark:
以供给创造需求，通过多方面的支持政策推动老年用品产业发展。老年用品产业投入大、投资回报周期长，很多产品具有一定的福利性质，其经济效益低但社会效益好。可通过加强相关政策扶持和税收优惠等，鼓励更多市场主体进入老年用品市场，开展老年用品关键技术和产品的研发推广，丰富市场供给。培育壮大骨干企业，打造老年用品品牌，推出更多老百姓用得起、用着好的产品和服务，不断释放引领示范效应，激发市场发展活力。
同时，还可鼓励老年用品企

contentList.fullName: text: 同时，还可鼓励老年用品企业创新线下体验、...
contentList.remark: 同时，还可鼓励老年用品企业创新线下体验、线上购买模式，优化老年用品消费方式和环境。老年人的健康水平和自理能力有较大的异质性，老年用品的适用性等也存在差异，应进一步细分老龄产品市场，低技术含量的产品可以进行网络销售，价格高昂的高科技产品可以提供上门试用服务。鼓励企业为老年人提供个性化服务，多渠道提升老年用品可及性，提升老年人消费体验。

contentList.remark: 2024年12月6日，久事体育和F1共同宣布：F1中国大奖赛已完成新一轮签约，双方将自2026年起续约至2030年。来自F1的官方数据显示，F1中国大奖赛连续举办20年来，培养了一大批忠实车迷，这项运动在中国的受欢迎程度正持续上升，当前中国粉丝数量已突破1.5亿。作为国内规模最大的国际常设赛事之一，F1中国大奖赛带来了显著的经济效益。据统计，2024年F1中国大奖赛共吸引逾20万观众现场观赛，带来直接经济效益14.06亿元，间接经济效益（产出效应）39.28亿元。

contentList.remark: 赛事也让市民更多地了解体育项目，进而参与其中。赛事的消费牵引作用，越来越被“看见”——除了赛事举办直接拉动门票、餐饮、服饰、运动器材等体育周边用品消费，还掀起了“跟着赛事去旅行”的新时尚，让体育赛事“流量”加快转化为文旅消费“留量”。越来越多的赛事也在积极“进商圈、进景区、进街区”。

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: 记者注意到，上海在办赛过程中注重顶层设计，有系统、有规划地引领和构建与国际体育赛事之都相匹配的体育赛事体系，相继发布《上海市体育赛事管理办法》等，推出一系列管理创新举措。“顶级赛事、标志性赛事、培育型赛事”——上海市体育局党组书记、局长徐彬这样界定他心目中的“上海赛事”标准。“我们希望探索形成一个闭环的赛事认证、赛事评估、赛事扶持的管理服务体系，从专业度、关注度、贡献度等方面对赛事影响力作评估，坚持市场主导、政府引导，鼓励更多社会力量参与办赛，提高赛事活动的针对性，让‘上海赛事’走向全国、走向世界。”他表示。

contentList.remark: 体育是提高人民健康水平的重要途径，是满足人民群众对美好生活向往、促进人的全面发展的重要手段；体育是促进经济社会发展的重要动力，是展示国家文化软实力的重要平台。“上海将进一步深化体育领域改革，把有效市场和有为政府结合起来，充分发挥市场在资源配置中的决定性作用，不断提高要素配置和产品流通效率。我们愿意在改革创新中为国家承担更多试点任务，探新路、测压力，办人民群众满意的体育。”徐彬说。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 城市功能是城市影响力、吸引力和竞争力的重...
contentList.remark: 城市功能是城市影响力、吸引力和竞争力的重要载体，城市发展的过程就是城市功能不断变化、不断叠加、日益完善的过程。体育是城市功能的重要载体，体育因城市而兴，城市因体育而盛。体育与其他领域积极互动，在民生、文化、经济、科教、对外交流交往等方面的功能日益彰显。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 体育为城市生活增添亮色。体育运动充分融入...
contentList.remark: 体育为城市生活增添亮色。体育运动充分融入市民日常，成为美好生活的重要内容之一。F1中国大奖赛、上海网球大师赛、WTT中国大满贯等高水平体育赛事“一票难求”，“北马”“上马”“厦马”等城市马拉松赛事“一签难中”。智能可穿戴设备、户外运动装备销售火爆，体育公园、体育综合服务体、城市步道体系建设如火如荼，社交平台“晒步数”“晒运动”蔚然成风。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 体育为城市形象定格铸魂。体育锻炼的是人的...
contentList.remark: 体育为城市形象定格铸魂。体育锻炼的是人的意志和素质，熔铸的是城市的形象与品格。2024年巴黎奥运会在塞纳河上的开幕式、埃菲尔铁塔下的沙滩排球赛以及协和广场上的新兴奥运项目，彰显了巴黎独特的历史文化和创新精神。纽约充分利用举办美网公开赛、纽约马拉松赛、职业体育联赛等契机，通过精彩的赛事内容、高效的管理工作、高水平的接待服务，将城市景观融入赛事，向世界展示了鲜明的城市形象。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 体育为城市经济注入活力。作为一种充满活力...
contentList.remark: 体育为城市经济注入活力。作为一种充满活力的经济形态，体育赛事成为串联文旅活动的纽带、城市营销的立体广告、拉动产业转型的内在动力之一。上海举办的奥运会资格系列赛创造直接经济效益6.43亿元，间接经济效益14.02亿元。2024年在北京举办的中国网球公开赛和WTT中国大满贯赛叠加“十一黄金周”效应，仅赛事票房收入就超过了1.4亿元，约有14万外地球迷和超1.3万境外观众入场观赛，有力地带动了“吃住行游购娱”相关产业消费。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 体育为城市更新提速赋能。通过建设改造体育...
contentList.remark: 体育为城市更新提速赋能。通过建设改造体育场馆及其配套设施，促进特定区域整体更新，成为提升城市空间品质的路径之一。为满足奥运会期间的场地可达性，伦敦政府整修了斯特拉特福德国际站及地区站，汇集伦敦所有公共交通服务种类，这也满足了当地居民日常出行需求；奥运会后通过土壤生物修复技术，实现被污染土地的再利用。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 进入新时代，中国体育事业蓬勃发展，全国各...
contentList.remark:
进入新时代，中国体育事业蓬勃发展，全国各地形成了你追我赶、千帆竞发的繁荣景象，共同开启了全新的发展格局。以上海为例，加快建设全球著名体育城市，已然成为深入践行体育强国战略、全力迈向具有国际影响力的社会主义现代化大都市进程中的关键一环。近十年间，上海体育事业砥砺前行，发展水平持续攀升，综合实力与国际影响力稳步提升。置身于这股浪潮之中，有条件的城市应把握机遇、创新突破，持续深耕体育领域，不断提升体育事业发展的质量与效益，为中国体育事业的辉煌篇章添上浓墨重彩的一笔。
重彩的一笔。

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 重彩的一笔

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 强化体育资源配置力。按照体育资源高度集聚...
contentList.remark: 强化体育资源配置力。按照体育资源高度集聚、体育服务功能健全、体育市场环境优良、物流运输优质高效的要求，提升对全球范围内体育人才、技术、资本、信息等资源要素进行流动、整合、分配、管理的能力。做大做强体育资源交易平台，广泛吸纳具备交易条件的体育资源权益，促进体育产权交易市场价值的最大化。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 强化体育创新驱动力。聚焦新质生产力培育，...
contentList.remark: 强化体育创新驱动力。聚焦新质生产力培育，构建支持体育领域全面创新的体制机制，促进创新链、产业链、资金链和人才链的深度融合。锚定数字赛事、智慧场馆、智能健身、智能制造等关键领域，引导现代科技成果和信息技术在体育领域发力，催生智慧互联的体育新产品、新模式、新业态。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 强化体育消费引领力。强化“商旅文体展”共...
contentList.remark: 强化体育消费引领力。强化“商旅文体展”共联、体育商品和服务共促、体育品牌和场景共融，释放体育消费潜力。积极发展体育领域首发经济、银发经济、冰雪经济、低空经济，丰富新兴运动项目供给，拓展体育消费空间。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 强化体育对外开放力。持续营造市场化、法治...
contentList.remark: 强化体育对外开放力。持续营造市场化、法治化、国际化营商环境，吸引国际体育组织、体育跨国企业、国际体育学校。开展多层次、多领域、多形式的体育合作，推动体育领域规则、规制、管理、标准等与国际融通对接。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 讲述人：中国赛艇协会原副主席、上海赛艇公...
contentList.remark:
讲述人：中国赛艇协会原副主席、上海赛艇公开赛赛事总监 李建新
我打小从事游泳训练，后来转行练赛艇，从运动员到教练员，参加过奥运会、亚运会，带领过国家赛艇队和皮划艇队，一路走来，对水上运动的热爱，已经融入了我的人生。
