contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Around fifty people gathered at the Cathedral of St. Catharine of Sienna, Pa., on Saturday February 25th for a Sacred Dance Workshop, "The Liturgy of Worship in Dance. Our guest leader was Mary Jane Wolbers assisted by Geraldine Stofco. The workshop was coordinated by members of the Sacred Dance Guild in cooperation with St. Catharine of Siena.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The morning began with a colorful getting-to-know you improvisation followed by a warm-up technique class. This was led by Geraldine Stofco. After our bag lunches we saw the film "The Liturgy of Worship in Dance". The theme of the afternoon was choreographic development: setting a mood for welcome, prayer, meditation, communion, so you want to dance a hymn? Mnnnn!; a dance for a special occasion; to carol is to dance. These sessions were directed by Mary Jane Wolbers. Each participant chose an area to explore. At the end of the day each group shared what their group had developed through movement. The day was an educational learning process. The participants' enthusiasm and willingness to learn and share made the day a heartwarming, creative experience.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: From Gina Ball: Have just finished my my master's thesis production at California State University, Northridge. I choreographed a 40 minute work with original music by Theodore Peterson. Titled "Dark Illuminations" it was a multi-media work dealing with the place of man in the universe.

contentList.name: table
contentList.remark: LATELATELATENEWS

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
From Rusty MacLeod, Mt. Pleasant,
Michigan: I had a wonderful experience recently which I want to share with my SDG friends. Was asked to speak at a "Feminar" at one of our local churches, and to dance. The theme of the day was "Be Thou My Vision," and I was to speak on the subject of praise in prayer. Since I had just finished

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: memorizing the 103rd Psalm, I assumed that I'd be dancing either to that or to the hymn-theme. I asked for the Lord's help and set to work. The movement that came to me was so lovely, I knew it had to come from Him. However, when I tried to set it to either the hymn or the Psalm, it seemed all wrong, and I just couldn't understand! After some time, I suddenly remembered that the leader had intended to close the day with "Spirit of the Living God, Fall Afresh On Me." And sure enough that was exactly what the movement was suited for! The day went so beautifully, I used it again twice in my own fellowship, and everyone said it was most edifying. Praise God!

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: I taught the group t...
contentList.remark: I taught the group the little hymn, "Spirit of the Living God," and they accompanied me with their voices. Note: If you intend to use this type of prayer accompaniment, be sure to warn the people to keep their eyes open. They may not realize you intend to dance to it, and keep their eyes closed!

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Very soon I will be ...
contentList.remark: Very soon I will be beginning work on my master's thesis for Central Michigan University, entitled "Dancing for Jesus"...Tentative plans are to do a first volume on the history of dance in the Christian church, and then follow it up with a specialist-degree work, perhaps with the same title, Vol. II, as a current-status work including practical application.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: From Marjorie Coco, Louisville, Kentucky: Three girls did symbolic candle movements Christmas Eve to congregational singing of "Silent Night". A few ideas we used were: "See the Eastern Wise Men Bring Gifts and Homage to Our King" - slow bend toward center of lying baby. "Angels Sing Alleluias to Our King" - dancers turn outward toward congregation in "joy" position (legs apart, arms high and apart, head high. "Star" - dancers in circle facing each other, raising candles high above head slowly almost touching one another. Our adult dance choir is very young and we use choir gowns. They are in the process of designing dresses at this time.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Variety and The Unity of Spiritual Gifts...1 Corinthians 12:4-7

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
"There is a variety of gifts but always the same Spirit; there are all sorts of service to be done, but always to the same Lord; working in all sorts of different ways in different people, it is the same God who is working in all of them....."
Through the years the Sacred Dance Guild has offered leadership in a variety of dance forms and religious denominations and with this 20th anniversary year we continue to build on the foundation of both traditional and contemporary expression. With this and in coming Festivals the culmination of the conference will be in the creating, participation and experience of a particular denominational worship service and its time in history.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Spirit Moves - A Workshop 9th Dance and Prayer - Through the interaction of self, improvisation and prayer the workshop will explore a variety of ways dance and prayer can enhance liturgy and illuminate scripture varying with the feasts and seasons in the church year allowing us to become more involved in the word of God as it touches us.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Carla DeSola, a graduate of the Juilliard School of Music, has danced and given workshops on dance and prayer from California to New York, for colleges, retreat centers, parishes and religious conferences. She has produced for television, writes a monthly column on dance for Liturgy and is the author of Learning Through Dance and The Spirit Moves .... a handbook on dance and prayer. Presently she is teaching at the College of New Rochelle, New York Theological Seminary and directing the Omega Liturgical Dance Company of New York City.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Music

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Calliope Consort - Music for Worship and Dance - Music from biblical times through the 17th century will be played on medieval, renaissance, baroque and folk instruments such as violas da gamba, recorders, krummhorns, pipe and tabor, percussion, harp, rauschefeiffe, psaltry and cornamuse.

contentList.name: text

contentList.fullName: text: That is where the In...
contentList.remark: That is where the India-Pakistan balance is now—about where we were in 1950. And it is U.S. policy today to try to rush in and get both sides to forswear the nukes: no further testing, no weaponization. This would be very nice. It is also very unlikely.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Indeed, it is likely that even if both sides agree, one side or the other will cheat. And it is certain that even if neither side does in fact cheat, both sides will surely suspect each other of doing just that. And when you suspect the other side of cheating, you suspect that it may have a first-strike capacity—which would spur you to cheat as well and develop a clandestine countervailing arsenal. Indeed, that is precisely what has happened between India and Pakistan—competing clandestine nuclear programs—to bring us to the current crisis.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The period of nuclear instability on the subcontinent is beginning. And paradoxically, the situation will only begin to stabilize when both countries have deployed enough nukes—spread out in enough areas—that neither side can be sure of a successful first strike. It sounds perverse to say it, but the fact is, now that the race is on, nuclear stability will only come to the Indian subcontinent when the respective nuclear arsenals have grown larger and more mature.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: It is not a happy pr...
contentList.remark: It is not a happy prospect. But it is reality. Welcome once again—just when you thought it was over—to the unthinkable world of nuclear deterrence.

THE THIRD RAIL

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Political Case for Privatizing Social Security Now

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: By David Frum

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: These days, a Washington journalist who evinces an interest in Social Security is likely to find himself in the same predicament as someone who buys from a mail-order catalogue: 72 hours later, the Post Office will need a forklift to deliver all the bales of printed matter to his doorstep. Proposal after proposal! Plan after plan! And appended to each, a phone book's worth of numbers! It's dazing, it's daunting. Who can possibly hope to understand all these alternatives? Much less, choose one?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Everyone knows that the condition of Social Security is desperate. A system created for an America in which most people died soon after reaching 65 is breaking down in an America in which life expectancies approach 80 and the average woman gives birth to only two children. When the system was established in 1937, there were 42 workers for every beneficiary. Now there are three. Soon there will be only two. Sometime after 2010, the money raised by the Social Security payroll tax will no longer suffice to pay the

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: David Frum is a cont...
contentList.remark: David Frum is a contributing editor to THE WEEKLY STANDARD.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: benefits the federal government has promised. The gap between what the tax will bring in and what the system requires is enormous: Nobody can say for sure how enormous, but even the most optimistic projections reckon that the shortfall will be in the hundreds of billions of dollars. Without Social Security reform, we are 12 years away from a financial emergency more expensive than World War II.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Again, that much everybody knows. But they also know the immense political risk of attempting to solve the problem. The American public hungers for Social Security reform about as much as one of Trollope's gouty squires hungered for reform of the House of Lords. There is no appetite for change, and no trust in the politicians who will have to effect that change. The voters brutalized the Republicans in 1982, when the GOP considered stiffening the rules governing early retirement, and they punished the Democrats even more harshly in 1994, after Bill Clinton's budget deal taxed a big chunk of the Social Security income of the better-off elderly.

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: The Bioethics of Big Brother

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: By Wesley J. Smith

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: People who are elderly, disabled, prematurely born, or seriously ill have much to fear from the medical intelligentsia—those bioethicists and moral philosophers who have in recent years transformed medical ethics.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It was bioethicists and moral philosophers, after all, who made it acceptable to dehydrate to death people diagnosed as permanently unconscious—a practice that has already spread to brain-damaged people who are unquestionably conscious.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It was bioethicists and moral philosophers who made a distinction between “human beings” and “persons,” with only persons enjoying the right to life—a theory intended to pave the way for the legal killing of babies born with birth defects and involuntary euthanasia of legally incompetent patients. (Both forms of medicalized killing already occur in the Netherlands, a country some look to as a model for the United States.)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It was bioethicists and moral philosophers as well who promulgated “Futile Care Theory,” which allows doctors and health-insurance executives to deny not merely high-tech interventions but also such treatments as CPR and antibiotics to the profoundly disabled and people at the end of life. Even if the patient or the patient’s family wants the care, what matters is the medical professional’s assessment of the quality and worth of the patient’s life. Little noticed by the mainstream media,

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Wesley J. Smith, an attorney for the International Anti-Euthanasia Task Force, is the author of Forced Exit: The Slippery Slope from Assisted Suicide to Legalized Murder.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Futile Care Theory is already being implemented in hospitals and nursing homes, both informally in clinical settings and formally through hospital protocols.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: In short, with the e...
contentList.remark: In short, with the exception of helping to create laws that permit people to refuse unwanted medical treatment, the attitudes and policies of most mainstream bioethicists and moral philosophers are very bad news for the medically defenseless and vulnerable among us.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Daniel Callahan
False Hopes
Why America’s Quest for Perfect
Health is a Recipe for Failure
Simon & Schuster, 336 pp., $24

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
William B. Schwartz
Life Without Disease
The Pursuit of Medical Utopia
University of California Press, 204 pp., $22

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: It is in this contex...
contentList.remark: It is in this context that two new books, False Hopes by the noted bioethicist Daniel Callahan and Life Without Disease by physician William B. Schwartz, cause so much concern. Both authors urge the laudable reform of our currently dysfunctional health-care system in order to make it more widely accessible and cost efficient. Unfortunately, both authors choose methods that are unethical and immoral.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: At first blush, Callahan and Schwartz seem mirror opposites: Callahan is nihilistic; Schwartz is utopian. Callahan is convinced that medical progress has advanced just about as far as it reasonably can. Schwartz sees a medically miraculous future where life expectancy will

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: reach 130 years. Callahan would put more money into public-health education, while Schwartz would increase investment in medical research. Callahan writes too long. Schwartz writes too short.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Despite these differences, however, the authors have much in common. Both write in the passive prose so favored by the medical intelligentsia. Both attempt to appear rational and balanced as they grapple with health-care policy. And both surrender abjectly to medical utilitarianism.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Each enthusiastically espouses a rigid system of health-care rationing that would sacrifice the life and health of some people for the sake of health-care “equity”—which for both the authors represents a higher good than the fate of individual patients. And therein lies an acute and fast-approaching danger to the future of America as a moral nation.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Callahan disbelieves in medical utopia, and everywhere he looks, he sees only limits. People expect too much from their doctors. Medicine is too expensive and getting more so. Health care consumes 14 percent of the gross domestic product and takes resources away from other important community interests.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: And what have we got...
contentList.remark: And what have we gotten for our huge investment in medicine? Not as much, according to Callahan, as might be supposed. It’s true that life expectancy has increased by approximately thirty years during the twentieth century, but that has mostly to do with improved infant-mortality rates. And our increased lifespan is actually a bit of a curse. We used to die quickly from infectious disease. Now we die slowly from such chronic and debilitating conditions as Alz-

contentList.remark: Bill Clinton's Fellow China Apologists

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: As preparations for the Tiananmen Square Summit proceed apace, it's increasingly clear that no Chinese infamy—not blatant interference in American elections, not Beijing's aggressive military buildup, not the forced-abortion and organ-harvesting horrors perpetrated by the Chinese Communists—will halt the tank-like forward progress of the Clinton appeasement machine. It's also clear that, as long as Clinton embraces the butchers of Beijing, much of America's commerce-loving foreign-policy Establishment will embrace Clinton. Interestingly, the more craven and fawning Clinton has become towards Beijing, the more he has tended to point out that his policy is a direct descendant of George Bush's. And for the approval-craving Bush crowd, this praise from the man who booted them out of office seems to be most welcome.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Perhaps that's why Brent Scowcroft, Bush's national security adviser, swung into action last week in defense of Clinton and his summit. Scowcroft drafted a cliché-drenched "Open Letter to Congress" full of Council on Foreign Relations blah-blah ("China is destined to become a

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: great economic and political power in the 21st century; the United States should neither fear nor oppose this development"). Then he circulated this letter with a comically full-of-itself cover memo on Scowcroft's letterhead—a copy of which THE SCRAPBOOK has obtained—in order to drum up VIP signatures for the letter.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “Dear Colleagues,” Scowcroft wrote, “As you are aware, U.S.-China relations have come under significant criticism in recent weeks. Much of the criticism seems based on misinformation or a lack of credible facts. . . . In an effort to bring some balance to public debate, we are proposing an open letter to Congress, to be published in selected national newspapers a week before President Clinton leaves for China. We anticipate that funding for this effort will come through the U.S.-China Education Foundation. Presidents Bush, Carter and Ford, as well as Henry Kissinger and Larry Eagleburger, agree that such a letter could bring a much needed reminder of the critical importance of the strategic relationship between our two countries. All have agreed to sign the letter. We would be honored if you

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: would join us."

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “I am currently in China with President Bush, but my colleagues . . . can assist you with any questions you may have regarding this letter.”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: It’s nice to know th...
contentList.remark: It’s nice to know that if President Clinton needs any informal advance work for the Tiananmen Square Summit, he seems to have some very able helpmeets already on the ground. THE SCRAPBOOK is also pleased to learn, from the distribution list on the Scowcroft memo, who makes the Establishment A-list these days: James Baker, Lloyd Bensten [sic], Michael Blumenthal, Nicholas Brady, Harold Brown, Zbigniew Brzezinski, Frank Carlucci, Dick Cheney, Warren Christopher, Henry Fowler, Alexander Haig, Melvin Laird, Anthony Lake, Robert McFarlane, William Miller, Walter Mondale, William Perry, Colin Powell, Dan Quayle, Donald Regan, Elliot Richardson, William Rogers, Donald Rumsfeld, James Schlesinger, George Shultz, William Simon, Cyrus Vance, and Casper [sic] Weinberger. Next week, once the letter has been published, we’ll provide an update on which of these men has the gumption—and principle—to spurn Scowcroft’s entreaties.

contentList.remark: TIGER, TIGER

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Golfer Tiger Woods is proving himself one of the nation's leading purveyors of clear-headedness about race, not that this is winning him many friends. Woods's mother is Thai, and his father is black—but also part-Caucasian and part-American Indian, which leads Woods to describe himself as "Cablinasian," a rebuke of sorts to those who would assign him a part that he doesn't wish to play. Gen. Colin Powell, for one, ridiculed Woods and this "very strange word" last year on Meet the Press.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: But Woods seems immune to criticism. Three years ago, when still in college, he was asked at the Masters whether he felt an “obligation” to serve as a role model to minority youths. And he answered, breathtakingly, “No. I feel I have an obligation to serve as a role model to everyone, regardless of color.”

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: Mr. McCully Wins Out in Competition

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our splendid subject “Raising the First American Flag” used in conjunction with a good distribution plan, that of distributing calendars through schools, as suggested on page No. 124 of hand book, landed this order, which amounts to $113.00. The plan contemplates the advertiser sending a large sized mount 16x21 into the school rooms of the county, and the small sized 7x10 mounts are given by the teachers to pupils, and thus go into the homes. By referring to the hand book you will find that pupils are supposed to write essays on the subject. We believe this distribution plan a very good one. This same buyer also uses a lot of our subject “In the Heart of the Rockies” for entirely different distribution. Mr. McCully’s letter which accompanied the order follows:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The enclosed order was taken in active competition with the Murphy Co. Mr. Buell, their representative in this territory showing his line at the same time. I won out easily, the large calendars go to the school rooms in the country and the teacher furnishes the youngsters with small ones. These people have bought of Murphy for several years, Mr. Buell living but a short distance from here. As far as I can learn Murphy got one order from a wholesale liquor man here. I will get at least $200.00 more here. Had to stay over here in order to show my line against Murphy's.

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: I have been too busy to write you sooner and tonight I have nothing special to offer. We have such an excellent line and I have had so many experiences with it that I don’t know which ones to tell, and I can’t tell all.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: True I have been sen...
contentList.remark: True I have been sending in some small orders every day, but they have not come easy, several of them it has taken from

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: three to six hours to close, but I never let go of a man as long as he keeps his interest, and I don’t stay long with a fellow that won’t enthuse over it with me.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: I was from 8:30 till 12:00 closing my mill order today, they had decided not to buy calendars, had distributed but few of the ones they bought. I outlined a plan of distributing them that won and finally got me their order for the beautiful "Autumn" De Luxe for 1910.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Talking to a man yes...
contentList.remark: Talking to a man yesterday he said, "It seems to me your calendars are awfully high," I said "they are, they are higher than a cat's back, but they are worth every cent we are asking for them, and you will admit it if you compare them with the junk you bought last year." He bought.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Another man said “Something cheap will do just as well.” I said “alright, suppose you were going to visit all your customers personally, would you fix up and look your best, or would you just slouch out any old way?” He said “I would fix up of course,” then I said, “Inasmuch as you cannot call upon all of your customers personally, don’t you think your greeting ought to be worthy of the man it represents, and as it is a souvenir, do you want it to have the appearance of something real cheap, or the best of its kind that money can buy?” He bought.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: A banker said to me,...
contentList.remark: A banker said to me, "I'll take the numbers of two or three" and before he said any more, I said "That won't buy you anything," he said "Why not?" "Because I replied "they will still be in the line, and I will sell everyone of my best subjects before I get back to you, and you'll have to take fourth or fifth choice," he said, "O well I'll buy of someone else there are plenty of others," "O yes" I answered, "but suppose you treat them all like you are treating me, don't you see you will possibly be up against the same proposition." He said "O well I wouldn't treat them all that way," and then I asked him what I had done to him that he should make an example of me. He bought.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Mr. A. E. Gerlach la...
contentList.remark: Mr. A. E. Gerlach last year sold a small bill of calendars to a prominent banker and broker in Chicago, who is considered an art connoisseur and who owns a large private collection,

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: many of which are in...
contentList.remark: many of which are in the Art Institute. This year he called upon this gentleman early and succeeded in selling him a bill amounting close onto $150.00. He buys these calendars more as a souvenir than as an advertisement, and gives them away to his personal friends and his customers. It is therefore not surprising that he selected several different subjects. Mr. Gerlach writes as follows:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Mr.—— is a prominent banker and broker of Chicago and an art connoisseur of renown, having a collection of originals in the art institute here and a private collection at his home. He had never purchased calendars until May, and he already turned down several men, but I simply asked him to look at the G.-B. line, I wanted his artistic opinion. I got same, also an order for 700 mounts. On his desk was a circular “wait for the Osborne Man,” and he had just opened B. & B.’s house calendar, but he could not wait. He said our line was beyond compare, and predicts success to all G.-B. salesmen.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A. E. Gerlach.

正文文本text_block: 继匈牙利、中国、苏联共产党和工人党及政府的代表 1 月 10 日在莫斯科举行会谈以后，以周恩来总理为首的我国政府代表团又应邀于 1 月 16 日到布达佩斯进行友好访问，并同匈牙利政府的领导人员进行了会谈。这次会谈进一步加强了中匈两国和社会主义各国的友谊和团结。两国政府代表团在会谈结束后发表的联合声明中，对当前重大国际问题和匈牙利局势取得了完全一致的看法。中国政府充分地支持匈牙利社会主义工人党和工农革命政府为保卫和发展匈牙利社会主义事业所作的努力。双方一致谴责以美国为首的帝国主义势力利用联合国对匈牙利进行干涉的阴谋，并重申加强以苏联为首的社会主义各国的亲密团结和友好合作。中国人民对于这次会谈的结果感到十分满意。
从去年 10 月的匈牙利事件以来，中国人民一直密切地注视着匈牙利人民斗争的发展，把匈牙利人民的斗争看成自己的斗争，把匈牙利人民的困难看成自己的困难，把匈牙利人民的胜利看成自己的胜利。中国人民完全同意匈牙利社会主义工人党临时中央委员会去年 12 月会议对匈牙利事件的反革命性质所作的正确估计。联合声明指出，匈牙利事件是 “帝国主义反动势力和匈牙利的反革命分子利用了劳动群众和青年对过去领导者的严重错误感到的正当的不满，进行了他们策划已久旨在推翻匈牙利人民民主制度和社会主义成就的反革命颠覆活动”。事实已经清楚地证明，匈牙利反革命分子的目的，是推翻社会主义制度和在匈牙利复辟资本主义制度，是从匈牙利打开一个缺口来破坏整个社会主义阵营，是把匈牙利变成新战争的温床。因此，匈牙利反革命暴乱是帝国主义势力对社会主义、民主和和平事业发动的凶恶进攻。由此可见，匈牙利人民粉碎反革命叛乱的这一胜利，是匈牙利劳动人民和匈牙利社会主义力量的胜利，是整个社会主义阵营的胜利，同时也是世界和平势力反对战争势力的胜利。正像周恩来总理在布达佩斯积极分子大会上的讲话所指出的，“匈牙利人民在对反革命阴谋进行斗争中所取得的胜利，具有世界范围的重要意义”。
在反革命暴乱被粉碎以后，由于匈牙利的党、政府和人民进行了各种努力的结果，现在匈牙利已经恢复了正常的秩序。反革命残余分子正在肃清，思想战线上的斗争正在加强。工业方面的情况已有好转，煤炭产量日益增加。在联合声明中，中国政府代表团对于匈牙利社会主义工人党和工农革命政府的这些努力给以充分的支持。
由于这次反革命暴乱的破坏，匈牙利的国民经济遭受了相当大的损失，因而不能不遇到暂时的严重的经济困难。同时，已经遭到失败的国内外反革命势力并没有死心。以美国为首的帝国主义势力还没有放弃干涉匈牙利事务的阴谋。匈牙利国内残存的反革命分子还在企图采取新的政治花样进行破坏活动。因此，摆在匈牙利人民面前的任务还是很艰巨的。现在，匈牙利的党和政府正在领导全国人民为克服经济上的困难而斗争，同时正在采取有效的措施，努力巩固匈牙利的无产阶级专政。匈牙利工农革命政府在 1 月 5 日所发表的关于当前最重要的任务的声明中正确地指出：“在无产阶级专政的匈牙利工农国家里，民主和自由是给予工人、劳动农民、忠于人民的知识分子和遵守法律的全体匈牙利公民的。反革命分子和帝国主义间谍，进攻匈牙利人民共和国合法制度和共和国主要机构、煽动反对它们的那些分子，即使他们用民主的口号来掩饰自己的反革命活动，没有而且也不可能给他们自由。法律将永远严厉地制裁他们。” 我们深信，匈牙利劳动人民在自己的党和政府的坚强领导之下，必能团结一致，战胜目前时期的困难，医治反革命暴乱所造成的创伤，并且走上繁荣幸福的道路。
中匈两国政府代表团在会谈中十分重视加强以苏联为首的社会主义各国的团结。社会主义国家之间的关系是利害相关、休戚与共、同甘共苦的新型国际关系。这种关系在匈牙利事件中受到了最严重的考验。一切忠于社会主义事业和忠于和平事业的人都可以看到，如果没有苏联的援助，法西斯势力就必然在匈牙利复辟，欧洲和世界和平就必然受到十分严重的威胁。在目前帝国主义势力仍然不甘失败，继续向社会主义、向和平事业进攻的时候，正如中匈两国政府代表团联合声明所说，“以苏联为首的社会主义各国的亲密团结和友好合作是保障社会主义各国的建设事业，争取世界持久和平的可靠保证。”
我国人民高兴的是，中匈两国人民的兄弟友谊经过最近的事件是更加加强了。这次以周恩来总理为首的我国政府代表团的访问匈牙利，和中匈两国政府代表团的会谈结果，使我们两国人民之间的友谊得到了进一步的发展。我们愿意利用这个机会表示我国人民的最普遍的情感：我们坚决支持匈牙利人民正在进行的保卫社会主义事业的艰苦斗争，并且热烈地祝贺匈牙利的工人、农民和爱国的知识分子在光荣的劳动中不断地获得新的成就。

中国方面参加会谈的是：国务院总理周恩来，副总理贺龙，外交部副部长王稼祥和中国驻苏联大使刘晓。

正文文本text_block: 新华社贝尔格莱德 18 日电 中国全国人民代表大会代表团和北京市人民委员会代表团 17 日中午乘专机到达南斯拉夫首都贝尔格莱德。这两个代表团是分别应南斯拉夫联邦国民议会和贝尔格莱德市人民委员会的邀请到南斯拉夫访问的。
到飞机场欢迎代表团的有：南斯拉夫联邦国民议会副主席申丘尔茨、联邦院主席沃茨维奇、生产者院主席鲍日契维奇，外交国务秘书处副秘书长维奇，塞尔维亚人民共和国执行委员会主席库塞林诺夫，贝尔格莱德市人民委员会主席米尼奇，以及联邦国民议会两院议员、政府官员和社会各界著名人士等很多人。
中国驻南斯拉夫大使伍修权和大使馆人员也到机场欢迎。
代表团团长彭真和代表团人员走下飞机后同欢迎者亲切地握手并且互相问候。彭真还接受了欢迎者的献花。
在机场休息室里，彭真发表了讲话。他首先代表全中国人民向兄弟的南斯拉夫人民致以崇高的敬意和亲切的问候。他还对南斯拉夫人民的热情欢迎表示衷心的感谢。彭真接着说，南斯拉夫各族人民是热爱自由和勇敢勤劳的人民，是有光荣的革命传统的人民。在第二次世界大战期间，南斯拉夫各族人民在南斯拉夫共产党领导下曾经英勇地进行了反对德、意法西斯侵略者的英勇斗争，终于在苏联和全世界人民的反法西斯斗争的支援下战胜了法西斯侵略者，取得了全国的解放。十多年来，南斯拉夫各族人民在建设社会主义的事业中取得了很大的成就，我们谨致以热烈的祝贺。
彭真说，中国和南斯拉夫是社会主义的兄弟的国家。中、南两国人民在为解放自己的国家和建设自己的国家的奋斗过程中已经建立起兄弟的友谊。还在我们各自进行革命战斗的年代里，我们两国人民就已经相互寄予无限的同情和关怀。自从我们两个国家建立邦交以来，两国间的友好和合作关系在不断地加强和发展。我们代表团这次来访期间，是为了进一步加深我们相互之间的了解和增进我们的友谊，是为了学习你们的先进经验，同时也就是为了加强我们在为和平、民主、社会主义共同事业的斗争中的团结。
彭真强调说，我们之间的团结和合作，以苏联为首的社会主义各国间的团结和合作和这种团结的进一步地巩固和发展，对于我们两国的安全和社会主义建设，对于世界和平和各兄弟国家的社会主义事业都是重要的保障，是中南两国人民和全世界无产阶级及一切爱好和平人民当前最大的利益。这种团结的加强就是世界和平的加强，也就是人类幸福的增进。我们应该重视这种团结，像爱护眼珠一样爱护以苏联为首的社会主义国家的团结。我们重视这种团结和合作的加强。
彭真最后高呼：“南斯拉夫人民共和国万岁！”“中南两国人民的友好合作万岁！”“以苏为首的社会主义各国和全世界一切爱好和平的国家和人民的团结万岁！” 等口号。
随后，中国客人在申丘尔茨的陪同下到梅杰斯托维克饭店休息。
晚间，代表团全体人员到大剧院观看了芭蕾舞剧 “奥赫里德的传奇”。
据新华社贝尔格莱德 18 日电 17 日的贝尔格莱德报纸发表了报道中国全国人民代表大会代表团和北京市人民委员会代表团的言论。它们在评论中表示相信，代表团的访问将对促进彼此间的了解发展两国间的合作有所贡献。报着重地指出，中国和南斯拉夫之间的关系建立在平等，独立、互不涉及和平共处的原则以及献身于社会主义理想这种基础上。

正文文本text_block: 新华社莫斯科 18 日电 中国驻苏联大使刘晓 17 日晚间为中国政府代表团访苏在 “苏维埃” 旅馆举行盛大宴会。
在灯火辉煌的大厅里聚集了将近七百位客人。在贵宾中有苏联共产党和政府的领导人布尔加宁、伏罗希洛夫、卡冈诺维奇、马林科夫、米高扬、萨布罗夫、赫鲁晓夫、穆希金诺夫、谢皮洛夫、什维尔尼克等同志。
出席宴会的还有苏联最高苏维埃主席团副主席塔拉索夫和萨雷耶夫、联盟院主席洛巴诺夫、民族院副主席科马罗夫，以及苏联将军们、作家们、演员们、社会活动家们，各国驻苏联使节，苏联和外国记者们。
莫斯科各界著名人物都应邀来和中国政府代表团会见。
出席招待会的还有目前在莫斯科的由副团长程潜率领的中国全国人民代表大会代表团的一批代表。
宴会进行十分热烈。周恩来总理首先提议为伏罗希洛夫主席、布尔加宁主席和赫鲁晓夫同志的健康和长寿干杯，为即将到来的十月社会主义革命胜利四十周年干杯。周恩来总理并且用俄语说 “干杯”。
布尔加宁主席提议为毛泽东主席、周恩来总理的健康，为中苏两国人民的友谊干杯。他用中国话说 “干杯”。
周恩来总理并和一大群围绕着他的外国记者们热烈交谈，请他们品尝中国特产茅台酒。周恩来总理并和外交使节们进行了亲切的谈话。
赫鲁晓夫接着提议为中国共产党、为中苏两国共产党永恒的友谊、为马克思列宁主义的胜利、为毛泽东同志、刘少奇同志等中共中央政治局的领导人干杯。
宴会在十时半结束。在结束之前，刘晓大使向出席宴会的全体客人表示感谢。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 新华社莫斯科 18 日电 莫斯科各界劳动人民 17 日下午在克里姆林宫举行苏中两国人民友好群众大会，欢迎周恩来总理率领的中华人民共和国政府代表团。周恩来总理、贺龙副总理等同三千多名苏联首都的各界人民代表见了面。
克里姆林宫大门上挂着中苏两国国旗。大会是在宫内庄严、宏伟的会议大厅里进行的。这里是苏联最高苏维埃和苏联共产党举行重要会议的地方。
在大厅主席台正中列宁立体像的两旁，悬挂着苏联和中华人民共和国两国的国旗。主席台对面挂着一幅用中文和俄文写的标语，苏中两国人民永恒的、牢不可破的友谊和合作万岁。
三点多钟，人们已经开始进入克里姆林宫。大厅的正面、楼上都坐满了参加大会的群众。
今天参加大会的，有苏联共产党和政府的领导人布尔加宁、卡冈诺维奇、米高扬、马林科夫、萨布罗夫、赫鲁晓夫、谢皮洛夫、别尔乌辛、什维尔尼克、波斯伯洛夫等同志。还有苏联政府的负责人员，群众组织的代表，劳动英雄、文化科学界人士等。
参加盛会的还有各国外交使节，苏联和外国的新闻记者。
四时正，周恩来总理、贺龙副总理和苏联党和政府领导人走上主席台，这时候，群众一致起立鼓掌，并且欢呼。周恩来总理等也和群众一道热烈鼓掌。
大会由莫斯科市苏维埃执行委员会主席波布罗夫尼科夫主持开幕。当他宣布苏联首都人民热烈欢迎周恩来总理、贺龙副总理和代表团人员的时候，宣布莫斯科人民热烈祝贺苏中两国人民的兄弟友谊的时候，群众一再起立鼓掌。
乐队奏起了中苏两国国歌。
莫斯科的工人、知识分子和青年的代表先后讲话。
莫斯科电灯泡制造厂工人皮欣金代表莫斯科工人向中国朋友和伟大的中国人民致词。他说，你们访问我国是一件使人高兴的大事，因为苏联人民和中国人民是兄弟，同心同德的兄弟，他们是在建设共产主义、争取世界和平和幸福的斗争中的兄弟。
我们所有苏联人都非常注意和关心谦虚、勤劳、英勇的中国人民的巨大的建设工作。我们根据自己的经验了解，中国人民在社会主义建设的道路上还将会遇到不少困难，但是我们相信，中国劳动人民会在自己战斗的共产党的领导下克服这些困难的。在这场为光明的未来的斗争中，中国人民有苏联人民作为他们忠实、无私和真诚的朋友，苏联人民愿意随时帮助、介绍三十九年来积累起来的经验。
接着是莫斯科冶金学院教授彼沃列齐列夫讲话。他说，苏联的科学家和知识分子向伟大的中国人民和英勇的中国共产党致敬。
这位曾经到过中国帮助中国科学家研究编制十二年发展科学规划的技术科学博士说，我们两国的科学家和生产者之间的科学技术合作，对两国的经济联系有着重大的意义。苏联科学家和中国科学家已经展开了合作的巨大工作。在发展国民经济各个部门的联系中，苏联和中国之间有着无限的可能性。这种友谊和合作正在加强整个社会主义阵营。
莫斯科第二钟表制造厂装配工里亚采娃代表莫斯科共青团员和青年讲话。她充满热忱地说，你们的访问更加加强了我们两国人民的友谊，像中国人所说的那种 “比天还高，比海还深” 的友谊。

正文文本text_block: 新华社 18 日讯 苏联文化代表团团长、苏联文化部部长米哈伊洛夫今天在北京举行的记者招待会上说：今天签订的苏中文化合作协定 1957 年执行计划是进一步发展苏中两国之间文化关系的又一个重要的里程碑。
米哈伊洛夫说，1957 年执行计划按其措施的规模来说，大大地超过了过去几年的中苏文化合作的规模。在这个计划范围内我们将要组织五十多起互相访问，其中包括代表团以及个别的科学、文化、艺术工作者。将要参加访问的共有一千人左右。
米哈伊洛夫说，中苏著名的艺术团体将互相访问。新西伯利亚歌舞剧院、哈萨克民族乐队和其他团体将到中国来作巡回演出。到苏联去访问的有大型的中国杂技团和歌舞团。
米哈伊洛夫说，两国作家、画家和雕刻家之间的互相访问将要扩大。在电影方面将要开始共同摄制艺术影片。今年苏联翻译中国书籍的数目将要比去年增加两倍。苏中两国将举办一些艺术展览会。计划还规定了在高等教育、教育和卫生方面的重要措施。
米哈伊洛夫说，在较短的时间内，我们两国在文化和科学方面的联系为什么如此巩固并且得到这么大的规模呢？这是因为这些联系是永恒的、牢不可破的中苏友谊的重要组成部分，因为这些联系是建立在伟大的、不可战胜的马克思列宁主义学说的坚实基础上的。
记者招待会是由文化部副部长张致祥主持的。参加招待会的有中外记者三十多人。

正文文本text_block: 据新华社 18 日讯 中苏文化协定 1957 年执行计划签字仪式今天下午在北京举行。
代表两国政府签字的是中华人民共和国文化部部长沈雁冰和苏联文化部部长米哈伊洛夫。
沈雁冰在举行签字仪式时说：这一计划反映了中苏两国之间文化合作事业的加强和发展，也反映了两国人民的友谊的增进和巩固。
米哈伊洛夫在举行签字仪式时说：我们相信，我们的工作是可以对进一步巩固中苏两国伟大友谊有所贡献的。
参加签字仪式的有苏联文化代表团全体人员，我国文化部副部长钱俊瑞、张致祥，高等教育部副部长刘皑风，卫生部副部长崔义田等。
苏联驻华大使馆临时代办顾德夫、文化参赞李海秋，我国驻苏联大使馆文化参赞张映吾等也参加了签字仪式。
新华社 18 日讯 关于签订中苏文化合作协定 1957 年度执行计划的新闻公报，全文如下：
以中华人民共和国文化部部长沈雁冰为首的中国文化代表团和以苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟文化部部长尼・米哈伊洛夫为首的苏联文化代表团，于 1957 年 1 月 12 日 —18 日在北京在十分友好的气氛中进行了商谈。双方根据 1956 年 7 月 5 日签订的中苏文化合作协定，制订了 1957 年度的文化合作计划。
在商谈中双方满意地指出，在互相尊重国家主权、互不干涉内政、平等互利的原则的基础上，中苏两国之间的文化联系正在日益加强和扩大。几年来中苏文化交流和合作的发展，对于增进两国人民的相互了解和兄弟友谊，起了显著的作用。双方一致认为，有必要在现有基础上进一步发展中苏两国之间的文化合作，这不仅符合于两国人民的利益，并且有助于世界和平事业的巩固。
双方通过商谈，认为应当尽力促使中苏两国相应的科学研究机构、学校、剧院、电影制片厂、出版社、报刊编辑部和其他科学、文化、卫生机构之间，以及两国文化、科学工作者之间，建立并扩大直接联系和有关交换经验、情报、出版物、资料等方面的关系，以便更好地互相了解和运用对方在文化各个方面的成就。
双方还议定，将协助两国的群众文化艺术团体如作家、音乐家、美术家等协会之间加强联系，促使这些团体采取适当的措施来加强他们之间的接触和合作。
双方还就中苏两国之间今后几年的文化合作的远景规划，初步地交换了意见，并且约定将进行有关这个问题的进一步接触。

正文文本text_block: 新华社地拉那 18 日电 以彭真为首的中国全国人民代表大会代表团在阿尔巴尼亚访问了六天后于 17 日上午乘专机离开地拉那。
到机场欢送的有阿尔巴尼亚人民议会主席团主席列希、人民议会主席马尔科、部长会议主席谢胡和党、政、人民团体的领导人。
中国驻阿尔巴尼亚大使徐以新和各国驻阿尔巴尼亚使节也到机场送行。
在机场举行的欢送会上，马尔科请代表团把阿尔巴尼亚人民议会全体议员和阿尔巴尼亚人民的友情转达给六亿伟大的兄弟的中国人民、中国政府和以毛泽东同志为首的中国共产党。他说，我们向你们保证，阿尔巴尼亚人民在劳动党的领导下，将拿出全部力量来更快地建设社会主义的新生活。
彭真接着致答词。他说，通过这次的访问，我们深深地体会到阿尔巴尼亚人民在保卫和平、民主和社会主义事业的斗争中的坚强意志，在建设社会主义事业中朝气勃勃的精神、创造性和积极性。我们体会到兄弟的、英雄的阿尔巴尼亚人民对中国人民的热爱和深厚友谊。我们将把你们的友谊带给中国人民。
新华社地拉那 18 日电 1 月 16 日晚间，中国驻阿尔巴尼亚大使徐以新为中国全国人民代表大会代表团访问阿尔巴尼亚举行招待会。
应邀出席招待会的有阿尔巴尼亚人民议会主席团主席列希、人民议会主席马尔科、部长会议主席谢胡以及阿尔巴尼亚党和政府的其他各领导人、各人民团体负责人等。各国驻阿尔巴尼亚外交使节也应邀出席了招待会。
徐以新大使在招待会上讲话说，这几天代表团完全生活在欢乐愉快的家庭气氛中。通过代表团这次的访问，更进一步加深了中阿两国人民间的相互了解，更加巩固和发展了两国人民间久已存在的亲密的友谊。
彭真团长接着讲话。他热诚感谢阿尔巴尼亚人民议会、政府和阿尔巴尼亚劳动党领导人以及广大人民群众对代表团的热烈欢迎和亲切接待。他还代表中国全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长刘少奇同志邀请阿尔巴尼亚人民议会在它认为适当的时间派遣代表团访问中国。
随后，人民议会主席马尔科讲话。他说，我们向伟大中国的兄弟们和出席招待会的社会主义阵营各国的代表们保证：人民的阿尔巴尼亚同以苏联为首的社会主义阵营各国将永远紧密地联系在一起。我们将根据无产阶级国际主义的原则，尽一切努力加强社会主义阵营的巩固！
部长会议主席谢胡在讲话时感谢中国人民派遣代表团访问阿尔巴尼亚。他说，我希望这是第一次而不是最后一次。
代表团副团长章伯钧和胡子昂也在会上讲了话。
新华社地拉那 17 日电 阿尔巴尼亚劳动党中央委员会政治局委员卡博、别利绍娃、谢胡、马尔科和政治局后补委员托斯卡，16 日在劳动党中央委员会接见了中国共产党中央委员会政治局委员、中央委员会书记彭真和中国共产党中央委员会委员刘长胜。
接见时，中国驻阿尔巴尼亚大使徐以新也在座。
新华社地拉那 16 日电 中国全国人民代表大会代表团继续分批在阿尔巴尼亚各地参观访问。
由副团长胡子昂率领的一批代表访问了都拉斯。在那里，代表们参观了一个烟草工厂，同工厂的工人进行了恳切的谈话，并且还参加了他们的欢迎酒会。随后，代表们游览了都拉斯城的名胜。
另一批代表在副团长章伯钧率领下参观了爱尔巴桑州的柴立克炼油厂。他们在炼油厂受到职工们的热烈欢迎。附近村庄的农业合作社的一些社员也纷纷来到炼油厂欢迎中国客人们。
在 15、16 两日，代表团团员分别和阿尔巴尼亚人民议会、地拉那市人民会议执行委员会、阿尔巴尼亚工会、妇女联合会以及阿尔巴尼亚农业部和交通部的负责人举行座谈，交流了工作情况和经验。

contentList.remark: SAS OFFICERCOMMITTED SUICIDE AFTER BEING SUSPECTED OF KILLING ANOTHER MENTAL DISORDER OR CONSCIENCE DISCOVERY?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Simon Riley, an officer of the Royal Air Force Special Air Service (SAS), was wanted by the police for a serious killing some time ago.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Simon Riley, an officer of the Royal Air Force Special Air Service (SAS), was wanted by the police for a serious killing some time ago.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It is reported that on the night of Christmas, which should be full of joy, Riley brutally killed his mother, his brother's family and the psychologist who consulted them. This series of violent acts quickly aroused strong public indignation and anxiety.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Investigators revealed that Riley may have had serious mental problems before committing the crime, which may be one of the important reasons that led him to the extreme road. However, although people around him may have noticed his abnormality, they failed to take effective measures in time to stop the tragedy.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 隶属于英國皇家空军特种空勤团（SAS）的...
contentList.remark: 隶属于英國皇家空军特种空勤团（SAS）的军官，Simon Riley，前段时间因涉嫌一起严重的杀戮事件而被警方通缉。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 据报道，在圣诞节这个本应充满欢乐的夜晚，...
contentList.remark: 据报道，在圣诞节这个本应充满欢乐的夜晚，Riley残忍地杀害了自己的母亲、弟弟一家以及为其进行心理咨询的心理医生，这一连串的暴力行为迅速引发了公众的强烈愤慨和不安。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 调查人员透露，Riley在作案前可能已存...
contentList.remark: 调查人员透露，Riley在作案前可能已存在严重的精神问题，这或许是导致他走上极端道路的重要原因之一。

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Then his whereabouts finally fell. Unfortunately, when people found his trail, he had committed suicide in his own house.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: After the incident, Riley once disappeared and the investigation was deadlocked.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: What is even more sh...
contentList.remark: What is even more shocking is that before committing suicide, Riley deliberately set fire to the whole house in an attempt to destroy all the evidence that might leave clues.

contentList.name: header
contentList.remark: DECEMBER 31(ST), 2010

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Because of the fierce fire, Riley's body was seriously damaged when rescuers arrived at the scene. Nevertheless, the police and forensic doctors found a barely recognizable military identification card in the ruins through careful search, thus confirming that the identity of the deceased was Simon Riley, who had been wanted for many days.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 然而，尽管周围人可能已察觉到他的异常，却...
contentList.remark: 然而，尽管周围人可能已察觉到他的异常，却未能及时采取有效措施阻止这场悲剧的发生。事发之后，Riley一度销声匿迹，调查陷入了僵局。而后他的行踪终于有了下落。不幸的是，当人们发现他的踪迹时，他已经在自己的住宅内自杀身亡。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: INTENTIONAL ARSON?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This discovery undoubtedly put an end to the investigation of the case, but it also left many unsolved mysteries.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For example, whether the body in the burning mansion is really Riley, and why did he kill his family? But there is no doubt that this case has come to an end in the open.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 更令人震惊的是，在自杀前，Riley还故...
contentList.remark: 更令人震惊的是，在自杀前，Riley还故意纵火，将整个住宅付之一炬，企图销毁所有可能留下线索的证据。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 由于火势猛烈，Riley的尸体在救援人员...
contentList.remark:
由于火势猛烈，Riley的尸体在救援人员赶到现场时已被严重损毁。尽管如此，警方和法医仍然通过仔细搜寻，在废墟中找到了一块勉强可辨认的军用识别牌，从而确认了死者的身份正是通缉多日的Simon Riley。这一发现无疑为案件的侦破工作画上了句号，但同时也留下了诸多未解之谜。例如起火的宅邸里的尸体是否真的是Riley，他又为什么要杀害自己的家人。但无疑本案在明面上已经落下帷幕。

contentList.remark: 宝安日报讯（记者 何冬英 通讯员 团团）2月2日，共青团深圳市宝安区第八届委员会第三次全体会议召开。会议以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入学习贯彻党的二十大及二十届历次全会精神、习近平总书记关于青年工作的重要思想，贯彻落实省、市、区高质量发展大会及相关重要会议部署，全面总结2025年工作，系统谋划2026年重点任务，团结带领全区广大青年为宝安现代化建设贡献青春力量。团区委委员、候补委员，各基层团组织负责人、团属社会组织及青年代表等参加会议。

contentList.remark: 会议审议通过了《共青团深圳市宝安区第八届委员会委员卸免替补递补确认案》及全会决议。

contentList.remark: 委的领导下，宝安共青团持续强化青年思想政治引领，全面推进组织改革创新，深度服务区域发展大局，聚焦青年急难愁盼提升服务实效，各项工作取得显著进展，为宝安高质量发展注入了蓬勃的青春动能。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 会议部署了新一年重点任务。强调要围绕青年...
contentList.remark: 会议部署了新一年重点任务。强调要围绕青年发展型城区建设，聚焦青年住房、就业、教育、婚恋、收入等现实需求，构建协同工作机制，推动出台更多惠青政策。升级青少年诉求响应平台，完善属地化联动服务，切实提升青年获得感、幸福感、安全感。整合社会资源，加强部门协同，营造关心支持青年发展的良好社会氛围。

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: 会议要求，要紧扣青年需求，深化青年夜校、青年驿站等品牌项目，吸引青年扎根宝安。拓展青年创新创业支持平台，大力推进青年AI应用场景

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 建设，优化社会融入体系，丰富文体活动，营...
contentList.remark: 建设，优化社会融入体系，丰富文体活动，营造积极向上、开放包容的青年发展生态，激发青年参与社会治理效能，指建议事平台，鼓励青年为基层治理和城市发展建言献策，服务“百千万工程”，组建青年突击队投身产业发展、社区焕新等一线实践。壮大志愿服务力量，打造服务品牌，引导青年在基层治理、赛会服务、文明提升中发挥积极作用。加强团干部队伍建设，深化理论武装和业务培训，提升政治素养与履职能力。健全联系青年机制，推动团干部深入基层调研，形成创新务实的工作举措，完善团干部培养选拔激励机制，打造信念坚定、能力过硬、作风优良的队伍，为青年工作高质量发展提供坚实组织保障，为宝安加快建设“青年发展型城区”，谱写中国式现代化宝安新篇章贡献磅礴青春力量。

层级主要作用代表企业(示例)在AI生态中的角色
架构设计/IP层创建基础IP和芯片架构cadence定义芯片如何设计，是关键的第一步
芯片设计(无晶圆厂)使用IP设计芯片，但不生产打造高性能芯片(GPU、CPU、ASIC、SoC、网络芯片等)
晶圆制造(代工)在晶圆上制造芯片，使用先进制程最资本密集的环节，将设计变为现实
4设备(生产设备)提供制造芯片所需的机器和工具支撑芯片制造的每一步，是进入的高门槛环节
封装与测试(OSAT)封装、打包并测试芯片以确保可用先进封装是AI芯片(HBM、2.5D/3D等)的关键瓶颈
内存提供内存芯片(DRAM、HBM、NAND)，为AI提供存储与带宽Western Digital.
高效交付与管理芯片和系统所需的电力
连接与网络在芯片、系统和数据中心之间高速传输数据对AI服务器、GPU、电动车等电力效率至关重要
系统与基础设施将芯片集成到服务器、系统和硬件解决方案
云计算/超大规模(终端用户)部署大规模计算基础设施并运行AI应用推动整个AI产业的计算需求
关键要点AI不只是芯片，而是一个完整的生态系统。每一层都至关重要，任何一个环节的瓶颈，都会影响大规模AI的落地。

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We report the results up to \(t=15\,\mathrm{s}\) to analyze the system behavior during and after the occurrence of the unexpected interaction; the performance along the whole trajectory is shown in the video accompanying this paper. Results are shown in Figs. 8 and 9. In all the plots, the time interval during which the external interaction occurs is highlighted with a shaded gray area. The obstacle, which hinders the motion, causes an increase of the tracking error (Fig. 8a), which consequently generates an increase of the pushing force (Fig. 8b). This causes a reduction of the tank energy (Fig. 9a) starting at time \(t=3.83\,\mathrm{s}\) when the collision happens, until the lower bound is reached at time \(t=3.91\,\mathrm{s}\). At this point, the tank deactivates changes in the manipulator velocity set-point generated by MPC via the activation parameter  \(\alpha\)  (Fig. 9b),

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: tracking error begins to increase (Fig. 10a) and the pushing force correspondingly rises in a potentially dangerous manner until the obstacle is removed (Fig. 10b). After the obstacle is removed, the tracking error returns to its nominal values.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The sharp increase in force results from the controller's attempt to reduce the growing tracking error. In the absence of a passivity filter, no mechanism prevents the controller from continuously increasing the pushing force. Such behavior is clearly undesirable, as physical interactions that hinder motion are not intended to be treated as disturbances to be rejected within the proposed framework. Therefore, integrating a passivity filter into non-prehensile pushing is essential to prevent unsafe system responses.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: A. Implementation Details

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We utilize Qwen2.5-VL  $ [3] $  as the VLM backbone. To initialize from the pretrained PTv3 model  $ [69] $ , we use the same model configuration as PTv3-Large. Specifically, there are 5 hierarchical stages with  $ (3,3,3,12,3) $  layers and feature dimensionality of  $ (64,128,256,512,768) $  per stage. The PointACT module, including the hierarchical interaction blocks and the action head, comprises approximately 300M trainable parameters. To maintain the knowledge of the VLM, we keep the VLM backbone frozen if not otherwise mentioned. We crop the input point cloud using a workspace bounding box defined relative to the robot base frame  $ [57,11] $ , and perform voxelization with size of 1cm. We set the maximum number of points as 4096.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Across our experimental benchmarks, the model is trained with a total batch size of 128 distributed across 2 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. We optimize the model for 20K to 50K gradient steps using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of  $ 5 \times 10^{-5} $  and a cosine decay schedule. We apply standard point cloud augmentations, including random rotation around the gravity axis, alongside image-level augmentations for the VLM input during training.

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Fig. 2. The architecture of the proposed FGER-Net is presented, alongside its conceptual underpinnings. The left portion illustrates the biological inspiration for the network: the synergistic function of fast and slow adapting mechanoreceptors in perceiving dynamic and static forces, respectively. These biological principles are emulated by the FGER-Net. In the network itself (center), event streams and image frames are synergistically fused for robust force estimation. In this architecture, frames are used to periodically correct for drift during training and to continuously stabilize the high frequency force predictions derived from the event stream during inference. The resulting force estimation is thereby made accurate and robust against drift, successfully capturing both dynamic and static tactile information, mirroring the perceptual capabilities shown on the right side of the diagram.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: dual rate architecture mirrors biological perception: a high frequency recurrent pathway integrates transient force increments from the event stream, while a low frequency pathway extracts absolute spatial references from single image frames for periodic training corrections.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: During inference, we maximize estimation stability via a continuous correction strategy. By persistently fusing the most recent frame feature with incoming events, this absolute spatial anchor effectively eliminates integration drift.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The architecture utilizes dual parallel pathways optimized for each modality's distinct characteristics. To circumvent the extreme sparsity typical of standard convolutions on event data, individual events are normalized and processed by a pointwise MLP, followed by max-pooling to generate an aggregated feature vector for each packet. Conversely, dense spatial information from image frames is extracted into a compact feature vector using a residual CNN backbone coupled with average pooling.

for  $ m \leftarrow 1 $  to M do

     $ \hat{f}_m \leftarrow \hat{f}_{m-1} + \Delta \hat{f}_m $ 

end for

Fusion and Correction

 $ f_{fusion} \leftarrow \text{concatenate}(\hat{f}_M, f_{frame}) $ 

 $ \Delta f_{corr} \leftarrow \text{MLP}_{\text{corr}}(f_{fusion}) $ 

 $ \hat{f}_{final} \leftarrow \hat{f}_M + \Delta f_{corr} $

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：海上石油平台导管架海生物清洗机器人
院　　系：机械工程学院
成果类别：应用设计类
成果介绍：
       石油平台导管架由于长期浸没在海水中，其表面易附着海生物，影响导管架的使用寿命和安全性。使用潜水员携带清洗设备潜入水下对海生物进行清理的传统方式存在成本高、效率低和安全风险大等缺点。
       团队成员在充分调研实际工况后，提出了磁轮和 Halbach 扇形磁体阵列相结合的磁吸附方案、惯性导航与视觉识别相结合的优化位姿计算方法以及平面反射式全景影像系统，并运用水力空化射流清洗技术，设计了一种新型海生物清理机器人，突破了不同曲率表面吸附力自适应、水下钢结构物表面精确定位、作业环境高清影像获取、海生物快速剥离等导管架表面海生物清理关键技术。
        所研制的海生物清理机器人在东海春晓油气田和平湖油气田成功进行了试验与应用，这也是国内首次使用专用机器人对石油平台导管架海生物进行清洗作业。

contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：管道医生 —— 智能泄漏检测定位球
院　　系：控制科学与工程学院
成果类别：应用设计类
成果介绍：
       智能泄漏检测定位球可搭载各种传感器，它就像个内科医生，为城市地下供水管网系统提供 “胃镜” 检查，不仅检测、定位漏损，还可以对管网进行建模，从而让后续的维修工作有的放矢。
       我国城市供水管网平均漏损率超过 15%，如果漏损率每降低 1 个百分点，每年可节水至少 5 亿立方米，相当于 30 个西湖的水量。然而，目前仍主要以人工听诊和固定传感器的方式进行泄漏检测，很难以低成本的方式对泄漏点进行定位。
       团队设计了一种自漂流式的智能泄漏检测定位球，可从管道内部检测微小泄漏并进行定位，克服传统检测方法的局限性。该定位球采集的指标包括管内声信号、振动等信息，利用多传感器数据融合方法检测微小泄漏，采用组合定位方式实现漏损点定位，通过无线通信方式传输数据至上位机软件可视化处理。该检测球直径仅 10cm，可进入大多数城市地下主管道，具有灵敏度高、成本低的优点。

contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：光电–光声耦合人工光合作用 ——PTC 合成太阳能燃料
院　　系：能源工程学院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       人工光合作用是模拟绿色植物自然光合作用，实现\(\mathrm{H_2O}\)和\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)工业合成碳氢燃料和氧气 (\(\mathrm{O_2}\))，在能量转化过程中同时完成了能量的存储。光子、声子和电子分别是太阳能、热能和电能 / 化学能的能量载流子，转化太阳辐射光子制备的燃料被称为太阳能燃料。立足工程热物理，温度衡量声子品质，频率决定光子能量。诺贝尔物理学奖得主 W. Shockley 根据辐射热力学与光子气体平均自由能进行推导，2500nm 近红外的单色光子和 2000K 的工质具有相同的极限卡诺效率。
       从热力学原理出发，在常温下利用太阳辐射中能量品质较高的紫外–可见光子激发电子产生光致氧空位代替传统高温热致氧空位，再利用长波段低品质具有热效应的可见–红外光激发声子加热，100℃以上即可分解\(\mathrm{H_2O}\)和\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)，国际上首次提出光热化学循环 (Photo–Thermochemical Cycle) 新方法。
       团队提出的 PTC 方法是一项浙江大学完全自主创新的太阳能燃料制备方法，光声–光电耦合实现了太阳能高品质光与低品质热的分级分质利用。

       从热力学原理出发，在常温下利用太阳辐射中能量品质较高的紫外–可见光子激发电子产生光致氧空位代替传统高温热致氧空位，再利用长波段低品质具有热效应的可见–红外光激发声子加热，100℃以上即可分解\(\mathrm{H_2O}\)和\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)，国际上首次提出光热化学循环 (Photo–Thermochemical Cycle) 新方法。
       团队提出的 PTC 方法是一项浙江大学完全自主创新的太阳能燃料制备方法，光声–光电耦合实现了太阳能高品质光与低品质热的分级分质利用。

正文文本text_block: 项目名称：酪氨酸磷酸化修饰调控核酸免疫识别及抗病毒宿主防御的功能与机制研究
院　　系：生命科学研究院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       当病毒入侵我们的身体时，被感染的细胞会识别出这些入侵的敌人并分泌干扰素来通知周围的细胞一起 “保家卫国”。但是，过多的干扰素也会 “蒙蔽” 细胞的 “双眼”，让他们敌我不分，引起自身免疫病。该研究发现了一种全新的预防干扰素过度合成的 “开关”，及时叫停干扰素，就能做到 “攘外” 和 “安内” 的一箭双雕。
       研究在国际上首次从分子、细胞和动物水平上鉴定了酪氨酸磷酸化修饰在调控抗病毒宿主防御中的功能与机制。实验中发现，抗病毒宿主防御中的关键激酶 TBK1 在病毒感染细胞的过程中存在动态的酪氨酸磷酸化修饰。通过激酶文库的筛选，发现 Src 非受体酪氨酸激酶家族中的 Lck/Hck/Fgr 调控了 TBK1 的酪氨酸磷酸化。在动物水平上，鉴定出 Lck/Hck/Fgr 的小分子抑制剂能显著增强动物的抗病毒能力。这一发现为本研究的临床转化和应用提供了重要的实验依据和生物靶标，具有十分重要的研究价值和应用前景。

contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：电驱动软体机器鱼
院　　系：航空航天学院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       软体机器人通常由智能人工肌肉驱动，相比传统的刚性机器人有着较多的优势，尤其在环境适应性和人机交互友好性方面。本项目研究开发了一款可以自带能源和控制系统且游动速度快的软体机器鱼。该机器鱼由介电弹性体驱动，全软体、无电机，且游动速度可以达到 6.4cm/s，也就是 0.69 倍身长，并实现 3h 的长航时。此外，该机器鱼全透明具有很好的隐蔽性，且能够适应 0–70℃的水温环境。该机器鱼可以很好地用于水下探测、侦查以及海洋环境与生物信息监测；大大提高机器鱼的环境适应效果，保证它可以更容易、安全地通过狭窄区域；同时为软体机器人和水下机器人的开发提供更好的指导。

正文文本text_block: 项目名称：硫硒化物核壳阵列材料的设计及其电催化性能应用
院　　系：材料科学与工程学院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       “欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜”，西湖之景，宏观之美，肉眼可见；纳米阵列，形貌多姿，无与伦比。核壳结构，仪态迷人，性能优异，解能源危机；相变结构，空心设计，微量掺杂，一切让纳米妙笔生花。
       本研究通过设计硫硒化物核壳阵列，展现了极佳的电解水性能。实验通过空心设计、相变转化、微量掺杂手段实现了高效的电解水制氢，为电解水制氢及燃料电池等方向提供了新的视野。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：基于 “膜催化活性化” 设计的新型燃料电池膜电极
院　　系：材料科学与工程学院
成果类别：创意研究类
成果介绍：
       燃料电池被誉为第四代发电技术，其中聚合物电解质燃料电池作为军用和民用领域的便携式移动电源均展现出广阔的应用前景，然而其核心部件 —— 离子交换膜尚存在离子传导率低、必须使用贵金属催化剂、燃料渗透严重等亟待解决的关键问题。
       该作品创新性地提出 “膜催化活性化以提高离子传导率并降低燃料渗透率” 的思路。采用过渡金属离子为催化活性物质，利用简单易控的流延成膜法制备具有催化活性的阴离子交换膜，通过系统的电化学测试评价该新型膜的性能，并将该膜应用于燃料电池。该作品制备方法简单易行，无需使用精密贵重仪器且容易放大量产；具有良好的离子传导率和低的燃料渗透率，采用本作品作为电解质膜的燃料电池表现出比杜邦公司出品的 Nafion N117 膜更优秀的性能。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：OTUD1 去泛素化 SMAD7 抑制乳腺癌转移
院　　系：生命科学研究院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       乳腺癌是女性健康的第一大杀手。在中国，每年约 20 万女性死于乳腺癌。肿瘤转移是导致癌症病人死亡的一个极其重要原因，多达 90% 的实体瘤患者死于肿瘤转移。
       为探究新的转移关键因子，团队建立了小鼠体内肿瘤转移模型，通过体内筛选去泛素化酶 shRNA 文库，发现了一个新的肿瘤转移抑制因子 OTUD1，进一步揭示了 OTUD1 通过调控 SMAD7 抑制 TGF-β 信号的分子机制。为临床预防肿瘤恶化和抗癌药物的研究提供了重要的理论支持。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName:
正文文本text_block: 项目名称：光驱微纳运输系统研究
院　　系：光电科学与工程学院
成果类别：论文著作类
成果介绍：
       还记得《星际迷航》电影中，一束激光将太空舰船捕获并拉过去的场景吗？团队通过联合光力与光泳力，在实验上实现了在微纳光纤 (“导轨”) 上用光推拉一个微米金片 (“微型火车”) 来回运动。
       传统的片上实验室运输系统基于微流控芯片，工作环境为溶液。能在空气中运行的新型光力驱动运输系统的研制很有必要但非常困难，主要是微纳结构由于小尺寸效应，当其置于物体表面，会受到非常大的短程吸引力，难以利用光在导轨表面将微纳物体驱动。该项目设计了新颖的拉锥微纳光纤结构，结合光力和光泳力，克服了这一难点，实现了在空气中的光驱动微纳运输。
       该项目首次实现微纳物体在空气中有轨运输，并联合光力和光泳力两种光致力实现微纳结构的来回驱动，验证了反直觉的光致拉力的存在，推动了光力操纵的多元化发展。

院　　系：农业与生物技术学院
成果类别：创意研究类
项目介绍：
       干旱是一个全球性的逆境，严重制约作物生产。为了适应陆地的干旱环境，植物经亿万年进化，形成了复杂的根系、庞大的维管系统、可主动调节的气孔以及角质层和木质素等耐旱体系。
       植物气孔是植物进化过程中的一项伟大 “发明”，通过调节二氧化碳吸收与水分蒸腾影响全球碳和水循环，估计每年通过气孔大约吸收 123 亿吨二氧化碳和 33 亿吨水。虽然气孔仅占叶表面积的 5%，但由此发生的蒸腾作用则是植物消耗水分的主要途径。普遍认为，调节植物叶片气孔关闭程度，控制水分散失，是植物抵抗干旱胁迫的重要方式之一。禾本科植物因其独特的气孔结构及高效的气孔调节使得这类植物具有更强的耐旱性，并被人类选为主根作物栽培。
       本研究首次系统地提出了禾本科作物气孔高效调节理论，对作物育种、水资源利用率提高具有重要意义。

Van Herpen has worked with Materialise on several collections, including Lucid.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: with viewers. For one dress, van Herpen created an ultralight weave of stainless steel, which she then hand-burnished to create shades of orange, yellow, purple and blue, evoking the colors of interstellar nebulae.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Beesley described their collaborations as focused on finding the best techniques for fabricating individual components. "The dialogues are on the one hand practical—laser-cutting and clipping or adhesions or thermal processes," he said. Vanessa Palsenbarg, a representative of the 3-D printing company Materialise, wrote in an email that these collaborations can take on a life of their own, "to inspire our other customers—in the automotive, consumer goods, aerospace and other industries." Beesley, too, believes their value goes beyond exploding the conventions typically associated with fashion design by using cutting-edge techniques and materials. "The fertility of these dialogues is that friends in multiple disciplines are exchanging ideas and opening the sense of what the applications can be," he went on. "What could a dress be? What could clothing offer? It is a wondrous meditation on how we relate to other people, and to the world."

contentList.name: footnote
contentList.remark: Van Herpen’s work can be seen in two shows overlapping this month: “Iris van Herpen: Transforming Fashion,” a retrospective of her work at the High Museum, will run until May 15. “Manus x Machina,” a show exploring how designers have reconciled innovations in machine-made clothing with craftsmanship and handiwork, opens May 5 at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York.

正文文本text_block: LONDON, Nov. 10.—Both the former German Emperor and his eldest son, Frederick William, crossed the Dutch frontier Sunday morning, ac-cording to advices from The Hague. His reported destina-tion is De Steeg, near Utrecht.
The former German Em-peror's party, which is believed to include Field Marshal von Hindenburg, arrived at Eysden, [midway between Liége and Maastricht,] on the Dutch fron-tier, at 7:30 o'clock Sunday morning, according to Daily Mail advices.
 Practically the whole Ger-man General Staff accompanied the former Emperor, and ten automobiles carried the party.The automobiles were bristling
with rifles, and all the fugitives were armed.
The ex-Kaiser was in uni-form. He alighted at the Eys-den station and paced the plat-form, smoking a cigarette.
Many photographs were taken of the members of the Imperial party. On the whole
the people were very quiet, but Belgians among them yelled out "En voyage a Paris"（Are
you on your way to Paris?）
Chatting with the staff, the former Em-peror, the correspondent says,did not look in the least dis-tressed. A few minutes later an imperial train, including res-taurant and sleeping cars, ran into the station. Only servants were aboard.
The engine returned to Vise,Belgium, and brought back a second train, in which were a large number of staff officers and others, and also stores of food.
The preparations began for the departure at 10 o'clock this morning, but at 10:40 o'clock the train was still at Eysden.
The blinds of the train were all drawn.
The Daily Mail remarks that, if the party arrived in Holland armed, all of them must be in-terned.

正文文本text_block: AMSTERDAM, Nov. 10.—I learn on very good authority that the Kaiser made a determined effort to stave off abdication. He went to headquarters with the deliberate intention of bringing the army around to his side. In this he failed miserably.
His main support consisted of a number of officers, nearly all of Prussian regiments, who formed themselves into two regiments and placed themselves at his Majesty's disposal. To do anything with such support was seen, of course, to be Gilbertian.
During the night the Kaiser called the Crown Prince, Hindenburg, and General Gröner to him, and the consultation lasted a couple of hours. Both officers strongly pressed the Kaiser to bow to the inevitable, and Hindenburg informed him that any more delay in coming to a decision to abdicate would certainly have the most terrible consequences and lead to serious events in the army. For those consequences Hindenburg said he must refuse responsibility.
The Crown Prince, it is said, was the first to give way. General Gröner fully supported Hindenburg's view, but when the conference broke up the Kaiser remained unconvinced of the advisability of abdication. He is said to have come to his final decision an hour or so later, after several communications had reached him from Berlin and after another short and stormy talk with Hindenburg.
Meanwhile, his son-in-law, the Duke of Brunswick, for himself and his heir, had abdicated. "Brunswick's Fated Chieftain" was forced without fighting to abdicate. Reports have it that the republican movement in Brunswick, which long before the war was chafing under autocratic conditions, began to be noticed even before it was set in motion at Kiel.

正文文本text_block: LONDON, Nov. 10 Emperor William signed his letter of abdication on Saturday morning at the German Grand Headquarters in the presence of Crown Prince Frederick William and Field Marshal Hindenburg, according to a dispatch from Amsterdam to the Exchange Telegraph Company.
The Crown Prince signed his renunciation of the throne shortly afterwards.
Before placing his signature to the document, an urgent message from Philipp Scheidemann, who was a Socialist member without portfolio in the Imperial Cabinet, was handed to the Emperor. He read it with a shiver. Then he signed the paper, saying:
"It may be for the good of Germany."
The Emperor was deeply moved. He consented to sign the document only when he got the news of the latest events in the empire.
The ex-kaiser and former Crown Prince were expected to take leave of the troops on Saturday, but nothing had then been settled regarding their future movements.

" Wilhelm II., the reigning King of the monarchy of Württemberg, abdicated on Friday night."
A Wolff Bureau dispatch from Stuttgart, by way of Amsterdam, says that the King has issued a proclamation saying that his person would never serve to hinder the development of the wishes of the people.

正文文本text_block: LONDON, Nov. 10.—The greater part of Berlin is in control of revolutionists, the former Kaiser has fled to Holland,and Friedrich Ebert, the new Socialist Chancellor, has taken command of the situation. The revolt is spreading throughout Germany with great rapidity.
Dispatches received in London today announce these startling developments. The Workmen's and Soldiers' Council is now administering the municipal government of the German capital.
The War Ministry has submitted, and its acts are valid only when countersigned by a Socialist representative. The official Wolff telegraphic agency has been taken over by the Reds.
The red flag has been hoisted over the royal palace and the Brandenburg Gate. The former Crown Prince's palace is also in possession of the revolutionists.
There was severe fighting in Berlin between 8 and 10 o'clock last night and a violent cannonade was heard from the heart of the city.

正文文本text_block: BERLIN, Nov. 9, (German Wireless to London, Nov. 10)—(Associated Press.)—The German People's Government has been instituted in the greater part of Berlin. The garrison has gone over to the Government.
The Workmen's and Soldiers' Council has declared a general strike. Troops and machine guns have been placed at the disposal of the Council. Guards which had been stationed at the public offices and other buildings have been withdrawn.
Friedrich Ebert (Vice President of the Social Democratic Party) is carrying on the Chancellorship.
The text of a statement issued by the People's Government reads:
In the course of the forenoon of Saturday the formation of a new German People's Government was initiated. The greater part of the Berlin garrison, and other troops stationed there temporarily, went over to the new Government.
The leaders of the deputations of the Social Democratic Party declared that they would not shoot against the people. They said they would, in accordance with the People's Government, intercede in favor of the maintenance of order. Thereupon in the offices and public buildings the guards which had been stationed there were withdrawn.
The business of the Imperial Chancellor is being carried on by the Social Democratic Deputy, Herr Ebert.
It is presumed that, apart from the representatives of the recent majority group, three independent Social Democrats will enter the future Government.

正文文本text_block: BERNE, Nov. 10, (Associated Press.)—In an address to the people, the new German Chancellor, Friedrich Ebert, says:
Citizens: The ex-Chancellor, Prince Max of Baden, in agreement with all the Secretaries of State, has handed over to me the task of liquidating his affairs as Chancellor. I am on the point of forming a new Government in accord with the various parties, and will keep public opinion freely informed of the course of events.
The new Government will be a Government of the people. It must make every effort to secure in the quickest possible time peace for the German people and consolidate the liberty which they have won.
The new Government has taken charge of the administration, to preserve the German people from civil war and famine and to accomplish their legitimate claim to autonomy. The Government can solve this problem only if all the officials in town and country will help.
I know it will be difficult for some to work with the new men who have taken charge of the empire, but I appeal to their love of the people. Lack of organization would in this heavy time mean anarchy in Germany and the surrender of the country to tremendous misery. Therefore, help your native country with fearless, indefatigable work for the future, every one at his post.
I demand every one’s support in the hard task awaiting us. You know how seriously the war has menaced the provisioning of the people, which is the first condition of the people’s existence. The political transformation should not trouble the people. The food supply is the first duty of all, whether in town or country, and they should not embarrass, but rather aid, the production of food supplies and their transport to the towns.
Food shortage signifies pillage and robbery, with great misery. The poorest will suffer the most, and the industrial worker will be affected hardest. All who illicitly lay hands on food supplies or other supplies of prime necessity or the means of transport necessary for their distribution will be guilty in the highest degree toward the community.
I ask you immediately to leave the streets and remain orderly And calm.

正文文本text_block: By The Associated Press.
WASHINGTON, Monday, Nov. 11, 2:48 A.M.—The armistice between Germany, on the one hand, and the allied Governments and the United States, on the other, has been signed.
The State Department announced at 2:45 o'clock this morning that Germany had signed.
The department's announcement simply said: “The armistice has been signed.”
The world war will end this morning at 6 o'clock, Washington time, 11 o'clock Paris time
The armistice was signed by the German representatives at midnight.
This announcement was made by the State Department at 2:50 o'clock this morning.
The announcement was made verbally by an official of the State Department in this form:
“The armistice has been signed. It was signed at 5 o'clock A. M., Paris time, [midnight,
New York time,] and hostilities will cease at 11 o'clock this morning, Paris time, [6 o'clock, New York time.]
The terms of the armistice, it was an-nounced, will not be made public until later.
Military men here, however, regard it as cer-tain that they include:
Immediate retirement of the German military forces from France, Belgium, and
Alsace-Lorraine. 
Disarming and demobilization of the Ger-man armies.
Occupation by the allied and American forces of such strategic points in Germany as
will make impossible a renewal of hostilities.
Delivery of part of the German High Seas Fleet and a certain number of submarines to the allied and American naval forces.
Disarmament of all other German warships

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: Apple's life cycle assessment methodology

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: When conducting a product life cycle assessment (LCA), we calculate greenhouse gas emissions using the 100-year time horizon global warming potentials (GWP100) from the 2023 IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6), $ ^{1} $  including biogenic carbon.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: There is inherent uncertainty in modeling greenhouse gas emissions due primarily to data limitations. For the top component contributors to Apple's greenhouse gas emissions, Apple addresses this uncertainty by developing detailed process-based environmental models with Apple-specific parameters. For the remaining elements of Apple's carbon footprint, we rely on industry average data and assumptions.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The following details the five steps we use to conduct our LCA:

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: PRODUCT LCA PROCESS

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: How Apple conducts our product greenhouse gas life cycle assessment

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: To model the manufacturing phase

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We use part-by-part measurements of the entire product along with data on part production. In some cases where part-by-part data is not readily available, we also use design-level data for size and weight detail. The measurements help us accurately determine the size and weight of the components and materials in the product, while data on manufacturing processes and yield loss during production allows us to account for the impact of manufacturing. The LCA includes accessories and packaging, as well as decreased emissions through Apple's Supplier Clean Energy Program. When calculating Apple's comprehensive carbon footprint, we also include units that are repaired and replaced through AppleCare.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: To model transportation

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We use data collected on shipments of single products and multipack units by land, sea, and air. We account for transporting materials between manufacturing sites; transporting products from manufacturing sites to regional distribution hubs; transporting products from regional distribution hubs to individual customers; and transporting products from final customers to recycling facilities.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: To model customer use

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We measure the power consumed by a product while it is running in a simulated scenario. Daily usage patterns are specific to each product and are a mixture of actual and modeled customer use data. For the purposes of our assessment, years of use, which are based on first owners, are modeled to be four years for macOS, visionOS, and tvOS devices and three years for iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS devices. Most Apple products last longer and are often passed along, resold, or returned to Apple by the first owner for others to use. More information on our product energy use is provided in our Product Environmental Reports.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: To model end of life...
contentList.remark: To model end of life

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We use material composition data on our products and estimate the ratio of products that are sent to recycling or disposal. For products sent to recycling, we capture the initial processing by the recycler to prepare the product for recovery of electronic, metal, plastic, and glass material streams. Subsequent downstream recycling processes are not included, as these are considered stages of production and not end-of-life processing. For products sent to disposal, we capture the emissions associated with landfilling or incineration of each type of material.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Putting it all together

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: After we collect data about manufacturing, use, transportation, and end of life, we combine it with detailed greenhouse gas emission data. This emission data is based on a combination of Apple-specific and industry-average data sets for material production, manufacturing processes, electricity generation, and transportation. Renewable energy used in the supply chain, initiated by suppliers independently or through the Apple Supplier Clean Energy Program, is also accounted for within the LCA model. Combining product-specific information with emission data in our LCA allows us to compile detailed results for greenhouse gas emissions as they relate to each product. The data and modeling approaches are checked for quality and accuracy by the Fraunhofer Institute in Germany.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 5.2 Map

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The MAP function establishes the context to frame risks related to an AI system. The AI lifecycle consists of many interdependent activities involving a diverse set of actors (See Figure 3). In practice, AI actors in charge of one part of the process often do not have full visibility or control over other parts and their associated contexts. The interdependencies between these activities, and among the relevant AI actors, can make it difficult to reliably anticipate impacts of AI systems. For example, early decisions in identifying purposes and objectives of an AI system can alter its behavior and capabilities, and the dynamics of deployment setting (such as end users or impacted individuals) can shape the impacts of AI system decisions. As a result, the best intentions within one dimension of the AI lifecycle can be undermined via interactions with decisions and conditions in other, later activities.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 4. Mathematical Preliminaries

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For some transformations of the AES algorithms specified in Sec. 5, each byte in the state array is interpreted as one of the 256 elements of a finite field, also known as a Galois Field, denoted by  $ \mathrm{GF}(2^{8}) $ .  $ {}^{1} $

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: In order to define a...
contentList.remark: In order to define addition and multiplication in  $ \mathrm{GF}(2^{8}) $ , each byte  $ \{b_{7}b_{6}b_{5}b_{4}b_{3}b_{2}b_{1}b_{0}\} $  is interpreted as a polynomial, denoted by  $ b(x) $ , as follows:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For example,  $ \{01100011\} $  is represented by the polynomial  $ x^{6} + x^{5} + x + 1 $ .

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 4.1 Addition in GF $ 2^{8} $

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: In order to add two ...
contentList.remark: In order to add two elements in the finite field  $ \mathrm{GF}(2^{8}) $ , the coefficients of the polynomials that represent the elements are added modulo 2 (i.e., with the exclusive-OR operation, denoted by  $ \oplus $ ), so that  $ 1 \oplus 1 = 0 $ ,  $ 1 \oplus 0 = 1 $ , and  $ 0 \oplus 0 = 0 $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Equivalently, two bytes can be added by applying the exclusive-OR operation to each pair of corresponding bits in the bytes. Thus, the sum of  $ \{a_{7}a_{6}a_{5}a_{4}a_{3}a_{2}a_{1}a_{0}\} $  and  $ \{b_{7}b_{6}b_{5}b_{4}b_{3}b_{2}b_{1}b_{0}\} $  is  $ \{a_{7}\oplus b_{7}a_{6}\oplus b_{6}a_{5}\oplus b_{5}a_{4}\oplus b_{4}a_{3}\oplus b_{3}a_{2}\oplus b_{2}a_{1}\oplus b_{1}a_{0}\oplus b_{0}\} $ . (In Section 5.1.4, this definition is extended to words.)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For example, the following three representations of addition are equivalent:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Because the coefficients of the polynomials are reduced modulo 2, the coefficient 1 is equivalent to the coefficient -1, so addition is equivalent to subtraction. For example,  $ x^{4} + x^{2} $  represents the same finite field element as  $ x^{4} - x^{2} $ ,  $ -x^{4} + x^{2} $ , and  $ -x^{4} - x^{2} $ . Similarly, the sum of any element with itself is the zero element.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 4.2 Multiplication in \(GF(2^{8})\)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The symbol • denotes multiplication in  $ \mathrm{GF}(2^{8}) $ . Conceptually, this multiplication is defined on two bytes in two steps: 1) the two polynomials that represent the bytes are multiplied as polynomials, and 2) the resulting polynomial is reduced modulo the following fixed polynomial:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Within both steps, the individual coefficients of the polynomials are reduced modulo 2.

contentList.name: footnote
contentList.remark: $ ^{1} $ Information about the properties of finite fields can be found in textbooks, such as Michael Artin's Algebra [4].

contentList.remark: D.4 CYBER RESILIENCY IMPLEMENTATION APPROACHES

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This section identifies representative cyber resiliency approaches to implementing cyber resiliency techniques. A cyber resiliency approach is a subset of the technologies and processes included in a cyber resiliency technique and is defined by how the capabilities are implemented or how the intended consequences are achieved. Table D-4 lists each cyber resiliency technique, representative approaches that can be used to implement the technique, and representative examples. Where possible, examples are drawn from discussions associated with the controls and control enhancements in [SP 800-53], even when these controls or enhancements do not directly support cyber resiliency as described in Appendix E. However, [SP 800-53] does not address all approaches or all aspects of any individual approach. Therefore, some examples are drawn from system reliability and system resilience practices and technologies and/or from emerging cyber resiliency technologies. The set of approaches for a specific technique is not exhaustive and represents relatively mature technologies and practices. Thus, technologies emerging from research can be characterized in terms of the techniques they apply while not being covered by any of the representative approaches.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Diodes protect the ADC inputs from electrostatic discharge (ESD) events that occur during the manufacturing process and during printed circuit board (PCB) assembly when manufactured in an ESD-controlled environment. If the inputs are driven below AVSS – 0.3 V, or above AVDD1 + 0.3 V, the protection diodes may conduct. If these conditions are possible, use external clamp diodes, series resistors, or both to limit the input current to the specified value.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The input multiplexer offers the option of normal or reverse input signal polarities. The multiplexer also provides two internal test modes to help verify ADC performance. The offset test mode is used to verify noise and offset error by providing a short to the ADC inputs. The resulting noise and offset voltage data are evaluated by the user. CMRR performance is tested using the CMRR test mode by applying a CMRR test signal to the AINP input. The resulting CMRR test data are also evaluated by the user. Table 8-1 shows the switch configurations of the input multiplexer circuit of Figure 8-3.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The device has optional input precharge buffers to reduce the charge required by capacitor  $ C_{IN} $  during the input sampling phase. When the capacitor is near full charge, the precharge buffers are bypassed ( $ S_{7} $  and  $ S_{8} $  of Figure 8-3 in up positions). The external signal driver then provides the fine charge to the capacitor. At the completion of the sample phase, the sampling capacitor is discharged by the modulator to complete the cycle, at which time the sample process repeats. The buffers reduce the transient input current required to charge  $ C_{IN} $ , therefore reducing the settling time requirement of the signal. Incomplete settling of the input signal can lead to degraded ADC performance. The input buffers are enabled by the AINP_BUF and AINN_BUF bits of the CONFIG1 register. In many cases, if AINN is tied to ground or to a low-impedance fixed potential, the AINN buffer can be disabled to reduce power consumption.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: With the input precharge buffers disabled, the charge required by the input sampling capacitor can be modeled as an average input current flowing into the ADC inputs. As shown in Equation 14 and Equation 15, the input current is comprised of differential and absolute components.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Input Current (Differential Input Voltage) = \(f_{\mathrm{MOD}}\cdot C_{\mathrm{IN}}\cdot 10^{6}\,(\mu\mathrm{A}/\mathrm{V})\)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: where:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • \(f_{\mathrm{MOD}}=f_{\mathrm{CLK}}/2=12.8\,\mathrm{MHz}\) (high-speed mode), \(1.6\,\mathrm{MHz}\) (low-speed mode)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: •  $ C_{IN} = 7.4\ pF $  (1x input range), 3.6 pF (2x input range)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Input Current (Absolute Input Voltage) =  $ f_{MOD} \cdot C_{CM} \cdot 10^{6} (\mu A/V) $

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: where:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • \(f_{\mathrm{MOD}}=f_{\mathrm{CLK}}/2=12.8\,\mathrm{MHz}\) (high-speed mode), \(1.6\,\mathrm{MHz}\) (low-speed mode)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: •  $ C_{CM} = 0.35 $  pF (1x input range), 0.17 pF (2x input range)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For  $ f_{MOD} = 12.8  MHz $ ,  $ C_{IN} = 7.4  pF $ , and  $ C_{CM} = 0.35  pF $ , the input current resulting from differential voltage is  $ 95  \muA/V $  and the input current resulting from the absolute voltage is  $ 4.5  \muA/V $ . For example, if \(\mathrm{AINP}=4.5\,\mathrm{V}\) and \(\mathrm{AINN}=0.5\,\mathrm{V}\), then  $ V_{IN} = 4  V $ . The total AINP input current =  $ (4  V \cdot 95  \muA/V) + (4.5  V \cdot 4.5  \muA/V) = 400  \muA $ , and the total AINN current is  $ (-4  V \cdot 95  \muA/V) + (0.5  V \cdot 4.5  \muA/V) = -378  \muA $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The charge demand of the input sampling capacitor requires the signal to settle within a half cycle at the modulator frequency  $ t = 1 / (2 \cdot f_{\mathrm{MOD}}) $ . To satisfy this requirement, the driver bandwidth is typically required to be much larger than the original signal frequency. The bandwidth of the driver can be determined to be sufficient when the THD and SNR data sheet performance are achieved. In the low-speed mode of operation, the modulator sampling is eight times slower, therefore more time is available for driver settling.
