contentList.remark: Fourier transform - Wikipedia

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For most functions f that occur in practice, R is a bounded even function of the time-lag  $ \tau $  and for typical noisy signals it turns out to be uniformly continuous with a maximum at  $ \tau = 0 $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The autocorrelation function, more properly called the autocovariance function unless it is normalized in some appropriate fashion, measures the strength of the correlation between the values of f separated by a time lag. This is a way of searching for the correlation of f with its own past. It is useful even for other statistical tasks besides the analysis of signals. For example, if  $ f(t) $  represents the temperature at time t, one expects a strong correlation with the temperature at a time lag of 24 hours.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: It possesses a Fourier transform,

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ P_{f}(\xi)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}R_{f}(\tau)e^{-i2\pi\xi\tau}d\tau. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This Fourier transform is called the power spectral density function of f. (Unless all periodic components are first filtered out from f, this integral will diverge, but it is easy to filter out such periodicities.)

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The power spectrum, as indicated by this density function P, measures the amount of variance contributed to the data by the frequency  $ \zeta $ . In electrical signals, the variance is proportional to the average power (energy per unit time), and so the power spectrum describes how much the different frequencies contribute to the average power of the signal. This process is called the spectral analysis of time-series and is analogous to the usual analysis of variance of data that is not a time-series (ANOVA).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Knowledge of which frequencies are "important" in this sense is crucial for the proper design of filters and for the proper evaluation of measuring apparatuses. It can also be useful for the scientific analysis of the phenomena responsible for producing the data.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The power spectrum of a signal can also be approximately measured directly by measuring the average power that remains in a signal after all the frequencies outside a narrow band have been filtered out.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Spectral analysis is carried out for visual signals as well. The power spectrum ignores all phase relations, which is good enough for many purposes, but for video signals other types of spectral analysis must also be employed, still using the Fourier transform as a tool.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Other notations

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Other common notations for  $ \widehat{f}(\xi) $  include:

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \tilde{f}\left(\xi\right),F(\xi),\mathcal{F}\left(f\right)\left(\xi\right),\left(\mathcal{F}f\right)\left(\xi\right),\mathcal{F}(f),\mathcal{F}\{f\},\mathcal{F}\{f(t)\},\mathcal{F}\big\{f(t)\big\}. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In the sciences and engineering it is also common to make substitutions like these:

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \xi\to f,\quad x\to t,\quad f\to x,\quad\widehat{f}\to X. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: So the transform pair  $ f(x) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\Longleftrightarrow} \widehat{f}(\xi) $  can become  $ x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{F}}{\Longleftrightarrow} X(f) $

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A disadvantage of the capital letter notation is when expressing a transform such as  $ \widehat{f} \cdot g $  or  $ \widehat{f}^{\prime} $ , which become the more awkward  $ F\{f \cdot g\} $  and  $ F\{f^{\prime}\} $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In some contexts such as particle physics, the same symbol f may be used for both for a function as well as it Fourier transform, with the two only distinguished by their argument I.e.  $ f(k_{1} + k_{2}) $  would refer to the Fourier transform because of the momentum argument, while  $ f(x_{0} + \pi\vec{r}) $  would refer to the original function because of the positional argument. Although tildes may be used as in  $ \tilde{f} $  to indicate Fourier transforms, tildes may also be used to indicate a modification of a quantity with a more Lorentz invariant form, such as  $ \tilde{dk} = \frac{dk}{(2\pi)^{3}2\omega} $ , so care must be taken. Similarly,  $ \widehat{f} $  often denotes the Hilbert transform of f.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The interpretation of the complex function  $ \hat{f}(\xi) $  may be aided by expressing it in polar coordinate form

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \widehat{f}(\xi)=A(\xi)e^{i\varphi(\xi)} $$

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Mach-Zehnder interferometer

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) illustrates the concepts of superposition and interference with linear algebra in dimension 2, rather than differential equations. It can be seen as a simplified version of the double-slit experiment, but it is of interest in its own right, for example in the delayed choice quantum eraser, the Elitzur–Vaidman bomb tester, and in studies of quantum entanglement. $ ^{[36][37]} $

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: We can model a photo...
contentList.remark: We can model a photon going through the interferometer by considering that at each point it can be in a superposition of only two paths: the

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Schematic of a Mach–Zehnder interferometer

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: "lower" path which starts from the left, goes straight through both beam splitters, and ends at the top, and the "upper" path which starts from the bottom, goes straight through both beam splitters, and ends at the right. The quantum state of the photon is therefore a vector  $ \psi \in C^{2} $  that is a superposition of the "lower" path  $ \psi_{l} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} $  and the "upper" path  $ \psi_{u} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} $ , that is,  $ \psi = \alpha \psi_{l} + \beta \psi_{u} $  for complex  $ \alpha, \beta $ . In order to respect the postulate that  $ \langle \psi, \psi \rangle = 1 $  we require that  $ |\alpha|^{2} + |\beta|^{2} = 1 $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Both beam splitters are modelled as the unitary matrix  $ B = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \begin{pmatrix} 1 & i \\ i & 1 \end{pmatrix} $ , which means that when a photon meets the beam splitter it will either stay on the same path with a probability amplitude of  $ 1/\sqrt{2} $ , or be reflected to the other path with a probability amplitude of  $ i/\sqrt{2} $ . The phase shifter on the upper arm is modelled as the unitary matrix  $ P = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & e^{i\Delta\Phi} \end{pmatrix} $ , which means that if the photon is on the "upper" path it will gain a relative phase of  $ \Delta\Phi $ , and it will stay unchanged if it is in the lower path.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A photon that enters the interferometer from the left will then be acted upon with a beam splitter B, a phase shifter P, and another beam splitter B, and so end up in the state

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ B P B\psi_{l}=i e^{i\Delta\Phi/2}\binom{-\sin(\Delta\Phi/2)}{\cos(\Delta\Phi/2)}, $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: and the probabilities that it will be detected at the right or at the top are given respectively by

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ p(u)=\left|\langle\psi_{u},B P B\psi_{l}\rangle\right|^{2}=\cos^{2}\frac{\Delta\Phi}{2}, $$

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ p(l)=|\langle\psi_{l},B P B\psi_{l}\rangle|^{2}=\sin^{2}\frac{\Delta\Phi}{2}. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: One can therefore use the Mach–Zehnder interferometer to estimate the phase shift by estimating these probabilities.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Типы функционалов качества

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: При обучении с учителем — функционал качества может определяться как средняя ошибка ответов. Предполагается, что искомый алгоритм должен его минимизировать. Для предотвращения переобучения в минимизируемый функционал качества часто в явном или неявном виде добавляют регуляризатор.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: При обучении без учителя — функционалы качества могут определяться по-разному, например, как отношение средних межкластерных и внутрикластерных расстояний.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: При обучении с подкреплением — функционалы качества определяются физической средой, показывающей качество приспособления агента.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Сфера применений машинного обучения постоянно расширяется. Повсеместная информатизация приводит к накоплению огромных объёмов данных в науке, производстве, бизнесе, транспорте, здравоохранении. Возникающие при этом задачи прогнозирования, управления и принятия решений часто сводятся к обучению по прецедентам. Раньше, когда таких данных не было, эти задачи либо вообще не ставились, либо решались совершенно другими методами.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Being Critical

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: As an academic writer, you are expected to be critical of the sources that you use. This essentially means questioning what you read and not necessarily agreeing with it just because the information has been published. Being critical can also mean looking for reasons why we should not just accept something as being correct or true. This can require you to identify problems with a writer's arguments or methods, or perhaps to refer to other people's criticisms of these. Constructive criticism goes beyond this by suggesting ways in which a piece of research or writing could be improved.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 一次辛苦的旅行

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: My sister was fond o...
contentList.remark: My sister was fond of traveling. Ever since graduating, she had been determined to organize a trip to an old temple. Since transporting fare was expensive, she decided to use a bicycle to cycle there not caring about the disadvantages. Her stubborn attitude was always her shortcoming. Once she made up her mind to do something, no one could persuade her to change her mind. Finally, we gave in as usual though we preferred to take a train. After we prepared everything, including the schedule, reliable weather forecast and the insurance, we began our trip.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我的妹妹很喜欢旅行。自从毕业以来，她就下...
contentList.remark: 我的妹妹很喜欢旅行。自从毕业以来，她就下定决心要组织一次往一座古庙的旅行。因为交通费用昂贵，她决定骑自行车去，毫不担心其中的不利情况。顽固的态度一直都是她的缺点，一旦她下定决心要做的事，就没有人能说服她改变主意。最后，我们像往常一样让步，尽管我们更喜欢乘火车去，我们准备好了所有东西，包括时间表、可靠的天气预报，还有保险，就开始了旅程。

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our journey was along a river flowing from a high altitude. Our pace was slow because the river frequently had many sharp bends through deep valleys, where the water seemed to boil. Just as I recorded in my journal, it was really a hard journey. But we also enjoyed great views. One night, I put my head on my pillow—a parcel of wool coats, and lay beneath the stars. When the flame in front of our cave went out at midnight, I found the sky so beautiful!

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
时间：佛教创立于公元前6世纪。创始人乔达摩·悉达多，后来被称为“释迦牟尼”。
早期佛教反对第一等级婆罗门地特权，提出“众生平等”，不拒绝低种姓的人入教；同时，佛教宣扬“忍耐顺从”，得到国王和一些富人的支持。信仰佛教的民众日益增多，佛教一度成为印度最重要的宗教之一$^{\textcircled{1}}$。

contentList.name: abstract
contentList.remark: 传播：公元前3世纪后，佛教开始向外传播。公元前1世纪，佛教经中亚传到中国新疆，再传入中国内地，后又传到朝鲜、日本和越南等国。佛教往南经锡兰$^{\textcircled{2}}$，传到缅甸、泰国、柬埔寨等国。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 地震前，水井和运河里的污水都涨涌起来。但...
contentList.remark: 地震前，水井和运河里的污水都涨涌起来。但是却没人判断出地震即将来临。霎那间，一切都在摇晃，似乎整个世界就要结束。数以百万的砖房和许多水坝遭到破坏；铁路轨道都变成无用的铁条；煤矿管道纷纷爆裂，发出有臭味的蒸汽；到处都有骑车的人被巨大的裂缝陷住。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 第二天，所有报纸都纷纷以大字标题或主要标...
contentList.remark: 第二天，所有报纸都纷纷以大字标题或主要标题报道了这一事件。记者们描述了灾难的大概情况，全国都被地震的破坏和灾民们极度的苦难所震惊。当人们读到幸存者以“恭喜啊，你还活着。”来互相安慰时，都被感动了。人们不仅衷心地表达了他们的同情，而且还立刻组织起来帮助灾民。伤员被救助了，死者被埋葬了，吓坏的幸存者被从废墟中挖出来了，栖身处、学水和电力也很快得到提供。多亏了人们的帮助，灾区的损失被减到了最小。

contentList.fullName: text: 此外，社会、教育和文化促使强化某些关于孤...
contentList.remark:
此外，社会、教育和文化促使强化某些关于孤独的非理性信念。

Society has a tendency to think that if someone is 40 years old and living alone, there's something wrong.

社会有一种倾向，如果一个人40岁了，仍在独自生活，那就有问题了。

However, it should be realized that the central problem tends to be the belief surrounding it.

然而，应该认识到，核心问题往往是围绕它的信念。

In other words, the problem isn't loneliness itself, it's what's said about it, how it's interpreted, and the meaning it's given.

换句话说，问题不在于孤独本身，而在于人们对它说了什么，如何解释它，以及它被赋予的意义。

Today, we live in crowded places and are incredibly connected to each other, thanks to social media.

如今，多亏了社交媒体，我们生活在拥挤的地方，彼此之间有着难以置信的联系。

Nevertheless, it may be that this isn't enough for you, and you feel alone because you're single or live completely alone.

然而，这对你来说可能还不够，你会感到孤独，因为你单身或者完全独居。

However, as we mentioned earlier, that isn't the problem.

然而，正如我们之前提到的，这不是问题。

It's your way of seeing it and the dialogue you're having with yourself about it that's the issue.

问题在于你看待它的方式和你与自己的对话。

That's what makes you feel anxious, depressed, and empty inside.

这就是让你感到焦虑、沮丧和内心空虚的原因。

Obviously, if you tell yourself a hundred times a day or more, that being alone is a terrible thing, that nobody loves you, and you'll end up dying alone, your emotions will be extremely intense and you'll feel dreadful because of these ideas and thoughts that don't even correspond with reality.

显然，如果你每天告诉自己一百次或更多次，孤独是一件可怕

记  $ \triangle ABC $  的内角 A, B, C 的对边分别为 a, b, c，已知  $ \frac{\cos A}{1 + \sin A} = \frac{\sin 2B}{1 + \cos 2B} $ .

(1) 若  $ C = \frac{2\pi}{3} $ ，求 B;

(2) 求  $ \frac{a^{2} + b^{2}}{c^{2}} $  的最小值.

【解析】 $ \frac{\sin 2B}{1 + \cos 2B} = \frac{2\sin B\cos B}{2\cos^{2}B} = \frac{\sin B}{\cos B} = \frac{\cos A}{1 + \sin A} $ 

 $ \Rightarrow \sin B + \sin B\sin A = \cos B\sin A $ 

 $ \Rightarrow \sin B = \cos B\cos A - \sin B\sin A = \cos (B + A) = -\cos C $ 

 $ \because B, C \in (0, \pi), \therefore \sin B > 0 \Rightarrow \cos C < 0, C > \frac{\pi}{2}, B \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) $ 

 $ \sin B = \sin\left(C - \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \Rightarrow B = C - \frac{\pi}{2} $  或  $ B + C - \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi $  (舍)

(1)  $ B = C - \frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{\pi}{6} $ 

(2) 因为我们有角的关系，我们将边化为角： $ A = \pi - B - C = \frac{\pi}{2} - 2B; C = \frac{\pi}{2} + B $ 

由正弦定理： $ \frac{a^{2} + b^{2}}{c^{2}} = \frac{\sin^{2}A + \sin^{2}B}{\sin^{2}C} \Rightarrow \frac{\cos^{2}B + \sin^{2}B}{\cos^{2}B} = \frac{(2\cos^{2}B - 1)^{2} + 1 - \cos^{2}B}{\cos^{2}B} $ 

令  $ x = \cos^{2}B, x \in (0, 1) $ 

 $ \frac{a^{2} + b^{2}}{c^{2}} = \frac{(2x - 1)^{2} + 1 - x}{x} = \frac{4x^{2} - 5x + 2}{x} = 4x + \frac{2}{x} - 5 \geqslant 2\sqrt{8} - 5 = 4\sqrt{2} - 5 $ 

 $ 4x = 2\sqrt{2} \Rightarrow x = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} $  时取等号

(12分)

如图，直三棱柱  $ ABC-A_{1}B_{1}C_{1} $  的体积为  $ 4, \triangle A_{1}BC $  的面积为  $ 2\sqrt{2} $ .

(1) 求 A 到平面  $ A_{1}BC $  的距离；

(2) 设 D 为 A,C 的中点， $ AA_{1}=AB $ ，平面  $ A_{1}BC \perp $  平面  $ ABB_{1}A_{1} $ ，求二面角 A-BD-C 的正弦值.

【解析】(1) 等体积法：设 A 到平面  $ A_{1}BC $  的距离为 h

 $ V_{A_{1}-ABC} = V_{A-A_{1}BC} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{3} \cdot 4 = \frac{1}{3} S_{\Delta A_{1}BC} \cdot h \Rightarrow h = \sqrt{2} $ 

(2) 大家应该都能看出  $ BC \perp $  平面  $ ABB_{1}A_{1} $  也就是很多人没证出来.

建系的这个说明是必要的. 取  $ A_{1}B $  中点 M，连 MD

 $ AA_{1} = AB, AA_{1} \perp AB \Rightarrow AM \perp A_{1}B $ ，又平面  $ A_{1}BC \perp $  平面  $ ABB_{1}A_{1} $  则  $ AM \perp $  面  $ A_{1}BC, BC \subset $  面  $ A_{1}BC \Rightarrow AM \perp BC $ ，又  $ AA_{1} \perp BC \Rightarrow BC \perp $  面  $ ABB_{1}A_{1} \Rightarrow BC \perp AB $  （省略了一点步骤，大家考场中不要省）

作  $ MN \perp BD $ ，连 AN，易证  $ \angle MNA $  即为  $ A_{1}-BD-A $  的平面角，也是二面角 A-BD-C 的补角，两者正弦值相等.

图中各关系都易求， $ BD = \sqrt{3} $ ，等面积法求  $ MN = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{3}}, AN = \frac{2\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{3}} $ 

 $ \sin \angle MNA = \frac{AM}{AN} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} $

不等式的性质 (1) \(a>b,\ b>c \Rightarrow a>c\)； 两个实数的顺序关系：
\(\begin{aligned} a > b &\iff a - b > 0 \\ a = b &\iff a - b = 0 \\ a < b &\iff a - b < 0 \end{aligned}\)
(2) \(a>b,\ c>0 \Rightarrow ac>bc\)；\(a>b,\ c<0 \Rightarrow ac<bc\)；
(3) \(a>b \Rightarrow a+c>b+c\)；
(4) \(a>b,\ c>d \Rightarrow a+c>b+d\)； \(a > b \iff \dfrac{1}{a} < \dfrac{1}{b}\) 的充要条件是 \(ab > 0\).
(5) \(a>b>0,\ c>d>0 \Rightarrow ac>bd\)；
(6) \(a>b>0,\ n\in \mathbb{N}^{*},\ n>1 \Rightarrow a^n>b^n,\ \sqrt[n]{a}>\sqrt[n]{b}\)
一元二次不等式 解一元二次不等式实际上就是求出对应的一元二次方程的实数根（如果有实数根），再结合对应的函数的图象确定其大于零或者小于零的区间，在含有字母参数的不等式中还要根据参数的不同取值确定方程根的大小以及函数图象的开口方向，从而确定不等式的解集。
基本不等式 \(\sqrt{ab}\le \dfrac{a+b}{2}\ (a>0,b>0)\) \(a+b\ge 2\sqrt{ab}\ (a,b>0)\)；\(ab\le \left(\dfrac{a+b}{2}\right)^2\ (a,b\in \mathbb{R})\)；\(\dfrac{2ab}{a+b}\le \sqrt{ab}\le \dfrac{a+b}{2}\le \sqrt{\dfrac{a^2+b^2}{2}}\ (a,b>0)\)；\(a^2+b^2\ge 2ab\)
二元一次不等式组 二元一次不等式 \(Ax+By+C>0\) 的解集是平面直角坐标系中表示 \(Ax+By+C=0\) 某一侧所有点组成的平面区域。二元一次不等式组的解集是指各个不等式解集所表示的平面区域的公共部分。
简单的线性规划 基本概念 约束条件 对变量 \(x,y\) 的制约条件。如果是 \(x,y\) 的一次式，则称线性约束条件。
目标函数 求解的最优问题的表达式。如果是 \(x,y\) 的一次式，则称线性目标函数。
可行解 满足线性约束条件的解 \((x,y)\) 叫可行解。
可行域 所有可行解组成的集合叫可行域。
最优解 使目标函数取得最大值或者最小值的可行解叫最优解。
线性规划 在线性约束条件下求线性目标函数的最大值或者最小值的问题。
问题解法 不含实际背景 第一步 画出可行域。 注意区域边界的虚实。
第二步 根据目标函数几何意义确定最优解。
第三步 求出目标函数的最值。
含实际背景 第一步 设置两个变量，建立约束条件和目标函数。 注意实际问题对变量的限制。
第二步 同不含实际背景的解法步骤。

contentList.remark: 对中国传统文化元素的仿制和复制是在现代环境艺术设计中最为常用的一种艺术设计手法。这是一种通过对传统文化上的一些视觉形态进行设计，然后有机地结合到现代环境艺术设计中去，并通过新的设计组合形式进行思想和情感的表达。另外，设计人员还可以从传统文化角度出发进行创新，一方面保留传统文化所蕴含的神韵，同时还能够具备现代艺术所特有的潮流，最终完美地反映出想要表达的精神状态以及思想情感。当前艺术环境下，还存在有部分传统图形、格局直接在环境艺术设计中安置。这种艺术形式的表达，充分地展现了传统文化元素与现代环境艺术的有机结合。

contentList.fullName: text: 在现代民族环境艺术设计中，更多的是继承传...
contentList.remark: 在现代民族环境艺术设计中，更多的是继承传统的文化元素，然后在传统文化元素的基础上进行创新。在现代艺术设计，使传统民族文化元素与现代审美理念相互融合，所设计出的环境艺术作品不仅有现代艺术色彩，而且不失传统文化气息的底蕴，其中比较典型的设计是民族文化宫，他的设计旨在突出民族风情展览，但同时也融入了现代人文特色与传统文化特点，通过运用现代化材料和构建，将传统的文化理念彰显出来。让人在感受到民族传统文化韵味的同时，也能体验到现代建筑风格的优美，一方面能够实现对传统文化元素的继承，另一方面还能针对传统文化展开优化和创新，另外，这种表现形式，还能够加深人们对现代环境艺术中传统元素的视觉了解。

contentList.name: vertical_text
contentList.remark: 人物小传

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: ■ 保尔具有顽强的生命力和坚定的革命意志...
contentList.remark: ■ 保尔具有顽强的生命力和坚定的革命意志，他具有钢铁般的意志和不畏牺牲的乐观主义精神。一次又一次的伤病弄得他几乎无法工作时，他依然坚持拒绝接受国家的抚恤和照顾。找到了新的工作后，保尔一刻也不停得跟上无产阶级的步伐。

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: ■ 保尔·安德烈耶维奇·柯察金，简称保尔·柯察金，出生于乌克兰舍佩托夫卡镇贫穷的铁路工人家庭。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 保尔·柯察金长着一对黑眼睛和乌黑的头发，...
contentList.remark: 保尔·柯察金长着一对黑眼睛和乌黑的头发，皮肤黝黑。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 保尔·柯察金爱憎分明，具有高度的革命自觉...
contentList.remark:
保尔·柯察金爱憎分明，具有高度的革命自觉性。人出身工人家庭，从小在贫穷和饥饿中长大，生活底层的苦难培育了他鲜明的阶级爱憎，激发了他强烈的反抗精神。少年保尔的反抗带有明显的自发性质，在接受布尔什维克党的教育之后，才把这种自发的反抗精神升华为自觉斗争。
保尔在同阶级敌人斗争的同时，还不断向自己的头脑中残存的旧思想开战。刚参军的保尔缺乏组织纪律的观念，但在革命斗争中保尔很快克服了自己的缺点，严格服从党的安排，成为一个自觉的共产主义战士。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName:
text: 保尔·科察金为人们的影响很大。他在小说
...
contentList.remark:
保尔·科察金为人们的影响很大。他在小说
中展现出苏俄内战时期与敌人斗争的精神、坚
忍不拔的意志和对党的忠贞，是斯大林时期的
无产阶级英雄榜样。
保尔的精神和他光辉的形象影响着一代又
一代的青少年，并对读者们产生了重要的现实
意义。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “人生万事须自为，跬步江山即寥廓”中，自...
contentList.remark: “人生万事须自为，跬步江山即寥廓”中，自为的意思是：自己去做；跬步：半步；寥廓：宽广。这两句诗的意思是，人生的许多事情都要靠自己去做，只要自己向前迈出一步，就可以进入一个无比广阔的世界。

contentList.fullName: text: 不安定清静就不能为实现远大理想而长期刻苦...

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Hal ini menyebabkan ramai pelajar tidak mempunyai capaian kepada bantuan kesihatan mental yang diperlukan dan ini sering menyebabkan masalah mereka menjadi semakin teruk.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Bagaimanapun di sebalik semua cabaran itu, kesedaran mengenai kesihatan mental perlu dibuat secara berterusan. Masih terdapat banyak langkah yang boleh diambil untuk tujuan itu.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Antaranya, IPT sendiri perlu program berkaitan isu itu seperti bengkel kemahiran menguruskan tekanan, ceramah dan klinik kesihat an mental.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Selain itu, pihak IPT perlu menyediakan sokongan yang mencukupi kepada pelajar, termasuk sokongan kewangan dan sumber bantuan kesihatan mental.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Keduanya, pelajar universiti perlu didedahkan dengan pengetahuan mengenai kesihatan mental dan cara untuk menguruskan kesihatan mental mereka sendiri.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Selain itu, adalah penting untuk mengurangkan stigma dan diskriminasi terhadap masalah kesihatan mental dalam kalangan pelajar universiti di Malaysia.

contentList.remark:
2. 光明小学师生100人共画了100幅画，老师1人画3幅，学生3人画1幅，画画的老师、学生各有多少人？
分组法
1个老师和3个学生画的画的幅数： $ 3+1=4 $ （幅）
共100幅画，每4幅为一组，共分的组数： $ 100\div4=25 $ （组）
老师： $ 25 \times 1 = 25 $  (人) 学生： $ 25 \times 3 = 75 $  (人)

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 3. 鸡、兔共笼，鸡比兔多26只，脚数共...
contentList.remark:
3. 鸡、兔共笼，鸡比兔多26只，脚数共有274只，鸡、兔各有多少只？
分组法
去掉26只鸡，脚数减少 $ 26 \times 2 = 52 $ 只
脚数共剩下： $ 274 - 52 = 222 $ 只
把1只鸡和1只兔看作1组
每组里脚数： $ 2 + 4 = 6 $ 只
222只脚可分成： $ 222 \div 6 = 37 $ 组
鸡： $ 37 \times 1 + 26 = 63 $ 只 兔： $ 37 \times 1 = 37 $ 只

分组法
1个大和尚和3个小和尚共吃的馒头个数： $ 3+1=4 $  (个)
共100个馒头，每4个馒头为一组，共分的组数： $ 100\div4=25 $  (组)
大和尚： $ 25 \times 1 = 25 $  (人)
小和尚： $ 25 \times 3 = 75 $  (人)

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: Neuroscience evidence counters a rape myth

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Ebani Dhawan & Patrick Haggard

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Victims frequently report immobility during rape and sexual assault, often using the term 'freezing'. Neuroscientific evidence suggests fear and threat can block cortical neural circuits for action control, leading to involuntary immobility. Defence arguments that blame victims for freezing are thus inappropriate and unjust.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Rape and sexual assault (collectively, RSA) are distinctive types of aggressive and criminal human behaviour that are overwhelmingly committed by men and directed at women. Thirty per cent of women have experienced RSA in their lifetime. The burdens of RSA on individuals and whole societies are extensive, but the subject is often hidden. For example, in England and Wales the police recorded over 70,000 rapes in 2021–2022 but only 3% led to a charge. Neuroscientific contributions to public debate over RSA have been limited.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Consent and rape myths

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Legal definitions of RSA are based on the absence of consent. However, establishing consent or lack thereof is challenging. Victims' reports of non-consent are often questioned in court. Legal actors in RSA cases are susceptible to stereotypes (referred to here as 'rape myths') about how a 'real' victim would behave.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: One common rape myth $ ^{1} $  involves a perpetrator claiming that he had assumed consent from the absence of clear attempts by the victim to resist: 'why didn't she struggle?' Although struggle and violence play no part in formal legal definitions of RSA in many countries, rape myths such as this continue to influence the thinking of jurors, lawyers and judges, and of wider society. Box 1 gives indicative examples of these misogynistic arguments, which seek to transfer the blame for RSA from the perpetrator to the victim.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The 'why didn't she struggle?' argument is based on a cognitive model of intentional action that underlies all criminal law. Healthy adult humans are assumed to have voluntary control over their actions and to carry out their actions intentionally. Mens rea (conscious intention) makes agents responsible for their actions and consequences. Philosophical and legal arguments hold that one may also be responsible for omitting to act – that not acting may be intentional in the same way that acting is intentional. In the case of RSA, this argument incorrectly assumes that the victim could have resisted or fled the attacker, yet she intentionally decided not to do so.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: The neuroscience of involuntary immobility

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: We argue that the as...
contentList.remark: We argue that the assumption that victims intentionally choose immobility over resistance is neuroscientifically incorrect. We suggest that RSA victims may remain immobile because of an involuntary neural response to threat $ ^{1} $  that blocks the brain circuits that provide voluntary control over body movement.

When asked why she froze, [she] answered "I don't know, I'd said, 'stop' and he wasn't stopping so I — if he just did what he had to do, then he'd — he — he would just leave." (ref. 20).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Further, legal discussions of the involuntary immobility response may involve an inappropriate double standard. The law has long recognized 'loss of control' defences and can accord diminished responsibility in specific situations in which evidence suggests that actions are made outside of voluntary control. These include some medical conditions such as sleep disorders, but also extreme situations of coercive control, and emotional triggering.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: To be consistent, legal systems should likewise recognize that the omission of action may also sometimes be involuntary. An involuntary immobility response may prevent a victim of RSA from responding by escaping or deterring the aggressor. This does not imply that the victim ought to make such actions: obligations and responsibilities in RSA lie with the aggressor, and not with the victim. Improved legal understanding of neuroscientific evidence regarding involuntary immobility during RSA could prevent inappropriate victim-blaming, and potentially draw wider societal attention to the crucial importance of active consent. Clearly, it is also possible to be voluntarily immobile without actively consenting, but our aim here is to draw attention to the frequency, mechanism and legal implications of involuntary immobility.

contentList.name: table
contentList.remark:
描写方法 作用 答题格式
外貌描写 揭示人物的思想品质、精神风貌和性格特点。 描写了……的样子，表现了……。
语言描写 刻画人物性格，揭示人物的内心世界。 ……的语言，生动、传神地展示了……的内心，表现了……。
动作描写 展示人物的精神面貌、情感特征、性格气质，可使人物具有活力，相相如生。 运用……的词语，生动、准确地刻画了……。
心理描写 挖掘人物的思想感情，尤其是复杂的心理刻画，更能揭示人物的精神世界。 ……等词句写出了……，表现了……。
环境描写 交代事情发生的地点或背景，增加事情的真实性；渲染气氛，烘托人物的心情；反映人物的性格品质；为下文埋下伏笔，推动情节的发展；深化作品主题。 ①……的景物描写，渲染了……的景色（环境），烘托了人物……的性格和品质；②……的景物描写，结合人物心理活动，表现了人物……的性格（精神）；③……的景物描写，反映了……的情景，为全文定下了……的感情基调。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: 14. 表现手法的类型、概念及作用...
contentList.remark: 14. 表现手法的类型、概念及作用

contentList.name: table
contentList.remark:
表现手法 概念 作用
照应 在内容上有着极其密切的关系，是对同一情况做出解释、说明、交代。 使文章浑然一体，情节完整，结构严谨，中心突出。
象征 通过特定的容易引起联想的具体形象，表现某种概念、思想和感情的艺术手法。 ①把抽象的事理表现为具体的可感知的形象；②可以使文章更含蓄，运用眼前之情，寄托深远之意。
对比 把两个相反、相对的事物或同一事物相反、相对的两个方面放在一起，用比较的方法加以描述或说明。 有利于充分显示事物的矛盾，突出被表现事物的本质特征，增强文章的艺术效果和感染力。
详略 详写，是指对能直接表现中心意思的主要材料加以具体的叙述和描写；略写，是指对虽然与表现中心意思有关但不是直接表现中心意思的材料，少用笔墨，进行概括式的叙述。 ①有详有略，主次分明，突出重点；②充实内容，突显中心；③或借墨如金，或用墨如淡，参差变化，描写多姿。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 美术实习是门“老牌”课程，伴随着建筑系创...
contentList.remark: 美术实习是门“老牌”课程，伴随着建筑系创建而开设。而今年，这门已有33年历史的课程增添了许多“思政味儿”。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 每年夏天，建筑系即将升大三的同学们会跟随...
contentList.remark: 每年夏天，建筑系即将升大三的同学们会跟随两位老师，前往有着丰富建筑特色以及文化底蕴的青岛、厦门、宏村、庐山等地。在那里，他们对照实习地点的真实景物，综合运用前两年所学习的素描、速写、水彩、水粉等美术知识，在完成建筑风景、自然风景、创作型风景和建筑风景小品的创作过程中，熟练掌握各类绘画技巧，深化对绘画艺术理论知识的理解，进一步提高艺术修养。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 之前的美术实习课程，在深入集中培训绘画技...
contentList.remark: 之前的美术实习课程，在深入集中培训绘画技巧的同时，两位老师就将了解实习地的人文地理背景、提高学生的艺术修养、丰富学生的文化底蕴积累，作为重要教学目标。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “美术实习课本身就非常适合‘课程思政’，...
contentList.remark: “美术实习课本身就非常适合‘课程思政’，两者的结合，大大提升原有的美术实习课程的思想内涵，更是通过美术课程的特色，以图文并茂的形式，丰富思想政治课程的外延。”蔡萌说。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 受到疫情影响，今年的美术实习无法集中开展...
contentList.remark: 受到疫情影响，今年的美术实习无法集中开展，采用学生根据实际情况选择实习地点，老师通过网络进行远程指导的方式。但这种不得已而为之的方法，却带来意想不到的惊喜效果。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 分散在全国各地的44位同学，独立寻找和捕...
contentList.remark: 分散在全国各地的44位同学，独立寻找和捕捉身边的人文古迹、红色遗迹，用笔尖的水墨色彩挖掘人文建筑背后的历史文化脉络和革命价值观导向，藉着走出去、看过来、画进去的学习过程，在训练绘画技巧专长的同时，更体悟和升华爱国之情。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 从重庆歌乐山到山西吕梁“高家沟高级军事会...
contentList.remark: 从重庆歌乐山到山西吕梁“高家沟高级军事会议”旧址，从遂昌王村口根据地到中共满洲省委旧址，从镇海林则徐故居到海防遗址……同学们的脚步跨越半个中国，调研的内容更丰富，角度也更多元。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 作为土生土长的杭州人，刘佳琪去到了富阳龙...
contentList.remark: 作为土生土长的杭州人，刘佳琪去到了富阳龙门古镇。在她的调研报告上，中间的古镇鱼眼全景图角度特别、非常吸睛，而全景图的下方，则是她用钢笔淡彩

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 描绘的古镇党建三馆——廉政文化馆、两岸交...
contentList.remark: 描绘的古镇党建三馆——廉政文化馆、两岸交流馆和孙晓梅烈士故居。“孙晓梅烈士的故事深深震撼了我。她没比我大几岁，却可以为了保卫家国光荣牺牲，身在和平年代的我，要积极向党组织服务，为了祖国的美好明天奋斗！”刘佳琪说。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “大家聊起上海，张口都是魔都、国际化都市...
contentList.remark: “大家聊起上海，张口都是魔都、国际化都市、快节奏，但是我认为，上海不应该只是摩登的，不应该只是迪士尼、陆家嘴，我想要去探索它的过去，去寻访那些民主主义革命时期的救亡图存人士留在上海的碎片。”带着这样的初衷，李帆去到了徐汇区的武康路，用建筑美学语言将宋庆龄故居、黄兴故居进行表达。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 1949年解放前夕，驻嘉兴的国民党陆军预...
contentList.remark: 1949年解放前夕，驻嘉兴的国民党陆军预备干部局所属训练团第一总队在嘉兴发动起义，在国民党心脏地区打响重要一枪。基于对这个场景的想象，胡玥琪创作了《嘉兴起义》：士兵们搬上梯子，爬上屋顶，手举红旗，向人们号召解放和起义。“画面采用了较深较灰的主题色调，重点突出了红旗的鲜亮，象征着起义志士的热血与决心。”胡玥琪介绍。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 今年的作品提交形式也有一定变化。除了上交...
contentList.remark: 今年的作品提交形式也有一定变化。除了上交10张水彩/水粉和20幅速写外，同学们还需要将10张左右最有代表性的作品汇编到一张调研报告上。调研报告最终以课程展览的形式跟大家见面，一开展就吸引了全校师生的目光，受到广泛好评。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 蔡萌多次感叹，这次课改尝试让带课老师非常...
contentList.remark: 蔡萌多次感叹，这次课改尝试让带课老师非常惊喜。她说，集中上课转为分散实践，实质上将“由上而下的传输”变为“自下而上的探索”。学生们主动寻找、挖掘、体悟革命历史文化，让价值引导、思想引领的教学目标更具真实性、生动性、合理性。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 而对于课程思政，蔡萌也有自己的理解。“在...
contentList.remark: 而对于课程思政，蔡萌也有自己的理解。“在信息获取高度便利的今天，面对学习能力强大的青年学子，浙大老师不能止步于回答‘学什么’，更为重要的是启发‘为什么学’，要做学生精神上的引路人。”她说，美术本就有疗愈功能，从教给学生如何画好一棵树的比例出发，到引导他们保持积极乐观的生活态度，再到培育青年学子健康向上的世界观、价值观、人生观，这就是老师的责任所在。

contentList.fullName: text: 当时一看到西南联大，就想起了我们浙大文军...
contentList.remark: 当时一看到西南联大，就想起了我们浙大文军长征的历史，所以想借着这样的机会去感受相似的故事。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 当真正开始调研后，我发现并不容易。当年三...
contentList.remark: 当真正开始调研后，我发现并不容易。当年三校迁来是租场地办学，所以整个学校也是四散分布。我实地调研了云南师范大学里的旧址主体和昆明周边的几个乡镇，同时也在网上查找了一些当年留下来的旧照片作为绘画的素材。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 进了师范大学的旧址，看到当年留下来的那个...
contentList.remark: 进了师范大学的旧址，看到当年留下来的那个茅草土坯校舍和里面那些老旧的桌椅，能够想象出当年教学环境的艰苦。同时可以看到现在在旧址上新建的现代化教学楼。两者相比，产生了一种很强烈的新与旧的冲突感，而这种对比其实也是两个时代的对比。所以我采用黑白速写的方式去还原当年的旧貌，又用水彩来勾勒当下的繁荣，同时对那些留存于昆明大街小巷里的教授故居，我也用水彩的方式来记录他们如今的面貌。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 经过这次调研，我感受到了当时虽然身处战乱...
contentList.remark: 经过这次调研，我感受到了当时虽然身处战乱但仍然弦歌不辍的家国情怀。也想到一代人有一代人的历史使命，无论是西南联大的“刚毅卓坚”，还是浙大的“求是”精神，这种对于民族文化的坚持，使得国家危难之际，一批批教育的精粹得以汇聚，最终又开花结果，将培养出的种子播撒出去，为国家民族的建设做出了贡献。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我也认识到，无论是战争年代，还是和平时期...
contentList.remark: 我也认识到，无论是战争年代，还是和平时期，教育都是国家的重中之重，作为新时代大学生的我们也应该把个人的命运与国家、民族的命运联结在一起，心中不断叩问竺校长的两个问题，承担起肩上的使命与重任！

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我的家乡在湖南邵阳隆回。说起近代家乡的革...
contentList.remark: 我的家乡在湖南邵阳隆回。说起近代家乡的革命人物，我最先想到的就是魏源先生。作为近代中国“睁眼看世界”的首批知识分子代表，魏源先生率先提出“师夷长技以制夷”的主张，在近代中国掀起思想的浪潮，开启了对西方世界探索的大门。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 身为魏源家乡人，我却还从未去过先生的故居...
contentList.remark: 身为魏源家乡人，我却还从未去过先生的故居，这也是一直以来的一个遗憾。所以，我把本次调研的地点定在了魏源故居，趁此机会去看看这位伟人到底有怎样的不凡。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我们从县城驱车三个多小时才找到这个藏在大...
contentList.remark: 我们从县城驱车三个多小时才找到这个藏在大山和农田里的小瓦房。说实话，第一眼看到它我是有点失望的，这和我想的有点不一样。这样一个名留青史的大人物不应该住在雕梁画栋的大宅子里吗？眼前这个小小的、荒草丛生、藏在穷乡僻壤的土坯四合院实在有些掉档次了。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 但是进屋后，当我看到先生从幼时的深夜苦读...
contentList.remark: 但是进屋后，当我看到先生从幼时的深夜苦读，到做官后革新图强、兴办实业等一系列举措后，再来看这残破的故居，才更加感叹先生的见识卓越，面对列强侵华的的举国危机，生于草野，却能放眼世界。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 当我走出故居后，想到当下世界正处于疫情下...
contentList.remark: 当我走出故居后，想到当下世界正处于疫情下百年未有之大变局，中国也面临着来自西方国家和种种威胁。百年后的危机再现，我们作为当代青年，更应该像魏源先生一样，有着放眼世界的眼光和勇于探索的精神，才能在这变局中为祖国贡献自己的光和热。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 建筑1801班 华颖

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 我调研的主题是红巷幽幽，薪火不息。红巷就...
contentList.remark: 我调研的主题是红巷幽幽，薪火不息。红巷就是杭州市上城区的小营巷，巷子里留存着许多红色革命记忆：它是太平天国时期的听王府，是杭州最高指挥部；它是中共杭州小组成立纪念馆所在地；它因为爱国卫生运动开展得好，在1958年接受了毛主席的视察；著名科学家钱学森先生的故居也坐落于此……

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 调研以及排版中，我都以时间为主线，由于小...
contentList.remark: 调研以及排版中，我都以时间为主线，由于小营巷中有很多建筑，我主要选择了中共杭州小组纪念馆和毛主席视察小营巷纪念馆为中心。这次的美术实习虽然很遗憾没有办法像往常一样和同学一起写生，但是通过自己实地走访的形式也让我收获了很多。让作为一个杭州人的我第一次深刻地了解了杭州的红色革命记忆。以前想到红色革命景点只会想到嘉兴南湖、上海一大会址这些，却忽略了去挖掘与探索杭州本地的红色印记。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 此外，经历新冠疫情这样一个特殊时期之后再...
contentList.remark: 此外，经历新冠疫情这样一个特殊时期之后再了解爱国卫生运动，我有了很大的共鸣：当时的爱国卫生运动是为了让全国人民都能养成良好健康的卫生习惯，这一点在现在依然重要，并且这场疫情让我更深刻的体会到了我们现在健康安定的生活都是无数人、尤其是无数的共产党员在替我们负重前行，健康安定就是对毛主席视察小营巷时的殷切期待交出的最好答卷，国泰民安就是最好的生活！

contentList.remark: 未来的家是什么样的？建筑健康、智能家居、生命周期住宅……一个个理念从提出到实施，凝聚在“小七帆和她的筑建宝宝”团队的参赛作品《生生不息》的图纸和模型之中。如何满足现代人对住房的需求，设计人们理想中的家，这个年轻的团队交出了诚意满满的答卷。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: “全生命周期住宅”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 家是生活的容器，承载着我们度过漫长的岁月...
contentList.remark: 家是生活的容器，承载着我们度过漫长的岁月。从二人世界到三口之家，从与父母同住到陪伴子女成长，一生中的角色不断变化，家的格局也需要发生相应改变。为此，团队确定了“全生命周期住宅”这一设计主题，囊括五大户型，让住宅随着家庭的变化一起长大，让每一阶段的住宅满足该阶段住户的不同需求。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “小七帆”首先设计了满足好友轰趴聚会的“...
contentList.remark: “小七帆”首先设计了满足好友轰趴聚会的“嗨翻青春”和满足高品质生活青年的“书香之家”，这两个户型专为单身青年打造。“我们的设计聚焦在一家人的故事，嗨翻青春’的女住户和‘书香之家’的男住户因房

contentList.name: text

contentList.remark: 子相邻而相识相爱，他们很快结婚并诞下爱情的结晶，‘融融之家’就诞生了。”2018级建筑学的队长华颖介绍。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 三口之家在原户型的基础上，对空间格局做出...
contentList.remark: 三口之家在原户型的基础上，对空间格局做出调整和改变，运用移动墙的元素，将原客厅的一部分划分为儿童房并靠近主卧，将书房改造成老人房方便照顾孩子，增设的防滑垫、安全警报器为老人孩子的安全提供保障。几十年过去，这对夫妻增加、改造品茶区、棋牌室等为老年生活添加丰富多彩的元素。

contentList.remark: 说起团队作品获奖的优势所在，华颖说：“我们是答辩现场第一个提出全省周期住宅理念的，还是唯一去实地调研的队伍。此外，用一个故事串联起生命阶段和设计方案的想法

contentList.remark: 火花碰撞的团队

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 团队由五位建筑学专业的同学及两位广播电视...
contentList.remark: 团队由五位建筑学专业的同学及两位广播电视学专业的同学组成，他们在一起会碰撞出怎样的火花呢？

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “建筑学子偏理性，传媒学子偏感性，我们可...
contentList.remark: “建筑学子偏理性，传媒学子偏感性，我们可以给他们提供灵感和创意，在专业上，通过推文、视频等形式更好地传达设计理念，记录设计过程。”2018级广播电视学的钱天祺说。虽然两个专业的同学在此之前不甚熟悉，还由于疫情不能见面，但她们还是成为了最好的伙伴，优势互补。结果证明，调研vlog、全方位展现系统的介绍视频等让专家评审看到了她们的用心和专业，为设计方案增色不少。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 初出茅庐的“小七帆”，身上有一股敢想敢拼...
contentList.remark: 初出茅庐的“小七帆”，身上有一股敢想敢拼的冲劲。“我们参赛时年级比较低，知识储备远远不够，室内设计、建筑健康、智能家居这些都是第一次深入了解。”华颖坦言。通过查阅大量文献资料和老师的指导，他们渐渐摸索出室内设计的门道，大到墙体硬装、设置吊顶，小到家具设计、灯具布置。尽管困难重重，“但是能够设计理想中的家这一点，就足够吸引我们做下去。”2018级建筑学学生王梦君感慨道。

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.fullName: doc_title: AI研发让运动图标「动」起来...
contentList.remark: AI研发让运动图标「动」起来

contentList.name: vertical_text
contentList.remark: ■学生记者  姜力暄

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 旋转、跳跃、投篮……每一届奥运会都有独具...
contentList.remark: 旋转、跳跃、投篮……每一届奥运会都有独具文化特色的静态运动图标，表现运动之美，那么，你见过动起来的运动图标吗？

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 最近的杭州智博会上，曾经研发出“修复《富...
contentList.remark: 最近的杭州智博会上，曾经研发出“修复《富春山居图》”的浙江大学墨染团队新成果——AI动态运动图标首次亮相。在现场，你可以对着摄像机做出任意一个动作，比如投篮，拍摄下的小视频经过一系列智能计算与创意设计后，就会形成专属于你的动态图标。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “只要有一个运动的小视频，就可以形成充满...
contentList.remark: “只要有一个运动的小视频，就可以形成充满设计感的动态图标。”团队主要研发人员、浙江大学计算机学院17级博士生李薇介绍，智能系统会自动剥离掉个人的外貌特征，但保留个人的运动姿态和行为特征，这些个性化的姿态行为进一步与不同设计风格的运动图标相融合，从而形成个人专属的动态图标。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: 灵感来源于东京奥运会现有4种设计形式...
contentList.remark: 灵感来源于东京奥运会现有4种设计形式

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 谈到灵感的来源，李薇说这是一个创意激发的...
contentList.remark: 谈到灵感的来源，李薇说这是一个创意激发的成果。2020年2月，东京奥运会发布了动态运动图标，这是世界首次在奥运会上使用动态图标。巧合的是，静态运动图标也是东京奥运会首创的，1964年东京奥运会首次使用静态运动图标，从此运动图标的设计和发布成为每届奥运会筹办过程中的重要活动，运动图标成为奥运文化的重要载体。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “当时大家看到这个新闻觉得很有趣，我们看...
contentList.remark: “当时大家看到这个新闻觉得很有趣，我们看到小视频介绍说东京奥运会动态图标的设计周期大概是2—3年，我们的指导老师汤永川教授立即提出，我们可不可以也做一下，用人工智能的方式来做。”

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 这个项目很快于2020年7月开展起来，项...
contentList.remark: 这个项目很快于2020年7月开展起来，项目组只有4个人，他们首先选定了四个运动形式——篮球、拳击、举重、棒球以及四种设计风格——2000年悉尼奥运会风格、2008年北京奥运会风格、2020年东京奥运会风格和2022年杭州亚运会风格，来生成动态图标。后来这个项目被命名为AI创意运动会。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “最开始是希望全部用最前沿的人工智能生成...
contentList.remark: “最开始是希望全部用最前沿的人工智能生成对抗技术，但是发现实现起来还是有困难，所以最后选择了AI人体姿态估计技术和目标检测等技术的结合。”李薇在现

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 场为记者演示了动态运动图标的形成。在电脑...
contentList.remark: 场为记者演示了动态运动图标的形成。在电脑上打开程序后，可以选择现场拍摄视频或者使用已有视频，然后对视频进行剪辑，剪到你需要的长度或者说你想要的动作。剪辑完成后，在四种风格中任选一种，就可以生成专属的AI动态图标了。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “不同人来做同样的动作真的差别很大。”李...
contentList.remark: “不同人来做同样的动作真的差别很大。”李薇说，比如拳击，小朋友做起来软绵绵的，形成图标后也是感觉手没有伸出去，尽管没有力量感，但动态化的图标却别有创意。若是专业运动员来做这些动作，由于动作迅捷有力，生成的动态图标也特别有冲击力和运动之美。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.fullName: paragraph_title: 国际首创 或将助力杭州亚运会...
contentList.remark:
国际首创
或将助力杭州亚运会

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 李薇介绍，用AI完成动态图标自动设计生成...
contentList.remark: 李薇介绍，用AI完成动态图标自动设计生成是国际首创的技术应用，之前并没有出现过（日本是人工制作），杭州智博会也是这个新应用的首次亮相。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “其实还是有挺多人感兴趣的，智博会那天有...
contentList.remark: “其实还是有挺多人感兴趣的，智博会那天有很多人过来试玩。”智博会之后，团队接到了很多企业机构的合作邀请。但最惊喜的，还是得到了杭州亚组委的认可。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “亚组委那边希望我们这个应用能集成到智能...
contentList.remark: “亚组委那边希望我们这个应用能集成到智能亚运一站通，用户可以直接在手机上体验，生成动态运动图标，传播亚运文化。”亚组委希望在未来的两年时间里有更多的人通过这样的方式来了解杭州亚运会的运动项目，提高全民参与亚运会的热情。为了达到这一目标，项目正在完善体育运动视频大数据，致力于设计出更多种的运动形式。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “未来发展方向的话，一个是拓宽运动项目，...
contentList.remark: “未来发展方向的话，一个是拓宽运动项目，从目前的四项运动项目拓宽到涵盖亚运会所有运动项目；另一方面是创新技术方法，提升人工智能技术的识别能力和动态图标的智能生成能力。”李薇坦言现在的程序还有很大的改进空间，比如复杂背景过滤和多人运动图标生成等，这些都是技术未来的挑战和进步方向。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: “对我来说，这个项目最有趣的地方在于，把...
contentList.remark: “对我来说，这个项目最有趣的地方在于，把我们的科研工作以及相关的前沿技术和生活结合了起来，科技不再是冷冰冰的公式和代码。这个项目做出成果能够展出的时候，还是很有成就感的。”李薇说，这也许就是技术赋能生活的一种方式。

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: 据了解，“AI创意运动会”项目由浙江省设...
contentList.remark: 据了解，“AI创意运动会”项目由浙江省设计智能与数字创意研究重点实验室和阿里巴巴—浙江大学前沿技术联合研究中心（AZFT）合作研发。团队由汤永川教授与孙凌云教授指导，致力于探索设计和人工智能的结合点，运用大数据、跨媒体、群体智能等支持设计创新的人工智能技术，提升数字创意产业的内容与实体生产能力。

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: The Company’s business is subject to a variety of U.S. and international laws, rules, policies and other obligations regarding data protection.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Company is subject to an increasing number of federal, state and international laws relating to the collection, use, retention, security and transfer of various types of personal information. In many cases, these laws apply not only to third-party transactions, but also restrict transfers of personal information among the Company and its international subsidiaries. Several jurisdictions have passed laws in this area, and additional jurisdictions are considering imposing additional restrictions or have laws that are pending. These laws continue to develop and may be inconsistent from jurisdiction to jurisdiction. Complying with emerging and changing requirements causes the Company to incur substantial costs and has required and may in the future require the Company to change its business practices. Noncompliance could result in significant penalties or legal liability.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Company makes statements about its use and disclosure of personal information through its privacy policy, information provided on its website, press statements and other privacy notices provided to customers. Any failure by the Company to comply with these public statements or with federal, state or international privacy or data protection laws and regulations could result in inquiries or proceedings against the Company by governmental entities or others. In addition to reputational impacts, penalties could include ongoing audit requirements and significant legal liability.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: In addition to the r...
contentList.remark: In addition to the risks generally relating to the collection, use, retention, security and transfer of personal information, the Company is also subject to specific obligations relating to information considered sensitive under applicable laws, such as health data, financial data and biometric data. Health data and financial data are subject to additional privacy, security and breach notification requirements, and the Company is subject to audit by governmental authorities regarding the Company's compliance with these obligations. If the Company fails to adequately comply with these rules and requirements, or if health data or financial data is handled in a manner not permitted by law or under the Company's agreements with healthcare or financial institutions, the Company can be subject to litigation or government investigations, and can be liable for associated investigatory expenses, and can also incur significant fees or fines.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Payment card data is also subject to additional requirements. Under payment card rules and obligations, if cardholder information is potentially compromised, the Company can be liable for associated investigatory expenses and can also incur significant fees or fines if the Company fails to follow payment card industry data security standards. The Company could also experience a significant increase in payment card transaction costs or lose the ability to process payment cards if it fails to follow payment card industry data security standards, which could materially adversely affect the Company's business, reputation, results of operations and financial condition.

contentList.remark: Financial Risks

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: The Company expects its quarterly net sales and results of operations to fluctuate.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Company's profit margins vary across its products, services, geographic segments and distribution channels. For example, the gross margins on the Company's products and services vary significantly and can change over time. The Company's gross margins are subject to volatility and downward pressure due to a variety of factors, including: continued industry-wide global product pricing pressures and product pricing actions that the Company may take in response to such pressures; increased competition; the Company's ability to effectively stimulate demand for certain of its products and services; compressed product life cycles; supply shortages; potential increases in the cost of components, outside manufacturing services, and developing, acquiring and delivering content for the Company's services; the Company's ability to manage product quality and warranty costs effectively; shifts in the mix of products and services, or in the geographic, currency or channel mix, including to the extent that regulatory changes require the Company to modify its product and service offerings; fluctuations in foreign exchange rates; inflation and other macroeconomic pressures; and the introduction of new products or services, including new products or services with lower profit margins. These and other factors could have a materially adverse impact on the Company's results of operations and financial condition.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The Company has historically experienced higher net sales in its first quarter compared to other quarters in its fiscal year due in part to seasonal holiday demand. Additionally, new product and service introductions can significantly impact net sales, cost of sales and operating expenses. Further, the Company generates a significant portion of its net sales from a single product and a decline in demand for that product could significantly impact quarterly net sales. The Company could also be subject to unexpected developments, such as lower-than-anticipated demand for the Company's products or services, issues with new product or service introductions, information technology system failures or network disruptions, or failure of one of the Company's logistics, supply or manufacturing partners.

contentList.remark: U.S. soil on a U.S. rocket to the International Space Station before year's end. We're going to make that happen with the help of Boeing and SpaceX," Cabana said. "It's going to happen this year, and I can't wait."

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Cabana also praised the center’s partnership with the 45th space wing and others.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “All that we’ve accomplished in the last few years – none of it would have possible without the partnership that we have with the 45 $ ^{th} $  space wing, Space Florida, the Federal Aviation Authority and many others.”

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Cabana recapped
accomplishments of programs
led by Kennedy and provided a
glimpse of what’s to come:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Center Planning and Development
Cabana said it remains the center’s “front door” for doing business here. Overall, Kennedy has more than 19 agreements with commercial companies of various types, doing work at the center.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “As many agreements as we’ve put in place, we still have room for more. We’re going to continue to expand on the ones that we have and develop this amazing resource that we have here at the Kennedy Space Center,” Cabana said.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Some of the center’s great successes include the 20-year lease with SpaceX for Launch Complex 39A, the U.S. Air Force’s X-37 aircraft in OPF Bay 1, and Boeing’s CST Starliner in the C3PF (formerly OPF 3).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: NASA Kennedy Space Center Director Bob Cabana updates community leaders, business executives, partners, educators and government leaders on Kennedy-led programs and accomplishments during a presentation March 29, 2019, at the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Florida. Cabana recapped achievements and future plans for the Commercial Crew Program, Exploration Ground Systems, Launch Services Program, Exploration Research and Technology, and Center Planning and Development. After the presentation, guests had the opportunity to ask questions and visit displays from the programs and some of the commercial partners. Photo credit: NASA/Kim Shiflett

contentList.name: footer
contentList.remark: SPACEPORT Magazine

contentList.name: vision_footnote
contentList.remark: Guests visit with a representative from Exploration Research and Technology during NASA Kennedy Space Center Director Bob Cabana's update to community leaders, business executives, partners, educators and government leaders March 29, 2019, at the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Florida. Photo credit: NASA/Kim Shiflett

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Commercial Crew Program

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Cabana described this year as very busy, with a crewed flight test by SpaceX, uncrewed and crewed test flights with Boeing, and abort tests coming up with SpaceX and Boeing.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: SpaceX had a successful Demo-1 flight test in March.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “It was really great to see a crew vehicle launching off a NASA pad at 39A for the first time since the space shuttle Atlantis in 2011,” Cabana said. I’m really looking forward to seeing crews flying on these vehicles to the International Space Station.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Exploration Ground Systems

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The upgraded mobile launcher recently rolled out to Launch Pad 39B and then to the Vehicle Assembly Building, where it is now going through verification and validation testing. In a couple of months, the mobile launcher will be tested at Launch Pad 39B. Extensive modifications were completed on the mobile launcher so it can accommodate the extra weight of the Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft, though additional modifications are needed. The mobile launcher will be ready this fall when it completes testing at the pad.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: EGS broke ground for a new liquid hydrogen tank at Launch Pad 39B. The new tank will be able to hold more than 1 million gallons of LH2. It will be able to handle multiple launch attempts in the current configuration. The existing tank holds 750,000 gallons of LH2.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Exploration Mission-1 (EM-1) will put Orion in space without crew on board and bring it out to a distant retrograde orbit around the Moon. The most important thing NASA will get from the mission is a check of the thermal protection system of the Orion crew module during lunar reentry velocities.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The team completed some great recovery tests recently in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, using a test version of the Orion spacecraft.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: To prepare for Ascent Abort Test-2, the Launch Abort System is currently integrated with a test version of Orion inside the Launch Abort System Facility. NASA is targeting a June test date from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: “The data that will be looked at from this test is on the separation of Orion from the Launch Abort System,” Cabana said.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Firing Room 1 is where NASA’s first female launch director, Charlie Blackwell-Thompson, will give the “go” for launch of SLS and Orion on EM-1. She has been running launch simulations and work is continuing on the software needed for processing and launch.

contentList.remark: As outlined in our CD&A, the only financial performance measure we currently incorporate within our executive pay program is Alphabet's TSR relative to the companies comprising the S&P 100. As such, and as outlined below, relative TSR is the sole and most important financial performance measure as it relates to CAP.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Most Important Performance Measures

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Relative Total Shareholder Return

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Over the reported five-year period, CAP for our PEO has generally tracked the direction of Alphabet's Net Income, cumulative TSR, and relative TSR, with the exception of 2024 and 2025. During these two years, PEO CAP decreased slightly from 2023 levels despite an increase in Alphabet's share price, record high Net Income, and a strong performance in the company's 1-year TSR ranking relative to the S&P 100 (the Alphabet-selected measure in the CAP table above). This divergence is primarily driven by a lower unvested equity balance as shares from the 2022 triennial award continued to vest, which limits the impact of year-over-year fair value adjustments despite significant stock price growth.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For non-PEO NEOs, average CAP increased from $60.5 million to $100.9 million in 2025, which trended with the company's record Net Income of $132,170 million and strong cumulative TSR performance which reached a five-year high in 2025. Over the reported five-year period, average CAP for non-PEO NEOs has generally trended with Alphabet's relative TSR and Net Income growth, particularly following the transition in 2021 to an equity award mix that includes performance-based awards. This trend also reflects Alphabet's 1-year TSR ranking relative to the S&P 100, as the average CAP for our non-PEO NEOs has generally followed the year-over-year increases and decreases in this ranking throughout the reported five-year period. Additionally, in each of the reported years, Alphabet's cumulative TSR has substantially outperformed the cumulative TSR of our peer group, which has driven the value realized through our NEOs' equity awards, as their CAP has tracked our strong stock price relative to the market.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Volume

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Berkas-berkas yang disimpan di disk di dalam Container bersifat tidak permanen (akan terhapus seiring dengan dihapusnya Container/Pod), yang menimbulkan beberapa masalah untuk aplikasi biasa saat berjalan di dalam Container. Pertama, saat sebuah Container mengalami kegagalan, Kubelet akan memulai kembali Container tersebut, tetapi semua berkas di dalamnya akan hilang - Container berjalan dalam kondisi yang bersih. Kedua, saat menjalankan banyak Container bersamaan di dalam sebuah Pod, biasanya diperlukan untuk saling berbagi berkas-berkas di antara Container-container tersebut. Kedua masalah tersebut dipecahkan oleh abstraksi Volume pada Kubernetes.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Pengetahuan tentang Pod disarankan.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Latar Belakang

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Docker juga memiliki konsep volume, walaupun konsepnya Docker agak lebih fleksibel dan kurang dikelola. Pada Docker, sebuah volume adalah sesederhana sebuah direktori pada disk atau di dalam Container lainnya. Lifetime tidak dikelola dan hingga baru-baru ini hanya ada volume yang didukung disk lokal. Docker sekarang menyediakan driver untuk volume, namun fungsionalitasnya masih sangat terbatas (misalnya hingga Docker 1.7 hanya ada satu driver volume yang diizinkan untuk setiap Container, dan tidak ada cara untuk menyampaikan parameter kepada volume).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Sebaliknya, sebuah Volume Kubernetes memiliki lifetime yang gamblang - sama dengan lifetime Pod yang berisi Volume tersebut. Oleh karena itu, sebuah Volume bertahan lebih lama dari Container-container yang berjalan di dalam Pod tersebut, dan data di Volum tersebut juga dipertahankan melewati diulangnya Container. Tentu saja, saat sebuah Pod berakhir, Volume tersebut juga akan berakhir/terhapus. Dan mungkin lebih penting lagi, Kubernetes mendukung banyak jenis Volume, dan sebuah Pod dapat menggunakan sebanyak apapun Volume secara bersamaan.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Pada intinya, sebuah volume hanyalah sebuah direktori, dan mungkin berisi data, yang dapat diakses oleh Container-container di dalam Pod. Bagaimana direktori tersebut dibuat, medium yang menyokongnya, dan isinya ditentukan oleh jenis volume yang digunakan.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Untuk menggunakan sebuah volume, sebuah Pod memerinci volume-volume yang akan disediakan untuk Pod tersebut (kolom .spec.volumes ) dan di mana volume-volume tersebut akan ditambatkan (di-mount) di dalam Container-container di Pod (kolom .spec.containers.volumeMounts ).

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark:
Sebuah proses di dalam Container memiliki sudut pandang filesystem yang disusun dari image dan volume Dockernya. Docker Image berada pada bagian teratas hierarki filesystem, dan volume manapun yang ditambatkan pada path yang diperinci di dalam Image tersebut. Volume tidak danat ditambatkan pada volume lain atau memiliki hard link ke volume lain.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: SUBJ: Identification and Notification of Differences Between ATO Products and Services and ICAO Publications

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 1. Purpose of This Order. This order establishes procedures for personnel from the Air Traffic Organization (ATO) to identify and report differences between applicable Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) directives and applicable International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs). This order satisfies the requirements of the current version of FAA Order 1240.11, Assessing Compliance with ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) and Implementing their Provisions. The order directs FAA lines of business (LOBs) to implement standard operating procedures to evaluate new and amended ICAO SARPs for impact on the National Airspace System (NAS) and procedures, make implementation decisions, and file any resulting differences, if applicable.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 2. Audience. This order applies to all ATO service units and directorates responsible for processes and/or functions impacted by ICAO SARPs.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 3. Where Can I Find This Order? You can find this order on the FAA website at http://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/orders_notices.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 4. What This Order Cancels. This order cancels FAA Order JO 7000.6A, Identification and Notification of Differences Between ATO Products and Services and ICAO Documents, dated May 30, 2008.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: 5. Explanation of Policy Changes. Following a reorganization within the ATO, including the movement of ATO International into Mission Support Services, ATO International conducted a review of its processes in place to identify and report differences between FAA directives and ICAO SARPs. The ATO Safety & Technical Training (AJI) also conducted an audit to determine compliance with FAA Order 1240.11, Assessing Compliance with ICAO SARPs and Implementing their Provisions, and FAA Order JO 7000.6A, Identification and Notification of Differences between ATO Products and Services and ICAO Documents. The audit team found that ATO International had conducted the annual review and SARP amendment review of new/revised SARPs in accordance with FAA Order 1240.11. Although ATO International was compliant with FAA Order 1240.11 by correctly completing the reviews and notifying ICAO of differences, the audit team identified potential problems with several unnecessary or ambiguous requirements in FAA Order JO 7000.6A. Specifically, FAA Order 1240.11 addresses requirements for identifying differences in SARPs only, yet FAA Order JO 7000.6A incorrectly includes the requirement to notify ICAO for differences to the Procedures for Air Navigation Services-Air Traffic Management (PANS-ATM). FAA Order JO 7000.6B removes references to PANS-ATM, as the PANS-ATM does not carry the same status as the ICAO Annexes to the Convention. contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Carburetor Icing

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: One disadvantage of the carburetor system versus the fuel injected system is its icing tendency. Carburetor ice occurs due to the effect of fuel vaporization and the decrease in air pressure in the venturi, which causes a sharp temperature drop in the carburetor. If water vapor in the air condenses when the carburetor temperature is at or below freezing, ice may form on internal surfaces of the carburetor, including the throttle valve.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Ice generally forms in the vicinity of the venturi throat. This restricts the flow of the fuel-air mixture and reduces power. If enough ice builds up, the engine may cease to operate. Carburetor ice is most likely to occur when temperatures are below  $ 70^{\circ} $ F ( $ 21^{\circ} $ C) and the relative humidity is above 80 percent. However, due to the sudden cooling that takes place in the carburetor, icing can occur even with temperatures as high as  $ 100^{\circ} $ F ( $ 38^{\circ} $ C) and humidity as low as 50 percent. This temperature drop can be as much as 60 to  $ 70^{\circ} $ F. Therefore, at an outside air temperature of  $ 100^{\circ} $ F, a temperature drop of  $ 70^{\circ} $ F results in an air temperature in the carburetor of  $ 30^{\circ} $ F. [Figure 4-10]

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Figure 4-10. Although carburetor ice is most likely to form when the temperature and humidity are in ranges indicated by this chart, carburetor ice is also possible under conditions not depicted.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The first indication of carburetor icing in a powered parachute is a decrease in engine RPM, which may be followed by engine roughness. Although carburetor ice can occur during any phase of flight, it is particularly dangerous when using reduced power during a descent. Under certain conditions, carburetor ice could build unnoticed until you try to add power. To combat the effects of carburetor ice, some engines have a carb heat option. Some of the newer four-stroke engines have carburetor heat turned on all the time to combat icing. Two-stroke engines are typically less susceptible to icing but specific installations dictate how susceptible the carburetor is to icing. Consult the aircraft POH for the probability of carb ice for the specific installation you have and for carb ice procedures.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Fuel Injection Systems

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In a fuel injection system, the fuel is injected either directly into the cylinders, or just ahead of the intake valve. A fuel injection system usually incorporates these basic components: an engine-driven fuel pump, a fuel-air control unit, fuel manifold (fuel distributor), discharge nozzles, an auxiliary fuel pump, and fuel pressure/flow indicators. [Figure 4-11]

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The auxiliary fuel pump provides fuel under pressure to the fuel-air control unit for engine starting and/or emergency use. After starting, the engine-driven fuel pump provides fuel under pressure from the fuel tank to the fuel-air control unit. This control unit, which essentially replaces the carburetor, meters the fuel and sends it to the fuel manifold valve at a rate controlled by the throttle. After reaching the fuel manifold valve, the fuel is distributed to the individual fuel discharge nozzles. The discharge nozzles, which are located in each cylinder head, inject the fuel-air mixture directly into each cylinder intake port.

contentList.remark: Figure 4-11. Fuel injection system.

contentList.remark: Figure 26: ACK Ranges

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The fields that form each ACK Range are:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Gap: A variable-length integer indicating the number of contiguous unacknowledged packets preceding the packet number one lower than the smallest in the preceding ACK Range.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: ACK Range Length: A variable-length integer indicating the number of contiguous acknowledged packets preceding the largest packet number, as determined by the preceding Gap.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: Gap and ACK Range Le...
contentList.remark: Gap and ACK Range Length values use a relative integer encoding for efficiency. Though each encoded value is positive, the values are subtracted, so that each ACK Range describes progressively lower-numbered packets.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Each ACK Range acknowledges a contiguous range of packets by indicating the number of acknowledged packets that precede the largest packet number in that range. A value of 0 indicates that only the largest packet number is acknowledged. Larger ACK Range values indicate a larger range, with corresponding lower values for the smallest packet number in the range. Thus, given a largest packet number for the range, the smallest value is determined by the following formula:

contentList.name: algorithm
contentList.remark: smallest = largest - ack_range

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: An ACK Range acknowledges all packets between the smallest packet number and the largest, inclusive.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: The largest value for an ACK Range is determined by cumulatively subtracting the size of all preceding ACK Range Lengths and Gaps.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Each Gap indicates a range of packets that are not being acknowledged. The number of packets in the gap is one higher than the encoded value of the Gap field.

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: The value of the Gap...
contentList.remark: The value of the Gap field establishes the largest packet number value for the subsequent ACK Range using the following formula:

contentList.name: algorithm

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: THRALL'S PROBLEM FOR TWO ROWS

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: JISUN HUH, WOO-SEOK JUNG, JANG SOO KIM, AND MEESUE YOO

contentList.name: abstract
contentList.remark: ABSTRACT. In this paper, we study Thrall's problem for the higher Lie modules  $ L_{\lambda} $ . Our main result provides a tableau-theoretic description of the Schur expansion of the character of  $ L_{\lambda} $  when  $ \lambda $  has two rows, thereby solving Thrall's problem in this case. This formula is expressed in terms of standard Young tableaux with major index congruence conditions and a spin-parity condition defined through bijections with Yamanouchi domino tableaux. We also obtain tableau formulas for hook shapes and partitions with distinct parts, and these results extend to all partitions in which each part greater than 2 occurs at most twice.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: 1. INTRODUCTION

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: In this paper, we st...
contentList.remark: In this paper, we study Thrall's problem for the higher Lie modules. We begin by describing the problem. See Section 2 for the undefined terms.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Consider the C-vector space  $ V = C^{N} $  and let  $  T(V) = \bigoplus_{m \geq 0} V^{\otimes m}  $  be the tensor algebra on V, graded by tensor degree with V in degree 1. The free Lie algebra Lie(V) on V is the Lie subalgebra of  $  T(V)  $  generated by V under the commutator bracket  $ [x, y] = xy - yx $ . Since the bracket is homogeneous with respect to the tensor grading, we have  $ \operatorname{Lie}(V) = \bigoplus_{m \geq 1} \mathcal{L}_{m}(V) $ , where  $ \mathcal{L}_{m}(V) := \operatorname{Lie}(V) \cap V^{\otimes m} $  is the homogeneous component of degree m. For a partition  $ \lambda $ , the higher Lie module  $ \mathcal{L}_{\lambda}(V) $  indexed by  $ \lambda $  is defined by

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \mathcal{L}_{\lambda}(V):=\bigotimes_{i\geq1}\operatorname{S y m}^{m_{i}(\lambda)}(\mathcal{L}_{i}(V)), $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: where  $ m_{i}(\lambda) $  denotes the number of parts equal to i in  $ \lambda $ . We also use the convention that  $ \mathcal{L}_{\emptyset}(V) $  denotes the trivial one-dimensional GL(V)-module.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: By the Poincaré–Birkhoff–Witt theorem, the tensor algebra is identified as a graded  $ \mathrm{GL}(V) $ -module with the symmetric algebra on the free Lie algebra:

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ T(V)\cong\operatorname{S y m}(\operatorname{L i e}(V))\cong\bigoplus_{\lambda}\mathcal{L}_{\lambda}(V), $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: where the direct sum is over all partitions  $ \lambda $ . Thus the higher Lie modules arise naturally from the isomorphism above. For brevity, we write

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ L_{\lambda}:=\mathcal{L}_{\lambda}(V),\qquad L_{n}:=L_{(n)}. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: For  $  g \in \operatorname{GL}(V)  $ , let  $ x_{1}, \ldots, x_{N} $  be the eigenvalues of g. Then the character  $ \operatorname{ch}(L_{\lambda}) $  of the polynomial  $ \operatorname{GL}(V) $ -module  $ L_{\lambda} $  is a symmetric polynomial in  $ x_{1}, \ldots, x_{N} $ . In 1942, Thrall [8] asked for the Schur decomposition of the higher Lie modules  $ L_{\lambda} $ . Equivalently, the problem can be stated as follows.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Problem 1.1 (Thrall's Problem). For a partition  $ \lambda $  of n, find a combinatorial interpretation for the Schur coefficients of the characters  $ \operatorname{ch}(L_{\lambda}) $  in the limit  $ N \to \infty $ :

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \mathrm{ch}(L_{\lambda})=\sum_{\mu\vdash n}c_{\lambda,\mu}s_{\mu}. $$

contentList.name: footnote
contentList.remark: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. Primary: 05E10, 05A05; Secondary: 17B01, 20G05.

contentList.name: footnote
contentList.remark: Key words and phrases. Thrall's problem, higher Lie modules, domino tableaux, semistandard Young tableaux, plethysm.

contentList.name: doc_title
contentList.remark: Confidence-Gated Robot Autonomy: When Does Uncertainty Actually Help?

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Johannes A. Gaus $ ^{1} $ , Jhon P.F. Charaja $ ^{1} $ , and Daniel Haeufle $ ^{1} $

contentList.name: abstract
contentList.remark: Abstract—Robotic systems often use predictive uncertainty to decide whether to act autonomously or defer to a fallback policy. In threshold-gated autonomy, uncertainty matters mainly through its ability to rank likely errors. Standard metrics such as expected calibration error and AUROC do not directly test whether uncertainty changes act/defer decisions. We therefore evaluate uncertainty using Spearman rank correlation, paired bootstrap equivalence testing, and act/defer agreement. Across three temporal activity-recognition benchmarks, we find a dataset-dependent competence regime below which uncertainty provides a weak and unstable error ranking. Above this regime, softmax heuristics, MC Dropout, and ensembles produce similar gating behavior, while threshold choice has a much larger effect on execution outcomes. A multi-seed embodied simulation shows the same pattern for collision rate and cost once realized autonomy is matched. Under temporal covariate shift, ranking quality remains stable, but fine-grained semantic OOD detection remains near chance. These results suggest that simple uncertainty proxies can suffice for selective gating once the base model is competent, but not for semantic novelty detection.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: I. INTRODUCTION

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Robotic systems must estimate not only the most likely state of the world, but also whether that estimate is reliable enough for autonomous execution  $ [1] $ . A common mechanism is confidence-gated autonomy: a perception model predicts an action or activity label, and an uncertainty score determines whether the robot acts autonomously or defers to a fallback policy. This is closely related to selective prediction and reject-option decision making, which formalize the risk-coverage trade-off induced by abstention  $ [2] $ ,  $ [3] $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In practice, uncertainty is often derived from softmax probabilities using entropy, margin, or least confidence, although Bayesian approximations and ensembles are also common. This raises a practical question: how should uncertainty be evaluated when its role is to gate execution rather than provide calibrated probabilities? Standard metrics such as expected calibration error (ECE) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) do not directly answer whether two estimators induce materially different act/defer decisions.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We study this question in threshold-gated temporal activity recognition along two axes: model competence and distribution shift. Across three benchmarks, we find that uncertainty becomes decision-useful only after the base model enters a dataset-dependent competence regime. Above this regime, softmax heuristics, MC Dropout, and ensembles induce similar gating behavior, while threshold choice has a much larger effect on execution outcomes. Under temporal covariate shift,

contentList.name: figure_title
contentList.remark: Fig. 1: Confidence-gated autonomy: a classifier produces an uncertainty score  $ u(x) $ , and threshold  $ \tau $  determines whether the robot executes autonomously or defers to fallback. In our experiments, varying  $ \tau $  changes behavior far more than switching uncertainty estimators.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: ranking quality remains stable enough for selective deferral, whereas fine-grained semantic OOD detection remains weak. Figure 1 summarizes the setting.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Contributions.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • We introduce a decision-centric evaluation protocol for confidence-gated autonomy based on rank correlation, paired bootstrap equivalence testing, and act/defer agreement.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - We identify dataset-dependent competence regimes below which uncertainty does not reliably rank prediction errors for gating.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - We show that threshold choice has a substantially larger effect on execution outcomes than estimator choice, both offline and in a minimal embodied simulation, while fine-grained semantic OOD detection remains near chance.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: II. RELATED WORK

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration. Predictive uncertainty methods include MC Dropout  $ [4] $  and deep ensembles  $ [5] $ ,  $ [6] $ . However, improved calibration does not necessarily improve error ranking for selective prediction  $ [7] $ .

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Autonomy Adjustment and Risk-Aware Robotics. In robotics, uncertainty is used for selective execution, shared autonomy, and introspection  $ [8] $ ,  $ [1] $ ,  $ [9] $ ,  $ [10] $ , as well as risk-sensitive control through chance constraints or CVaR  $ [11] $ . Our focus is narrower: when uncertainty is useful for threshold-gated autonomy and when common proxies are effectively interchangeable.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Task-Driven Shift Detection. Related work detects distribution shift through task-level performance violations rather than input novelty alone  $ [12] $ . This helps explain why temporal covariate shift and semantic held-out-class detection behave differently in our experiments.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Selective Prediction and Evaluation Pitfalls. Selective prediction formalizes the coverage–risk trade-off  $ [3] $ ,  $ [2] $ . Common evaluations use risk–coverage curves, SelectiveNet, or AUROC  $ [13] $ ,  $ [14] $ , but global metrics such as ECE or AUROC may fail to reflect decision-level utility in structured robotic tasks  $ [7] $ . Recent work has also highlighted pitfalls.

contentList.remark: A Note on Second-Order Expected Maximum-Load Bounds for Binary Linear Hashing

contentList.remark: Abstract

contentList.name: abstract
contentList.remark: Let  $ S \subseteq F_{2}^{u} $  have size  $ n = 2^{\ell} $ , and let  $ h : F_{2}^{u} \to F_{2}^{\ell} $  be a uniformly random linear map. For  $ y \in F_{2}^{\ell} $ , write  $ \operatorname{load}_{h}(y) := |h^{-1}(y) \cap S| $ , and let  $ \mathsf{M}(S, h) := \max_{y \in \mathbb{P}_{2}^{\ell}} \operatorname{load}_{h}(y) $  be the maximum load. Jaber, Kumar and Zuckerman (STOC 2025) proved that the expected maximum load of h on S is at most  $ 16 \log n / \log \log n $ , matching the fully independent keys-into-bins scale up to constants. Their proof also gives the tail estimate

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \Pr\left[\mathsf{M}(S,h)\geq R\frac{\log n}{\log\log n}\right]\leq O\left(\frac{1}{R^{2}}\right). $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: We record a base opt...
contentList.remark: We record a base optimization in their exponential-potential method showing that binary linear hashing nearly matches fully independent hashing also at the level of the second-order maximum-load scale. For every \(R>1\) satisfying \(R\ell^{1-1/R}\geq D\ln\ell\), where \(D\) is an absolute constant, we prove

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \Pr\left[\mathsf{M}(S,h)\geq R\frac{\log n}{\log\log n}\right]\leq O\left(\frac{(\log\log n)^{2}}{R^{2}(\log n)^{2-2/R}}\right). $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Integrating this tail yields

contentList.name: display_formula
contentList.remark: $$ \mathbb{E}[\mathsf{M}(S,h)]\leq\left(1+(1+o(1))\frac{\log\log\log n}{\log\log n}\right)\frac{\log n}{\log\log n}. $$

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Thus binary linear hashing matches fully independent hashing in the leading term and matches the dominant second-order correction up to a  $ 1 + o(1) $  factor.
