contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block: 到达刘庄时，时任省公安厅厅长张秀夫再三嘱...
contentList.remark: 到达刘庄时，时任省公安厅厅长张秀夫再三嘱咐，邓小平有些疲劳，打牌时要尽量少问问题。等见到邓小平，邓小平便用四川话一边招呼大家“请坐，请坐”，一边指着丁关根介绍说“这位是我的牌友”，室内的气氛马上变得轻松起来。开局后，大家没想到，邓小平这位80岁老人是一位桥牌技术十分高超的牌手，他采用精确叫法，对牌型分布和控制张都有很强的表现力，而且与队友配合默契。他很少轻易放过一个机会，但也不会冒进地去定约一副他认为把握不大的牌。整个晚上，他始终专注地打牌，一边还和“牌友”谈笑风生。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:        “那您跟邓小平打桥牌，最后谁赢谁输？”按耐不住好奇，记者向郭本铁询问了当晚的“战况”。“他赢，他赢。”郭本铁笑着答道。
contentList.remark: “那您跟邓小平打桥牌，最后谁赢谁输？”按耐不住好奇，记者向郭本铁询问了当晚的“战况”。“他赢，他赢。”郭本铁笑着答道。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block: 事实上，郭本铁在桥牌界的声望“众人皆知”...
contentList.remark: 事实上，郭本铁在桥牌界的声望“众人皆知”。他的家中，有一个专门用来陈列桥牌比赛奖杯的玻璃柜；浙江省双人桥牌赛冠军、全国《百龄杯》桥牌团体赛冠军……他还在校内积极开办桥牌讲座，把这项运动的快乐带给更多的人。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:        “可惜的是，打桥牌过于耗费脑力，几年前，爸爸就不再打桥牌了。现在一直坚持的只有京剧了。”郭尚云说.
contentList.remark: “可惜的是，打桥牌过于耗费脑力，几年前，爸爸就不再打桥牌了。现在一直坚持的只有京剧了。”郭尚云说.

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:       1958年，我们从黄浦江畔、钱江两岸、八闽大地、锦绣江苏，手捧浙江大学的录取通知书，怀着无比喜悦的心情，来到母校无线电技术专业1958级（581、582、583班），开始了梦寐以求的5年大学生涯。我们充满天马行空的梦想，天真单纯的热情，师长的教导如阳光雨露般滋润抚育我们茁壮成长，如灯塔般照亮我们前行的方向。
contentList.remark: 1958年，我们从黄浦江畔、钱江两岸、八闽大地、锦绣江苏，手捧浙江大学的录取通知书，怀着无比喜悦的心情，来到母校无线电技术专业1958级（581、582、583班），开始了梦寐以求的5年大学生涯。我们充满天马行空的梦想，天真单纯的热情，师长的教导如阳光雨露般滋润抚育我们茁壮成长，如灯塔般照亮我们前行的方向。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block: 五年求是园，屡经变迁。入学时，我们无线电...
contentList.remark: 五年求是园，屡经变迁。入学时，我们无线电58级3个班共90人。1961年，抽调部分同学进入11系。同时，撤销师训班和自动远动专业后，部分同学转入无线电1958级。无线电1957级少数同学因故插班58级。毕业时，无线电1958级同学，已经超过100名。男生宿舍，也经历从本部4舍到3舍，再到三分部平舍的变迁。不变的是，创系元老何志均、邓汉馨、戚贻逊、张毓鸥、姚庆栋等一辈师长，带领当年风华正茂的中青年教师荆仁杰、张德馨、梁慧君、叶秀清等，求是创新，攻坚克难，奋发创业，教学规模和学科建设均有较大发展，一批批莘莘学子，如饥似渴，孜孜以求，获取科学知识，学得做人真谛，梦圆求是园。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:         五年求是园，峥嵘岁月稠。入学伊始，我们接受一个月的入学教育，走又红又专道路。学习宣传“鼓足干劲，力争上游，多快好省地建设社会主义”总路线。教育与生产劳动相结合。五年中，劳动实习时间超过一年。我们先后参加修筑杭州半山钢厂“铁路支线劳动，第六教学大楼的基建劳动，萧山长河公社抢收抢种劳动，到杭州电器仪表厂、杭州邮电器材厂、上海无线电四厂、武汉710厂、南京714厂等企业生产实习，还远赴成都766厂毕业实习，参与浙江省广播电台建台、杭州无线电厂、半导体厂和电子管厂筹建，参加学校的教育改革和技术革新。通过劳动和实习，我们年轻学子培养了与工农的感情，增长了生产实践知识，增强理论联系的能力。
contentList.remark: 五年求是园，峥嵘岁月稠。入学伊始，我们接受一个月的入学教育，走又红又专道路。学习宣传“鼓足干劲，力争上游，多快好省地建设社会主义”总路线。教育与生产劳动相结合。五年中，劳动实习时间超过一年。我们先后参加修筑杭州半山钢厂“铁路支线劳动，第六教学大楼的基建劳动，萧山长河公社抢收抢种劳动，到杭州电器仪表厂、杭州邮电器材厂、上海无线电四厂、武汉710厂、南京714厂等企业生产实习，还远赴成都766厂毕业实习，参与浙江省广播电台建台、杭州无线电厂、半导体厂和电子管厂筹建，参加学校的教育改革和技术革新。通过劳动和实习，我们年轻学子培养了与工农的感情，增长了生产实践知识，增强理论联系的能力。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:         五年求是园，我们潜心学习专业知识，在老师的谆谆教导下，以悬梁刺股精神，废寝忘食，互帮互学。图书馆、阅览室，座无虚席；教学大楼的灯光，彻夜通明。学校重视专业基础教育，重视培养实际工作和生产活动的动手能力。为我们毕业后，在不同的工作岗位得心应手，打下了良好的基础。同学们在专业技术工作中，默默奉献，辛勤耕耘，取得了骄人的业绩，没有辜负母校的栽培，老师的教导。我们中，涌现了高级工程师，研究员、教授、博导等高级专业技术人员和大中型科研院所（所）院（所）长、企业的总经理、总工程师等高级企业管理人才，厅局级科技管理人才，及军队的中将等。
contentList.remark: 五年求是园，我们潜心学习专业知识，在老师的谆谆教导下，以悬梁刺股精神，废寝忘食，互帮互学。图书馆、阅览室，座无虚席；教学大楼的灯光，彻夜通明。学校重视专业基础教育，重视培养实际工作和生产活动的动手能力。为我们毕业后，在不同的工作岗位得心应手，打下了良好的基础。同学们在专业技术工作中，默默奉献，辛勤耕耘，取得了骄人的业绩，没有辜负母校的栽培，老师的教导。我们中，涌现了高级工程师，研究员、教授、博导等高级专业技术人员和大中型科研院所（所）院（所）长、企业的总经理、总工程师等高级企业管理人才，厅局级科技管理人才，及军队的中将等。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      五年求是同，正处于国家三年经济困难时期，物资匮乏，生活十分艰苦。但我们个个精力饱满，乐观向上，生活上相互体贴，业余生活丰富多彩。我们当中，不乏歌舞戏曲人才，课余、周末，俱乐部，大操场，自编自演，愉悦身心，振奋精神。工厂车间，农村田头，也是表演舞台，鼓舞士气，忘却疲劳，尽显青春活力。
contentList.remark: 五年求是同，正处于国家三年经济困难时期，物资匮乏，生活十分艰苦。但我们个个精力饱满，乐观向上，生活上相互体贴，业余生活丰富多彩。我们当中，不乏歌舞戏曲人才，课余、周末，俱乐部，大操场，自编自演，愉悦身心，振奋精神。工厂车间，农村田头，也是表演舞台，鼓舞士气，忘却疲劳，尽显青春活力。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      六十春秋，韶华易逝，光阴如梭。我们骄傲，母校已由院系调整后单一的工科大学，经艰苦创业和四校合并，建成人文、社科、理工、工学、信息学、医学和农业生命环境学七大学部，以“综合型、研究型、创新型”为办学特色，学术思想活跃，学科综合交叉，办学实力雄厚，教育质量和办学水平居国内高校前列。
contentList.remark: 六十春秋，韶华易逝，光阴如梭。我们骄傲，母校已由院系调整后单一的工科大学，经艰苦创业和四校合并，建成人文、社科、理工、工学、信息学、医学和农业生命环境学七大学部，以“综合型、研究型、创新型”为办学特色，学术思想活跃，学科综合交叉，办学实力雄厚，教育质量和办学水平居国内高校前列。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      六十春秋，乘风破浪，弘歌而行。从1960年正式成立无线电电子工程学系到2015年更名为信息与电子工程学院，学院继承和发扬求是创新的优良传统，栉风沐雨，不断提高教学质量和科研水平，培养了近两万名高级科技人才和管理人才，为国家的发展做出了重要贡献。
contentList.remark: 六十春秋，乘风破浪，弘歌而行。从1960年正式成立无线电电子工程学系到2015年更名为信息与电子工程学院，学院继承和发扬求是创新的优良传统，栉风沐雨，不断提高教学质量和科研水平，培养了近两万名高级科技人才和管理人才，为国家的发展做出了重要贡献。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      六十春秋，似水流年，岁月蹉跎，改变了我们年少的面容，抹不去我们对年轻时光的追忆。曾经的激情岁月，没齿难忘。浓浓的师生情谊，时时在心头缠绕。纯真的感恩意念，与日俱增，与岁同长。
contentList.remark: 六十春秋，似水流年，岁月蹉跎，改变了我们年少的面容，抹不去我们对年轻时光的追忆。曾经的激情岁月，没齿难忘。浓浓的师生情谊，时时在心头缠绕。纯真的感恩意念，与日俱增，与岁同长。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      六十年后，我们再次聚会在这魂牵梦绕的母校，心潮澎湃。老校区日新月异，之江校区，山林掩映；华家池校区，典雅端庄；西溪校区，青春焕发；玉泉校区，旧貌换新颜。紫金港新校区建设，规模恢宏，古典与现代融合；舟山海洋学院，敞开大海般的胸怀，拥抱未来；海宁国际学院，洋为中用，中外结合，走向世界。
contentList.remark: 六十年后，我们再次聚会在这魂牵梦绕的母校，心潮澎湃。老校区日新月异，之江校区，山林掩映；华家池校区，典雅端庄；西溪校区，青春焕发；玉泉校区，旧貌换新颜。紫金港新校区建设，规模恢宏，古典与现代融合；舟山海洋学院，敞开大海般的胸怀，拥抱未来；海宁国际学院，洋为中用，中外结合，走向世界。

contentList.name: 正文文本text_block
contentList.fullName: 正文文本text_block:      “雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越”。母校从求是书院起步，跋涉文军长征，跨越四校合并，奋进改革开放，创造丰硕成果，正以坚定步伐，奔向世界一流大学的行列。我们如今虽已是耄耋老人，步履蹒跚，仍胸怀民族复兴大业，祈求民富国强，我们愿与母校和信电学院勠力同心，同舟共济，不忘初心，砥砺奋进！（无线电1958级部分校友）

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Abstract

contentList.name: abstract
contentList.remark: People often attempt to shape others' perceptions of them, but the role of romantic relationships in this process is unknown. The present set of studies investigates relationship visibility, the centrality of relationships in the self-images that people convey to others. We propose that attachment underlies relationship visibility and test this hypothesis across three studies in the context of Facebook. Avoidant individuals showed low desire for relationship visibility, whereas anxious individuals reported high desired visibility (Studies I and 2); however, similar motives drove both groups' actual relationship visibility (Study I). Moreover, both avoidant individuals and their partners were less likely to make their relationships visible (Studies I and 3). On a daily basis, when people felt more insecure about their partner's feelings, they tended to make their relationships visible (Study 3). These studies highlight the role of relationships in how people portray themselves to others.

In cats, ventral reticulospinal axons with cell bodies in the gigantocellular nucleus synapse onto inhibitory spinal interneurons, suggesting a candidate mechanism for inhibiting voluntary action. Inhibitory circuits also exist within the human brainstem itself, but these have not been studied in the context of threat processing. Second, we suggest that two forms of IRSA might exist: one in which muscle tone is preserved (similar to the classical concept of tonic immobility) and a hypotonic 'floppy' form of immobility $ ^{1} $ . Further research is required to identify and compare the presentation, aetiology and sequelae of these two behaviours, including their implications for victim rehabilitation and for legal outcomes. Importantly, both forms of IRSA would constitute involuntary responses to extreme threat and both would involve the suspension of normal voluntary action control.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Involuntary action and the law

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Our interpretation of IRSA as an involuntary, threat-induced block of normal voluntary action control raises profound questions about voluntariness, autonomy and consent. Voluntary action depends on the functioning of specific brain circuits that are centred on the frontal lobes and also on the nonengagement of other brain circuits that are associated with fear and threat, centred on evolutionarily preserved specialized circuits that also involve subcortical structures.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Legal systems provide normative principles for investigating, explaining and judging human voluntary actions $ ^{15} $ . Legal process often poses 'why' questions about human behaviours and explains both actions and omissions by reference to the intentions of agents. Individuals are held responsible for their actions and omissions when these are intentional and voluntary, but responsibility is qualified or reduced when actions and omissions are unintentional – and individuals are typically not held responsible for actions that are involuntary. Thus, legal concepts of responsibility inevitably implicate the neurophysiological question of the role of cortical voluntary action circuits in control of behaviour.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We suggest that given the neural mechanisms that underlie responses to severe threat, IRSA can be considered as an involuntary omission of voluntary action. As such, legal 'why' questions regarding IRSA would not have the same force as for intentional actions or omissions. Legal process should recognize this fact and ensure it is consistently applied.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: We highlight a second issue for legal process surrounding IRSA. Legal case reports show that accounts by victims of immobility during RSA are often disjointed and lack conventional explanatory terms (Box 1). The victim may have difficulty answering 'why' questions. Defence lawyers often exploit this fact and draw attention to a victim's inability to articulate and justify their behaviour during RSA. This appears to be straightforward victim-blaming, diverting the attention of the court away from the aggressive behaviour of the assailant towards the purportedly strange behaviour of the victim. In fact, recent neuroscientific advances can also help in understanding why victims often have difficulty in explaining their own behaviour. Victims' accounts of IRSA are likely to share the fragmented, incoherent quality that is characteristic of traumatic memories in general.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: In addition, memories of IRSA refer to an unprecedented experience – namely, losing voluntary control over one's own body. Voluntary agency is the chief backdrop to mental life in healthy adults, and so a sudden loss of ability to act in accordance with one's wishes is likely to seem strange and inexplicable even in the absence of trauma. Clinical neuroscientific evidence from a range of conditions confirms both the disorganization of traumatic memory $ ^{14} $  and the bizarreness of losing

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: volitional control $ ^{15} $  that are also present in IRSA. The law already recognizes in evidential guidelines that trauma may affect the ability to remember and explain events, including one's own behaviour – but this point seems often to be ignored in legal discussions of IRSA.

contentList.name: paragraph_title
contentList.remark: Conclusion

contentList.name: text
contentList.fullName: text: We argue that IRSA i...
contentList.remark: We argue that IRSA is an evolutionarily conserved involuntary response that is characterized by lack of normal voluntary motor control, with further distinctive relations to sexual aggression and fear and with subsequent memory effects. We hypothesize that IRSA emerges when the aggressor's behaviours activate the brain threat-defence circuitry of the victim, leading to the inhibition of neural pathways that underlie the victim's voluntary action control.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: This interaction between neural circuits for threat processing and for voluntary action remains a scientific hypothesis, as we can have only indirect evidence regarding patterns of neural activity during IRSA. Instead, our argument relies on indirect evidence such as victim testimony and evidence from studies of defence circuitry in animals. This evidence, although indirect, is substantial and convergent. Ethical and moral hazards surround almost all research in this area, which makes it difficult for neuroscientific research to directly address the legal and societal issues raised by RSA. However, neuroscience should still, in our view, contribute to public debate regarding RSA. For example, mechanistic understanding of IRSA may help to counteract rape myths and ensure justice. Our hypothesis of threat-induced involuntary inhibition of voluntary action pathways may contribute to improving understanding of the facts about RSA crimes, the societal wrongs of gender violence, and the realities of victims' experience and suffering.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: Neuroscientists can also make important contributions to justice in this area. For example, a recent intervention study has shown that educating police officers to understand the involuntary neural mechanisms of IRSA reduced acceptance of rape myths. Moreover, neuroscientifically informed training for officers improved victims' willingness to continue with legal proceedings $ ^{28} $  and such training could potentially improve legal outcomes and justice. Finally, increased awareness of IRSA may benefit victims themselves by reducing victim-blaming, including self-blaming and inappropriate feelings of guilt.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: A recent Spanish law explicitly requires that consent must be freely and clearly expressed by a person's actions. This progressive and enlightened legislation clearly rules out the rape myth that IRSA could ever be interpreted as consent. Arguments and attitudes that imply that immobility might be misinterpreted as consent are neuroscientifically mistaken, and unjustly blame victims. Neuroscience may have a role in helping legal systems and wider society to guard against such rape myths.

contentList.remark: $ ^{10} $ The potential energy savings is calculated by multiplying the number of Windows 10 devices in use by the energy consumption difference between 2009 and 2014 computers as determined by the ENERGY STAR ratings system. “Laptop” includes laptop, notebook, and tablet computers. “Desktop” includes desktop, all-in-one, and server devices. Where specific market data is not available, this analysis assumes a 4:1 ratio of laptop to desktop sales. Windows 10 mobile, wearable, and IoT devices are excluded. Windows 10 consoles are included.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: $ ^{11} $ Savings in electricity prices across regions are calculated as follows:

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Electricity prices for the United States are from the International Energy Agency – Key World Energy Statistics 2017

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • The electricity price for Asia is the average consumer price paid for energy in Central and East Asia, excluding Japan and China.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for Japan are from the International Energy Agency – Key World Energy Statistics 2017

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for China are from the Chinese National Energy Administration.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for Canada are from the International Energy Agency – Key World Energy Statistics 2017.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - Energy prices for Europe are from the European Commission Eurostat reports. The prices for France, Germany, and the UK are broken out separately. The prices for Western and Eastern Europe are averaged separately.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for India are from the Indian Ministry of Power, Tariff & Duty of Electricity Supply in India, March 2014.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for Latin America are an average of the consumer prices for electricity across the region, excluding Mexico and Argentina.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for Mexico are from the Comision Federal de Electricidad.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - The price of electricity in Argentina has varied significantly due to economic instability. Prices used for this analysis are based on the consumer price reported by Bloomberg News, January 29, 2016.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Energy prices for the Middle East are based on an average across the region.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: $ ^{12} $ The conversion from kWh to carbon reduction is based on the International Energy Agency (IEA) emission factors 2016 edition.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - The conversion is based on the  $ CO_{2} $ -equivalent emissions for electricity generation, excluding heat, adding in the correction factors for transmission and distribution losses, electricity trade with other countries, methane factors, and nitrous oxide factors.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: - The factor for trade is excluded where regions are aggregated, such as for Latin America and Central/Eastern Europe. IEA does not provide trade factors for these regions where energy purchase and sales are almost entirely within the region.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • IEA provides separate data for the Middle East and Africa. Those values are averaged for the “Middle East and Africa” category used in this analysis. The IEA European average data is used for Western Europe, excluding France, Germany, and the UK.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • IEA European average data is used for Central and Eastern Europe.

contentList.name: text
contentList.remark: • Conversions from energy to vehicles and forest sequestration are determined using the US Environmental Protection Agency Greenhouse Gases Equivalencies Calculator.
